### GONNA STEAL YOUR HEARTS LIKE YOU STOLE OUR LAND

#### BLAK SOCIAL IS

## **AN INDIGENOUS ARTS SPACE DREAMING ACROSS FILM, THEATRE + MUSIC**

Alethea Beetson (Kabi Kabi/Gubbi Gubbi and Wiradjuri) established Blak Social after successfully founding renowned Indigenous youth arts organisation, Digi Youth Arts, to continue creating spaces for the sovereign-led development and presentation of Indigenous stories and connected arts practice.

Since its beginnings in 2020, Blak Social has delivered productions such as Queen’s City, Blak Friday and held a residency at The Tivoli through which it delivered Blak Day Out 2022 and 2023 along with other music centric events. In 2023 Blak Social produced First Nations led alt-rock band Selve’s visual album Red Desert Dream via our label; and will be releasing new music through Blak Social records in 2024.

Blak Social’s next major theatre + film work is Meet Your Maker - details of that epic work will be available soon!

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5e4e4e58add2726619f02616/21831bea-9705-488d-b034-f4246eb83e7f/Screenshot+2024-06-01+at+7.29.39+pm.png)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5e4e4e58add2726619f02616/95aa55a9-9514-4fe9-b21b-f559a18206a9/Screenshot+2024-06-01+at+7.31.40+pm.png)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5e4e4e58add2726619f02616/e2019fd0-a18e-48f2-abdf-3e96e550d981/Screenshot+2024-06-01+at+7.30.11+pm.png)

We acknowledge the important role the arts has played, and continues to play on these lands since the very first sunrise. We give thanks to the Elders, activists and artists who paved the way for us to do this work.

Always was, always will be!

# **OUR STORY**

## **WE ARE EARTH FREQUENCY**

Earth Frequency is a four-day music, arts, lifestyle and environment festival based in South-East Queensland, Australia.

From our humble beginning as a small landcare party in 2005, Earth Frequency has grown into one of Australia’s most vibrant cultural events and now holds the distinction of being Queensland’s longest-running electronic music festival.

Drawing influence from a rich mix of genres and traditions, including doof, rave, boutique and transformational festivals, over two decades, we’ve moved beyond labels to become a truly multi-faceted gathering that celebrates creativity, connection, intention, education and inspiration.

Truly independently owned and operated, Earth Frequency has existed for its entire history without corporate sponsorship, alcohol sales or major government funding.

We’re built on a belief in the strength of community, unity in diversity, respect for nature and the environment, and the capacity of music and art in all their forms to inspire growth and enact positive change in the world.

We’re committed to creating a space that is welcoming, respectful and safe for all who gather with us, and the local community and environment around us.

This includes honouring and respecting First Nations culture and Country, supporting peace, culture and diversity in all its forms, being genuinely family friendly and continually strengthening our approach to accessibility, sustainability and community care.

As Earth Frequency grows, so too does our responsibility to one another and to the environment that supports us, and we approach that responsibility with openness, intention and heart.

Music sits at the heart of everything we do. Our programming is guided by a commitment to quality, diversity and independent creative expression, bringing together live and electronic artists from across a wide spectrum of sounds, scenes and traditions.

From techno, bass, psytrance, progressive and house through to drum’n’bass, reggae, hip-hop, funk, folk, downbeat, world music and beyond, we aim to create a musical journey that connects past, present and future while giving space to both emerging and established artists.

What began as a primarily electronic gathering is now a truly multi-genre festival, and we continue to curate lineups that reflect the depth, creativity and energy of both Australian and global festival culture and the many communities that shape our dancefloors.

Creative arts are woven throughout every part of the Earth Frequency experience. Across our stages, installations, performance spaces and market areas, we showcase a diverse range of visual artists, live painters, performers, designers and makers whose work transforms the festival grounds into a living, evolving gallery.

From immersive installations, projections and visionary art through to handcrafted goods, workshops and interactive spaces, creativity is present at every corner of the festival, reflecting our commitment to supporting independent artists and fostering an environment where art, culture and community can be experienced not just on stage, but across the entire site.

Our journey hasn’t always been easy, nor without its share of challenges, yet each chapter has strengthened our resolve and deepened our bond with the community at our core. We are proud to have never missed a year in more than two decades of history, even through the most uncertain of times. Every test has clarified our purpose and reaffirmed our values.

To everyone who has stood beside us, danced with us and helped carry this vision forward, we offer our sincere gratitude. Earth Frequency exists because you do.

We are all Earth Frequency.

# **mEDIA TEAM**

Each year, we work alongside a talented and dedicated group of photographers and videographers who help document Earth Frequency through their own unique lenses. The EFF2026 Media Team is currently taking shape, with every creator bringing their own eye, instinct and perspective. From the big, unforgettable moments to the quiet scenes unfolding at the edges of the site, our Media Team captures both what you saw and much of what you couldn’t. Together, they form a layered visual record of the festival, reflecting its energy, intimacy and scale in equal measure.

Earth Frequency Festival acknowledges that this festival takes place on the traditional lands of the Jinibara peoples.  
We pay respect to their ancestors and elders, past and present, along with today’s descendants that carry on the living culture and ensure its survival for future generations.  
We are grateful to all the custodians of the lands on which we have gathered previously - the Bundjalung, Gubbi Gubbi, and Yuggera lands.

## **Welcome to Earth Frequency Festival**

Earth Frequency is a music, arts, lifestyle and environment festival based in South-East Queensland, Australia. From humble beginnings as a small landcare party more than two decades ago, we have grown into Queensland’s  
longest-running electronic music festival and one of Australia’s leading cultural events. Grounded in arts, education and community spirit, Earth Frequency draws inspiration from a wide spectrum of genres and traditions, including doof, rave, tribal gatherings, transformational and boutique festival culture. Over time, we have transcended these labels to become a truly multifaceted experience centred on creativity, connection, intention and inspiration.

### **Our 2026 Edition will return to Woodfordia from October 23 – 26**

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/64c1dc237276232628c6fa4b/1b20ae97-588e-4d4e-b3a6-0ff2ac142ddf/DMM_EFF2025-1.jpg)

### **EARTH FREQUENCY RETURNS TO WOODFORDIA IN 2026!**

Following the success of our 20th Anniversary Edition, Earth Frequency Festival returns to the iconic cultural parklands of Woodfordia in 2026. Set in the lush foothills of the Moreton Bay region, just one hour north of Brisbane, EFF2026 will take place from October 23 to 26. In 2026, we look forward to building on the momentum of our milestone year and delivering the most expansive and fully realised edition of the festival to date.

Expect a rich and carefully curated mix of electronic and live music, performance, visionary art and installations, workshops and wellness, a dedicated family and kids space, quality food and markets, and a strong sense of community connection. Together, we provide a meeting place where people from many different backgrounds, ages and walks of life connect through shared interests in music, art, nature, technology, culture and peace. Our ongoing aim is to create an experience that is deeply meaningful, connective and genuinely life-changing!

# **TICKETS**

## **TICKETS FOR EFF2026 ARE ON SALE NOW**

You can purchase festival tickets, vehicle passes, camping upgrades and other add-ons all through [**Humanitix**](https://events.humanitix.com/earth-frequency-festival-2025/tickets)

*   All purchases are final. If you can no longer attend for any reason and want to sell your ticket, you can list it for sale publicly or sell direct to a friend on our official ticket reseller platform [**Tixel**](https://tixel.com/au/music-tickets/2026/10/23/earth-frequency-festival-2026).
    
*   For any ticket questions, [**read the terms and conditions**](https://www.earthfrequency.com.au/ticket-terms-and-conditions)
    
*   If you can’t find your answers in the T&Cs, [**contact us**](https://www.earthfrequency.com.au/connect).
    
*   If your birthday falls on October 23/24/25/26, [**drop us an email**](mailto:hello@earthfrequency.com.au?subject=EFF2025%20Birthday%20Ticket%20%F0%9F%8E%82) for a friendly birthday discount ticket!
    
*   We love our festival families! Kids 0-12 enter free of charge. Teenagers 13-17 can purchase a youth ticket at the gate for $200 (minors must be accompanied by a legal parent/guardian, or have a written note of consent to attend from a legal parent/guardian and attend with an adult over the age of 18 years).
    
*   We offer discounted day tickets for local residents. If your photo ID shows proof of residence at Woodford 4514, Bellthorpe 4514, or Cedarton 4514, you can purchase a single-day ticket for $80. Local resident day tickets can only be purchased at the front gate upon entry. Camping is not included, and you must park your vehicle as instructed at the front gate and walk into the festival ground for the day.
    

[BUY EFF2026 TICKETS 🎟️](https://events.humanitix.com/earth-frequency-festival-2026/tickets)

When entering the festival, you must bring your **Photo ID** to verify you are the ticket owner, and the name on your ticket must exactly match the name on your photo ID.  If you do not have photo id which matches the name on your ticket, you will not be permitted to enter the festival using that ticket. This is a protection measure to avoid theft and duplication of e-tickets.  The only possible delegation of tickets is if the ticket owner has multiple tickets in their own name, they may delegate their additional tickets to people in the same vehicle at the scanning point.

**Please be aware** that ticket scammers are prolific and take advantage of events like Earth Frequency Festival, with tickets being offered at lower prices on social media including as comments on our official posts and on websites like marketplace, ebay and gumtree. The only way to be sure of getting a legitimate ticket is to purchase your ticket through our Humanitix ticket page or our official ticket reselling platform Tixel. Second hand ticket sales always carry some risk and Earth Frequency Festival will not be able to assist if you fall victim to a fake ticket seller.

# **FESTIVAL FAQ**

*   #### When is Earth Frequency Festival 2026 happening?
    
    Earth Frequency Festival 2026 takes place from October 23–26, 2026 at Woodfordia, around 1 hour north of Brisbane.
    
*   #### Where is EFF2026 held?
    
    Earth Frequency Festival 2026 will be held at Woodfordia, a venue in the Moreton Bay region, inland from the Sunshine Coast. Woodfordia is located at 87 Woodrow Rd, Woodford.
    
*   #### What is the venue like?
    
    Woodfordia is in the Moreton Bay Region and is a flat, forested site with permanent amenities, walking trails, and Lake Gkula for swimming. The entertainment zone is well-shaded with hundreds of gum trees providing a picturesque setting for our stages, markets and other festival features. We are going above and beyond to create an immersive festival environment this year. Camping is all flat and on solid ground, and the walking distances from campsites to stages are equal or better than at Ivory's Rock. Access is excellent and suitable for all vehicles.
    
*   #### What are the directions to the site?
    
    [**Click here**](https://www.earthfrequency.com.au/location) for information on travelling to the festival venue at Woodfordia.
    
*   #### Approximately how many people attend EFF – how big is the crowd?
    
    Earth Frequency typically draws around 5,000 attendees, creating a vibrant but boutique festival atmosphere.
    
*   #### Will there be police on site?
    
    We expect a police operation on the roads and at times there may be police at the festival.
    
*   #### What can I do if I feel unsafe?
    
    To help ensure a safe, welcoming and unified experience for all our community, we have implemented a policy that overtly political symbols and protest materials, such as national flags and banners, are not to be brought into the festival space. We have witnessed the division and harm that this can create, whether online or at events, and we want nothing more than for everyone to feel safe and united at Earth Frequency.
    
    There is always nuance and sensitivities to how policies like this are applied and interpreted, and to be clear – if an individual chooses to dress in traditional cultural attire or has a small artifact such as a pin or patch, and is engaging in the festival experience peacefully, this will not present an issue. Overt and disruptive actions such as crowd agitation, flag-wearing and delivering political speeches, as well as anything that could be considered intentionally divisive, discriminatory or supportive of violence, compromise our highest goal of a safe and welcoming festival and will be responded to as appropriate to the situation.  
      
    If you do not feel safe or see an activity that you feel goes against our policy, please let our friendly Earth Frequency staff or security team know.
    
*   #### Are there medical staff on site?
    
    Yes, there are on-site Medical / First Aid services staffed 24/7 by qualified medics to handle injuries, illness, and emergencies.
    
*   #### Are there water refill stations that are safe to drink from?
    
    Yes. Free, drinkable water is available onsite via multiple water refill stations. These are located throughout the festival and all attendees are encouraged to use them.
    
*   #### Will there be showers?
    
    Yes! Showers will be set up in all campground areas.
    
*   #### Are the showers hot or cold?
    
    We have a mixture of hot and cold showers.
    
*   #### Are the toilets permanent facilities or portable units?
    
    There will be a mix of portable facilities as well as permanent Woodfordia facilities.
    
*   #### Is there a fire ban?
    
    A fire ban is in place for Woodfordia. Campfires and other open flames (including candles) are not allowed, and patrons are not permitted to fire twirl. Gas cookers are allowed, as long as they are supervised at all times.
    
*   #### What are the music running times?
    
    The stages will run until midnight on Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights, and until 6pm on Monday evening when the festival closes.
    
*   #### Will there be anywhere to swim?
    
    Yes! Lake Gkula is situated in the centre of the venue and offers a beautiful swimming spot for attendees. Full details of how swimming will operate during the festival will be released soon.
    
*   #### Will there be lockers to store my things?
    
    No EFF does not operate a cloak room or locker system.
    
*   #### Are there ATMs on site?
    
    Yes there will be an ATM onsite at the Front Gate and in the Market Place.
    
*   #### Can i buy alcohol at the festival?
    
    No. Alcohol will not be sold or served at the festival. EFF is a strictly BYO event.
    
*   #### Will there be a place to charge my phone or other devices (charging stations)?
    
    Yes, you can charge your phone for $5 at the Info Tent. You can drop them off and they will be safe with the Info Tent team until you pick them up. We recommend you drop them off before your phone dies to avoid longer charging times.
    
*   #### Is there mobile phone reception or Wi-Fi at the festival site?
    
    There is a Telstra and Optus tower near the festival venue that provides mobile reception, however this can be subject to conditions at the time, including distance to towers and number of people on site.
    
*   #### Is there a general store on-site for basic supplies or forgotten items?
    
    Yes. Woodfordia has a general store where you can purchase coffee, snacks, camping equipment and a wide range of supplies. It’s conveniently located near the glamping area and Lake Gkula.
    
*   #### Is there a map of the festival site available (to find stages, camping areas, etc)?
    
    The festival map will be released closer to the event in October.
    
*   #### Is there a dedicated place to go if I feel unwell or overwhelmed?
    
    Yes. The ConsciousNest is a safe chill-out area where attendees can rest if they feel overwhelmed or emotionally unwell. For more serious medical issues, there is on-site Medical / First Aid services staffed 24/7 by qualified medics to handle injuries, illness, and emergencies.
    
*   #### What happens if it rains or there’s bad weather during the festival?
    
    Earth Frequency Festival is an outdoor, all-weather event over four days. The event will proceed unless specific safety advice is received by a relevant authority to halt or postpone the festival.
    
*   #### Are there any shaded areas or indoor spaces in case of extreme weather?
    
    It is a primarily open-air event.
    
*   #### Where can I buy tickets?
    
    Tickets are available via Humanitix by clicking [**here**](https://events.humanitix.com/earth-frequency-festival-2026/tickets).
    
*   #### Are tickets available for purchase on the gate?
    
    No. All ticket purchases must go through Humanitix or Tixel. Gate sales are not available, except for teenagers 13-17, who can can purchase a youth ticket at the gate for $200. Minors must be accompanied by a legal parent/guardian, or have a written note of consent to attend from a legal parent/guardian and attend with an adult over the age of 18 years. Kids 0-12 enter free of charge.
    
*   #### Is it all ages?
    
    Yes. Earth Frequency is an all-ages festival. Children aged 0–12 enjoy free entry. Teens (13–17) can purchase youth tickets. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian, or arrive with an adult and have a consent letter from a parent / legal guardian.
    
*   #### Are there single-day tickets available?
    
    No. If we don't sell out, we may offer a limited amount of Saturday and Sunday entry tickets, but that won't be announced until the weekend of the festival. We are close to selling out in 2025, so it isn't likely.
    
*   #### What are the terms and conditions of entry?
    
    You can view the full Terms and Conditions by clicking [**here**](https://www.earthfrequency.com.au/ticket-terms-and-conditions).
    
*   #### What price are tickets for kids?
    
    Kids aged 0–12 enter free of charge. Youth tickets (13–17 years) are available for $200 at the gate. Minors must be accompanied by a legal parent/guardian, or have a written note of consent to attend from a legal parent/guardian and attend with an adult over the age of 18 years.
    
*   #### Can I change the name on my tickets?
    
    If you can no longer attend for any reason and want to sell your ticket, you can list it for sale publicly or sell direct to a friend on our official ticket reseller platform Tixel. Using the Tixel service, you can list your ticket for public sale, or make a private link and sell directly to a friend so their name can be added to the ticket. [**Click here to visit our official Tixel page.**](https://tixel.com/au/music-tickets/2026/10/23/earth-frequency-festival-2026)
    
*   #### I haven't received my email confirmation/ticket — what do I do?
    
    If you haven’t received your confirmation or ticket, check your spam folder first. If it’s still missing, reach out via the contact form, referencing your purchase or asking for support.
    
*   #### I can no longer attend the event. What are my options?
    
    If you can’t attend, your only option is to resell your ticket using the festival’s official resale platform [**Tixel**](https://tixel.com/au/music-tickets/2026/10/23/earth-frequency-festival-2026).
    
*   #### Can I get a refund if I can't attend?
    
    Refunds are not available due to personal circumstances or poor weather. If the festival is genuinely postponed due to force majeure, tickets remain valid for the new dates. Only use our official ticket resale platform [**Tixel**](https://tixel.com/au/music-tickets/2026/10/23/earth-frequency-festival-2026) to resell your tickets.
    
*   #### How and when will I receive my tickets after purchase?
    
    Your tickets are emailed via Humanitix shortly after purchase. Be sure to check your inbox and spam folder. If you haven’t received your ticket, use the website’s Contact Us form for assistance.
    
*   #### Can I change the name on my ticket?
    
    Using the Tixel service, you can list your ticket for public sale, or make a private link and sell directly to a friend so their name can be added to the ticket. [**Click here for our official ticket resale platform Tixel.**](https://tixel.com/au/music-tickets/2026/10/23/earth-frequency-festival-2026)
    
*   #### Who do I contact regarding ticketing?
    
    For ticketing issues, use EFF’s official [**Contact Us**](https://www.earthfrequency.com.au/contact-us) form or refer to the ticketing platforms ([**Humanitix**](https://events.humanitix.com/earth-frequency-festival-2026/tickets) or [**Tixel**](https://tixel.com/au/music-tickets/2026/10/23/earth-frequency-festival-2026)) you used to purchase your tickets.
    
*   #### Are there age restrictions?
    
    We are an all-ages event. Children 0–12 enter free. Teens 13–17 need a youth ticket ($200 at the gate) and must be accompanied by a guardian or have written consent.
    
*   #### I want to sell/buy a ticket through a ticket resale website, will it be valid?
    
    Yes, but only if you use [**Tixel**](https://tixel.com/au/music-tickets/2026/10/23/earth-frequency-festival-2026), the festival’s official resale platform. Buying from other resale sites may risk invalid tickets.
    
*   #### Can I collect my ticket from the box office?
    
    Tickets are emailed post-purchase via Humanitix. There will be no Box Office on site.
    
*   #### Do I need to bring ID?
    
    Yes, a valid photo ID matching the name on your ticket is required for entry.
    
*   #### Are children free?
    
    Kids 0-12 enter free of charge. Teenagers 13-17 can purchase a youth ticket at the gate for $200. (Minors must be accompanied by a legal parent/guardian, or have a written note of consent to attend from a legal parent/guardian and attend with an adult over the age of 18 years.)
    
*   #### If EFF sells out, can I still purchase a youth ticket at the gate ?
    
    Yes. We always hold back sufficient capacity for youth tickets for kids 12-17 years old as these can only be purchased at the gate.
    
*   #### Can I transfer a ticket or change the name on it?
    
    Yes. Using the Tixel service, you can list your ticket for public sale, or make a private link and sell directly to a friend so their name can be added to the ticket. [**Click here to transfer or change your name via Tixel.**](https://tixel.com/au/music-tickets/2026/10/23/earth-frequency-festival-2026)
    
*   #### Does the name on my ticket need to match my ID?
    
    Yes
    
*   #### Do you honour companion cards?
    
    Yes. You can purchase one ticket before the event, and when you arrive, present your companion card and your companion will receive free entry. They need to arrive with you in the same vehicle.
    
*   #### Do you offer birthday tickets?
    
    Birthday discounts are available for those born on October 23–26. Contact us via [**this form**](https://www.earthfrequency.com.au/contact-us) with "Birthday Ticket" in the subject line to organise your ticket.
    
*   #### Is there a discount or special tickets for local residents of the festival area?
    
    Yes, we offer discounted day tickets for local residents. If your photo ID shows proof of residence at Woodford 4514, Bellthorpe 4514, or Cedarton 4514, you can purchase a single day ticket for $80 at the front gate box office. Camping is not included and you must park your vehicle as instructed at the front gate and walk in to the festival ground for the day..
    
*   #### What happens if the festival is postponed or canceled – will tickets be refunded or carried over?
    
    If the festival is postponed or canceled, tickets remain valid for the rescheduled dates. Refunds are not offered for personal circumstances or poor weather.
    
*   #### Who do I contact if I have ticketing issues or questions?
    
    [**Click here to contact us directly**](https://www.earthfrequency.com.au/contact-us) and someone will be in touch. For ticketing-specific questions, you may also seek support through [**Humanitix**](https://events.humanitix.com/earth-frequency-festival-2026/tickets) or [**Tixel**](https://tixel.com/au/music-tickets/2026/10/23/earth-frequency-festival-2026), the platforms we use for ticket sales and resales, respectively.
    
*   #### What if I lose my wristband during the festival – can it be replaced?
    
    Do not remove your wristband! If your wristband is too loose, tighten it. If it is too tight, go to the Info Booth for a replacement.
    
*   #### Will there be a Bus service?
    
    Yes. Details of the EFF Express shuttle are [**here**](https://www.earthfrequency.com.au/eff-express-shuttle).
    
*   #### What are the transport options from Brisbane, Gold Coast, or the nearest train station?
    
    You can catch a Queensland Rail train to Caboolture Station and taxi/rideshare to the festival site. We also offer the EFF Express shuttle bus service. Details on the EFF Express will be announced soon.
    
*   #### If I’m getting dropped off or using rideshare, is there a designated drop-off point?
    
    Drop off is at the front gate of the festival. We do not have a designated area.
    
*   #### Can I arrive by campervan or RV – are there passes or special parking for them?
    
    Yes. An RV/Caravan Pass or Camper Trailer Pass is required to enter the site, plus an appropriate vehicle pass for any towing vehicles. Deluxe RV/Caravan plots (100 m² with 15 A power) are now sold out, however there may be limited options for resale available via our ticket reseller Tixel.
    
*   #### Will there be roadside police alcohol and drug testing?
    
    Yes. You should assume that the police will be testing drivers both on the way to and from the festival.
    
*   #### Will there be Alcohol & Drug Swab Testing available onsite ?
    
    Yes. BMFHQ (formerly Blow Me First) will be offering voluntary alcohol and drug self-testing at Earth Frequency Festival, so you can check yourself before leaving the festival.
    
*   #### When do i need to leave the festival?
    
    All campers — general, deluxe, and Wow Tents — must depart the festival site by midday on Tuesday, October 27.
    
*   #### Am i allowed to bring my pet?
    
    No! There is a strict no pet policy. There are numerous health and safety issues with dogs and cats and other pets at festivals, and our event permit does not allow any animals on site. Please help us make the festival clean and safe for everyone. If you arrive with your pet, you will be turned away. This applies to patrons and crew and artists alike... no exceptions (except Guide Dogs).
    
*   #### When can i arrive at the festival?
    
    Your festival ticket allows entry from 9am on Friday, October 23 onwards. For those who wish to arrive on Thursday, we have a number of camping upgrades available which grant early entry. If you purchase a General Camping Early Entry Pass, a Deluxe Camping plot, an RV/Caravan plot, or a bell tent from Wow Tents, you will be able to enter the festival on Thursday, October 22, from 9am.
    
*   #### Am i allowed to bring alcohol?
    
    The festival will operate on a BYO basis. Earth Frequency has operated with a responsible BYO policy since its first year, with very few alcohol related incidents, and we thank you all for maintaining this positive and responsible approach to alcohol consumption. Please continue to enjoy alcohol in moderation so we can continue to maintain a BYO policy at the festival. We consider a reasonable amount of alcohol for one person over a 4-day period to be up to one carton of cans or one bottle of spirits. Binge Drinking is anti-social and not accepted at Earth Frequency. If any person brings excessive amounts of alcohol, they may be confiscated by our security.
    
*   #### Can I leave the festival site and come back later (pass-outs/re-entry policy)?
    
    Yes. Re-entry (“pass-outs”) is allowed according to gate timelines defined by the festival.
    
*   #### What do I need to bring to enter the festival?
    
    You must bring a printed or electronic ticket, photo ID that matches the ticket name, and any applicable vehicle or camping passes. You may also be subject to bag or vehicle searches.
    
*   #### Is early entry on Thursday available, and how can I get an early entry pass?
    
    Yes. Early Entry for General Camping, Family Camping, and Deluxe Camping allows arrival from 9 am on Thursday, October 22. These are purchased as add-on passes via the camping options on the official site.
    
*   #### What are the gate opening hours each day, and can I arrive late at night?
    
    Our gate opening hours for EFF2026 are as follows:
    
    **THURSDAY:** 9am-12am (Early Entry Pass holders only)
    
    **FRIDAY:** 9am-12am
    
    **SATURDAY:** 9am-12am
    
    **SUNDAY:** 9am-12am
    
    **MONDAY:** 9am-12am
    
*   #### What do I need to have ready at the gate for entry?
    
    You must present a photo ID that exactly matches your ticket name; have your festival ticket (e-ticket or printout) and any vehicle or camping passes; and comply with possible bag or vehicle searches.
    
*   #### What is the process at the gate – will there be security checks or vehicle searches?
    
    Yes. Attendees may be subject to bag, vehicle, or personal searches as part of the entry process in accordance with the festival’s Terms & Conditions.
    
*   #### If I leave with my car, can I re-enter and park again later?
    
    You can leave and re-enter, but you may be required to park in the car park and walk in, depending on the time of day/night and site conditions.
    
*   #### Can I bring gas cookers ?
    
    A decision will be made on gas cookers closer to the event, depending on fire conditions.
    
*   #### Am i allowed to bring glass?
    
    NO! Do not bring any glass bottles as these will be confiscated. Its not hard to do some searching to find your favourite drinks in cans, or to decant the contents of glass bottles in to plastic or steel drink containers. Glass is dangerous to everyone at the festival, including our amazing recycling team and children, so please don't bring any glass.
    
*   #### Can I bring my own generator?
    
    Generators are listed as prohibited items in the festival terms, so they are not allowed.
    
*   #### Are there any prohibited items?
    
    Yes. The following items are strictly prohibited on site: illegal, dangerous or menacing items; mini-bikes or motorised vehicles; glass bottles or containers; pyrotechnics (fireworks, sparklers, flares); generators or sound systems; pets (except guide dogs).
    
*   #### Any tips on essential items to bring for a comfortable festival experience?
    
    EFF suggests bringing appropriate camping gear, shade, water, lighting, and trash bags. Helpful gear includes portable chargers, reusable water bottles, and sturdy tent equipment. For full guidance, check the Camping Advice section on the website.
    
*   #### What is NOT allowed at the event?
    
    Among prohibited items: glass, generators, pets (excluding Guide Dogs), weapons/illegal items, pyrotechnics, mini-bikes, and sound systems.
    
*   #### Can I bring a portable sound system or speakers for my campsite?
    
    Generators and Sound Systems are not allowed in the festival campgrounds. Small iPod docks / portable speakers in campsites are permitted, provided that you are considerate of your neighbours. If you have a portable speaker and you receive a request from the EFF team to turn it down or off, you must comply.
    
*   #### Is there a limit to how much alcohol I can bring?
    
    We consider a reasonable amount of alcohol for one person over a 4-day period to be up to one carton of cans or one bottle of spirits. Binge Drinking is anti-social and not accepted at Earth Frequency. If any person brings excessive amounts of alcohol, they may be confiscated by our security.
    
*   #### Do Wow Tents come with power or charging points?
    
    Power isn’t included by default in Wow Tents. However, you can add a “Power Up” extra for $200 (plus booking fee), specifically for device charging (e.g., phones, lights—but not high-draw appliances like hair dryers).
    
*   #### Where are the Wow Tents located on the festival site, and how close are they to stages or amenities?
    
    Wow Tents are located close to stages and amenities, and always come with nearby communal areas and toilets/showers
    
*   #### What time can I check into my Wow Tent, and when must I check out?
    
    Arrival starts from 9 am on Thursday, October 22, and you must leave the festival by midday on Tuesday, October 27.
    
*   #### Can I share a Wow Tent with friends, and how many people can stay in one?
    
    Yes. Tent types vary by capacity:
    
    • Quad tents sleep 4
    
    • Triple tents sleep 3
    
    • Double tents for 2
    
    • Scouts tent sleeps 1
    
*   #### Can I bring my own bedding or add extra mattresses to a Wow Tent?
    
    Yes. There are “Empty” Wow Tent options (5m or 4m) which allow you to bring your own bedding (BYO), meaning you can supply your own mattress and bedding.
    
*   #### Are Wow Tents secure – can I lock them, or should I bring a padlock?
    
    No, they cannot be locked. Secure your possessions in your car or keep them on you if they are valuable.
    
*   #### Do Wow Tent bookings include festival tickets, or are tickets purchased separately?
    
    No. Festival tickets are purchased separately. A festival ticket is required per person in addition to Wow Tent accommodation.

# **VJS & Multimedia**

**Earth Frequency has long pushed the boundaries of video art, and this year the bar is being raised once again.**

Drawing on the latest vision technology, an A-team of video artists will seamlessly integrate projection mapping, LED walls, stage design, lighting and lasers into a rich visual landscape that evolves with the music.

Rather than operating as a backdrop, our visual program is designed as a responsive, living system. Reactive lighting design, intricate textures and expansive, otherworldly lightscapes unfold in real time, amplifying the emotional and physical impact of each performance.

The result is a fully immersive experience where sound and optics move as one, transforming the dancefloor into a shared cinematic space and heightening the sensory experience across the grounds.

# **MARKET STALLS**

![Two women embracing at an outdoor market stall surrounded by colorful hanging crafts and jewelry.](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/64c1dc237276232628c6fa4b/196c35ea-cd57-4645-a8a9-a076329a99f0/EFF2025_caitlin_denise_photography_-92.jpg)

The Earth Frequency Market Place sits at the heart of the festival and serves as a vibrant hub for food and drink, art, fashion, jewellery, crafts and information. Carefully curated artisans and caterers create a rich sensory experience, while the space itself becomes a vibrant, social meeting point, particularly later in the evening once the stages wind down and it’s time to eat, unwind and reconnect with friends.

Food and drink stall selections prioritise high-quality, healthy options, with a wide range of choices catering to all dietary requirements. Locally based, handmade, recycled, and ethically produced wares are given preference through the vendor selection process, ensuring the Market Place reflects Earth Frequency’s core values and offers something genuinely distinctive. Earth Frequency also provides a number of free or significantly discounted stall spaces to environmental groups and local charities we actively support.

Each year, the Earth Frequency Market Place continues to grow in quality and diversity, and for many attendees, it is a highlight of the festival experience. Plan ahead and arrive ready to explore, eat and connect in the vibrant heart of the festival.

## Tickets and Car Passes

### [How much are tickets?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

The ticket prices for this year’s Woodford Folk Festival can be found on the [Ticket Prices page](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/ticket-prices/). 

Terms and conditions, including booking and infrastructure fees are found on that page too.

[![](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/ticket-prices-revised.jpg)](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/ticket-prices-revised/)

### [How can I buy tickets?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

All tickets are to be purchased online using your Mastercard or Visa Card or Visa/Master Card Debit Card from the  [Tickets page](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/tickets/). 

If you prefer, you can call our office on 07 5496 1066 between 9am and 5pm AEST Monday to Friday and we will process your purchase over the phone. A credit or debit card will be required for all phone transactions, and will be processed on our secure online website. 

### [What is a day ticket?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

If you purchase a Day ticket, it will be valid just for one day of the festival. It allows you entry from 8.00am on the day of your ticket, until the end of the programme that night/early morning (approx. 2am). If you’d like to participate in any of the early morning activities, such as 6am yoga, you’ll need a Season ticket. 

### [What is a season ticket?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

A Season ticket is valid for all 6 days of the festival, 27 Dec – 1 Jan. 

Season with Camping ticket, you are welcome to come to set up on 26 Dec and depart on 2 Jan.

Tickets cannot be shared between people.

### [Do I need know the specific day I want to attend, before purchasing a day ticket?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Yes, you will need to purchase a ticket for a specific day however you can change the day of your ticket by contacting the office on 07 5496 1066. If exchanging your ticket for another day, there are booking fees payable for exchanging tickets.

### [Are there multi-day tickets?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

If you would like to come for more than one day you will need to purchase multiple Day tickets.

### [How do I access or make changes to my tickets?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Your tickets will land in your inbox from [**woodfordia@flicket.io**](mailto:woodfordia@flicket.io). Look for the _‘**Manage your tickets’**_ link at the bottom of that email to add extras to your booking. For other information on the festival, skip over to our [website](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/).

Need to rename or send your tickets to friends? Use the _‘**Access your tickets’**_ link in your email and follow the bouncing ball.

**Important:** Make sure all tickets are named _before_ you arrive. Unnamed tickets can’t be scanned at the gate. Once they’re named, you’ll see a shiny QR code appear — your golden key to the festival.

### [How do I purchase an additional youth ticket?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

To add a Youth, Child or Toddler ticket to your existing order: use the **‘Manage your tickets’** link in your confirmation email from [woodfordia@flicket.io](mailto:woodfordia@flicket.io) log into your customer portal by using the same email on your original booking and you will be able to add minor tickets as your customer portal will recognise that you have already purchased an adult ticket.

### [What dates do the early bird ticket rounds change?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#) 

Early Bird ticket rounds do not end on a specific date. When all the tickets available for each round are sold the next round begins. 

### [I’m on a payment plan. can I make extra one-off payments?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Additional payments are unable to be made.

### [Are there student/pensioner discounts?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

No. We aim to keep our festival tickets prices as low as possible for everyone and provide discounts through the ticket rounds. We also have an extensive volunteering program where people can volunteer for 5 hours per day at the festival in exchange for a festival ticket.  [Apply for a volunteer position](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/get-involved/volunteer/)

### [How do I sell my ticket?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

You can sell your ticket to a family member or friend and change the name on your ticket via your portal. 

You can also sell your ticket via our ticketing company Flicket.

**Important Note**: Only **Adult Season tickets,** **Adult Day tickets, Reserved Camping Area Tickets** and **Vehicle Passes** are eligible for resale via the Flicket Resale page. Other ticket types (including merchandise, powered sites and Youth/Child/Toddler tickets) will appear eligible but cannot be listed or resold, due to our guardian policy.

**To sell your tickets, please follow these steps:**

1.  Open your order confirmation email.
2.  Click **“Manage Your Tickets”** or **“Access Your Tickets.”**
3.  Select the ticket you wish to sell.
4.  Click **“View Ticket.”**
5.  Choose **“Sell”** or **“Transfer/Rename Ticket.”**
6.  Review and agree to the **Terms and Conditions.**
7.  Click **“List Ticket.”**

To purchase a Resale Ticket, please follow the below link:

[**FLICKET RESALE**](https://woodfordia.flicket.io/events/961dc6b5-c2b0-4d21-85d7-8b6981527134/reservation?release=8915ef76-a451-464a-80c0-2607d99605b7)

### [Can I give my ticket away?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Yes. The name on each ticket can be changed by the purchaser. You can do this by clicking **‘manage my tickets’** link in your confirmation email from [woodfordia@flicket.io](mailto:woodfordia@flicket.io)

### [What car pass do I need?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

![](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/New-Car-Pass-Guide-2026.png)

### [If I am sleeping in my car, do I need to buy a parking pass?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Yes.   

You will need to purchase a Sleeping In Vehicle pass, no other car pass is required. [Parking at Woodfordia page](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/parking-at-woodfordia/)  

The sleeping in vehicle pass is available to patrons who hold a festival ticket with camping. 

### [which car pass do I buy if I am staying in Tent City or bell tent camping?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

If you are staying with Bell Tent Camping operated by Bell Tent Village or Tent City (season camping) and want your vehicle in the campgrounds with you, please purchase a vehicle at Campsite pass. Vehicles parked in our long-term carpark require a Day & Long-Term vehicle pass. 

For patrons staying in Tent City overnight campgrounds, please purchase a Long-term Day Vehicle Pass and your vehicle is not permitted in the Season Campgrounds, Tent City will operate a shuttle from the Eastern Bloc Transit Lounge, to and from your accommodation.

### [If I buy a ticket and then get a volunteer position later, will I get a refund?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Unfortunately not, however you can sell your ticket to a family member or friend and change the name on your ticket via your portal. 

You can also sell your ticket via our ticketing company Flicket.

**Important Note**: Only **Adult Season tickets,** **Adult Day tickets, Reserved Camping Area Tickets** and **Vehicle Passes** are eligible for resale via the Flicket Resale page. Other ticket types (including merchandise, powered sites and Youth/Child/Toddler tickets) will appear eligible but cannot be listed or resold, due to our guardian policy.

**To sell your tickets, please follow these steps:**

*   Open your order confirmation email.
*   Click **“Manage Your Tickets”** or **“Access Your Tickets.”**
*   Select the ticket you wish to sell.
*   Click **“View Ticket.”**
*   Choose **“Sell”** or **“Transfer/Rename Ticket.”**
*   Review and agree to the **Terms and Conditions.**
*   Click **“List Ticket.”**
*   Choose **“Sell”** or **“Transfer/Rename Ticket.”**

### [Do I need a camping ticket?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

The answer for most people is yes. If you are planning on staying overnight on site in any form (car, tent, motor home, caravan and Tent City etc) then you will need to purchase a camping ticket.

### [Do I need to purchase a camping ticket if I have a campervan, motor home, caravan or camper trailer?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Yes, you will need to purchase camping tickets.

### [Can I purchase a camping ticket for the night before I want to go to the festival?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

No, we do not offer single night camping tickets.

### [Can I change the day or add camping?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Yes. Please contact us at [ticketing@woodfordia.com](mailto:ticketing@woodfordia.com) to amend your tickets, booking fees for exchanging or amending tickets will apply.

### [Can I get a refund?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

We are sorry to hear that you aren’t able to use your tickets for this year’s festival.

You can sell your ticket to a family member or friend and change the name on your ticket via your portal. 

You can also sell your ticket via our ticketing company Flicket.

**Important Note**: Only **Adult Season tickets,** **Adult Day tickets, Reserved Camping Area Tickets** and **Vehicle Passes** are eligible for resale via the _Flicket Resale_ page. Other ticket types (including merchandise, powered sites and Youth/Child/Toddler tickets) will appear eligible but cannot be listed or resold, due to our guardian policy.

**To sell your tickets, please follow these steps:**

1.  Open your order confirmation email.
2.  Click **“Manage Your Tickets”** or **“Access Your Tickets.”**
3.  Select the ticket you wish to sell.
4.  Click **“View Ticket.”**
5.  Choose **“Sell”** or **“Transfer/Rename Ticket.”**
6.  Review and agree to the **Terms and Conditions.**
7.  Click **“List Ticket.”**

Please note that tickets are **non-refundable** for the reasons outlined below. These conditions are also detailed in your [terms & conditions](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/terms-and-conditions/):

*   If you (the patron) arrive late or leave the event early for any reason.
*   Change of mind or change in personal circumstances.
*   Adverse weather conditions before or during the event.
*   Any alterations to event programming.
*   COVID-19 or COVID-19–related symptoms.
*   Common or temporary illnesses that do not require hospitalisation.
*   Refund considerations apply **only** to situations directly impacting the **primary ticket holder**. Circumstances affecting third parties (e.g., friends, family, or other non-ticket holders) are not eligible for refund consideration.
*   Booking fees are non-refundable

If you believe your situation constitutes **exceptional circumstances** and would like to proceed with a refund request, please continue below.

**To continue with a refund request, please fill out this [FORM.](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/forms/refunds)**

Refund applications close on 28 FEB.

### [Can I purchase a camping ticket for the 25th or 26th of December if I do not have a season ticket?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

No, camping on the 25th and 26th of December is only available to season ticket holders. Season ticket holders will need to purchase Christmas Day Camping tickets prior to arriving on site as they will not be able to be purchased at the Gate.

### [Do you offer payment plans?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Yes, we do! — we’ve got flexible payment plans available to make it easier to join the fun at Woodford Folk Festival! Head over to our Buy Tickets page to secure your payment plan today!

With a one-off $30 admin fee, you can choose to pay weekly, fortnightly, or monthly, depending on what works best for you. This round of pricing applies to the tickets currently on sale.

️ Important dates to remember:

*   Payment Plan sign-up closes: _31st October at 11:59PM_
*   All instalments must be completed by: _28th November at 11:59PM_

After the cut-off, we won’t be able to take on any new payment plan orders, so make sure you get in early if you’d like to take advantage of this option.

### [What is Mobtix?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

For the 2026/27 Festival, we’re proud to offer our First Nations Ticket Programme, designed to support access and create additional opportunities for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, as well as Māori, Pasifika, and Global First Nations communities, to join us at the Festival. 

#### Why should I register?  

This programme provides a dedicated allocation of tickets for First Nations peoples, both here on Country and internationally. 

#### What are the perks? 

To purchase at a reduced rate of 40% off our gate prices. 

MobTix applies to the ticket cost only. Any extras such as food, beverages, transport, or other add-ons are not included and will incur additional charges, along with standard booking fees. 

#### Who can apply? 

MobTix is available to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people from Australia, as well as Māori, Pasifika, and First Nations people from other countries. 

When will tickets be available to purchase? 

All tickets in this allocation are limited and released on a first-come, first-served basis and registrations will close at **5pm 19th December 2026.**

#### How do I apply? 

*   Complete this [REGISTRATIONS FORM](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/forms/mobtix) 
*   **\*Mobtix Ticket sales will not be released for sale until later in the year.**  
     

#### How will I know I’ve been accepted into the Programme? 

Once reviewed, you will receive an email from our team on how to redeem your discounted Festival tickets. 

Our First Nations Engagement Team may contact you to discuss your application further, if required.  

Once approved, you will receive an email with instructions on how to redeem your tickets along with a link to our Mobtix ticketing page. 

## Festival entry process

Generally no. We would encourage youth who have ID to bring as they may be required to show proof of age.

### [What time can I start queueing for Christmas Day?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

For patrons who have purchased an 8am entry ticket, you are able to queue from 2pm on 24th December, no earlier.

For patrons with a 1pm entry ticket, you are able to queue from 11am on 25th December, no earlier.

Patrons who arrive earlier than the allocated queue times will be turned away by security.

28th December – 1st January: 7am – 2pm each day. Located next to the Happy Campers office in the overnight campgrounds.

### [I’m camping multiple nights, how do I get my next day’s wristband?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

## Camping

### [Can I camp in Season Camping if I have an overnight ticket?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

**Family and friends wishing to camp in the Season Campgrounds with and overnight camping ticket are subject to the following terms;**

*   Ensure you have purchased your festival tickets first. 
*   Then scan the QR code to secure your One Night Stand tickets ( 4 maximum)
*   There are a maximum of 4 people only permitted to camp with season camping patrons in the season campgrounds.
*   Overnight guests may only camp in the existing season camping footprint, meaning that the overnight guests cannot add tents, vans or swags to the campground, they may camp with you inside your van, tent or awning area.
*   The overnight guests are not permitted to bring their vehicles into the season campgrounds. Overnight guests will be required to catch a shuttle from the Eastern Bloc Transit Lounge to the Season Campgrounds.
*   Each overnight guest will need to have a One Night Stand ticket, which can be scanned at the Drive-Through Wristbanding gate in exchange for a One Night Stand wrsitband in order to access the Season Campgrounds.
*   If the overnight guests are staying for multiple nights, they will receive their wristband for the following day via the Happy Campers Office in the Season Campgrounds (opposite Lake Gkula).  This ticketing office will operate from the 28 DEC – 1 JAN from 8:00AM-1:00PM each day.
*   A shuttle bus will operate regularly between the Transit Lounge on the Eastern Bloc and the Season Campgrounds (Butterfly Walk) from 27 DEC – 2 JAN, transporting patrons from the car park to the Season Campgrounds.
*   Family or friends on day tickets without camping are not permitted to visit season campers at their campsite, this is only available to guests that hold a day with camping ticket and have their names submitted via the online form on our website.
*   If the overnight guests are sleeping in their vehicle as part of their camping setup, they will not be able to join you in the Season Campgrounds.
*   **[BOOK YOUR ONE NIGHT STAND ENTRY](https://woodfordia.flicket.io/events/7a495a35-5f8f-4767-bd19-b2336104e71b)**  
    

![](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/DIGITAL-COPY-4.png)

### [Can I bring my campervan, motor home, caravan or camper trailer to the festival?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Yes you can.

### [Are campsites allocated in the campgrounds?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

No, campsites are not allocated. We operate on a first in first served basis. We have plenty of room for everyone.

### [Can I bring my car into the campgrounds?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Yes. You will need to purchase a Vehicle Pass. For details on the types of Vehicle Passes, only one vehicle is permitted per campsite. Please refer to the  [Parking at Woodfordia page](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/prepare/parking-at-woodfordia/) 

### [What time must I vacate my site if I am camping overnight?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

10am the following day. Your ticket does not allow access to the Festival precinct the morning of your departure. 

### [Can my friends with day passes visit me in Season Camping?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

No they can’t visit you in your campground.

### [Can somebody help me set up my camp without a wristband/ticket?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Yes.  We allow a 2 hour temporary access for camp set up and/or pack down.  The non ticket holder will be required to pay a $50 deposit that will be refunded on proof of departure within the allotted time frame.  

### [What is your ‘no tarps down’ policy?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#) 

Patrons who set up on Christmas Day are not permitted to place down tarps to reserve an area for friends or family arriving at a later time.  **Any tarps found laid out onsite will be removed and held by Woodfordia.** 

### [Can I bring a generator?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#) 

Generators are not permitted.

### [What do I need to bring with me to my campsite?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

We’ve partnered with Camping Buddy if you need some support on the best things to bring with you as well as how to leave the campsite as beautiful as you found it. Learn more here – [www.campingbuddy.com.au/](http://www.campingbuddy.com.au/)

### [Christmas Day camping](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Season campers can arrive on Christmas Day for an extra cost. Head to our ticketing page and choose CHRISTMAS DAY ACCESS.  

If you are booked with Tent City, Bell Tent Camping or Woodfordia Glamping Tents, your accommodation will not be available on Christmas Day.

### [What is a reserved camping area?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

The reserved camping area is an optional add on for patrons who hold a season with camping ticket.  

We reserve you a 8mx10m campsite in the season camping area, this area should accommodate your campsite, awning and vehicle.  If friends or family have also paid for a reserved camping area ticket and you wish to camp together, you must arrive together as these sites are on a come first, come serve basis. Patrons wishing to arrive on Christmas Day will need to purchase a Christmas Day entry ticket in addition to their reserved camping area and season with camping tickets. 

Campers or RV’s that exceed the allocated size of 10m in length will need to advise our office on 07 5496 1066. 

### [I want to know more about your powered sites.](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

**Powered sites are an optional add-on and available to patrons with a Season with Camping ticket only.** This year we are offering designated powered sites located within the main festival season campgrounds.

This year there will be 2 options available, a smaller or larger powered site offered across 4 different locations in the Season Campgrounds.

**Large Powered Sites** – 8mx10m

**Small Powered sites** – 6mx8m and 6mx6m (Outer Barcoo Campground)

*   Parklands Campground
*   Butterfly Valley Campground
*   Outer Barcoo Campground (Greenzone)
*   Strawberry Fields Campground (Greenzone)

**What is Greenzone Camping?**

This year, we’re excited to trial a new initiative with a Greenzone camping area, featuring powered sites supported by battery-assisted generators. The aim of the trial is to help reduce our overall carbon footprint and emissions, while also creating a quieter camping experience through reduced overnight generator noise.

As part of our ongoing commitment to sustainability and improving the festival experience, this trial will allow us to test new power solutions as we continue exploring more environmentally conscious camping options.

**Important Information:**

*   Powered Sites are suitable for caravans, camper trailers, and RVs. Just a heads-up: we are unable to provide power to tents due to safety.
*   There’s no water hookup at the powered sites, so please make sure your tanks are full before you arrive.
*   You’ll find your site in the Season Campgrounds, right on the main festival grounds—so you’ll be close to all the action.
*   After collecting your wristband and vehicle pass from the Eastern Bloc Drive-Through Gates, head to your allocated site in the Season Campgrounds and set up within the marked space. Make sure your Powered Site pass is clearly visible on the front of your vehicle so our crew can easily confirm your booking.
*   Don’t forget to bring a power lead that’s at least 25 metres long.
*   We support both 10AMP and 15AMP connections.
*   All leads must be tested and tagged before arrival to meet safety requirements.

For Powered Site maps, please visit our [Camping at Woodfordia](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/camping-at-woodfordia/) page.

Workshop bookings open online when the Programme is launched in mid-October. See the  [Workshops page](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/workshops/)  for more information.

## Accessibility

### [How do I apply for a companion ticket?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

We understand that equal access can sometimes mean being accompanied by a carer. Thus, we offer complimentary carer/companion tickets on an individual-needs basis.  

To apply for a complimentary companion card ticket, please complete the [form](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/forms/companion-card). 

_Please ensure that the person requiring a companion has purchased their festival ticket prior to completing this form_.

### [Can I bring my assistance animal?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

We also welcome **Assistance Animals** and encourage you to register your Assistance Animal prior to attending the festival. To help us support you and your Assistance Animal on site, we have an **application and registration process** for Guide Dogs, Hearing Dogs and trained Assistance Animals to be allowed onto the festival site. [Please pre-book using the following form.](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/forms/assistance-animal)

### [How do I apply for accessible camping?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

The festival has a designated accessible camping area situated close to the entertainment precinct entrance available for season and overnight campers with accessibility needs. A small number of camping sites have access to power for a subsidised fee of $100, and all have access to accessible shower and toilet facilities. These camping sites are limited and must be pre-booked using the following form. 

[WFF Accessible Camping Form](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/forms/accessible-camping) 

### [I need to refrigerate medication at the festival, where can I store it?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Our festival paramedics can store your medication in a fridge for the festival duration. 

  Please note:  Whilst every care is taken to ensure medication is kept cold, Woodfordia Ltd is not liable for power outages or fluctuation of fridge temperature.  

### [How do I find more information on accessibility at the festival?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Please visit our [accessibility page](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/prepare/accessibility/) for information on the festival.  Alternatively, you can call one of our team on 07 5496 1066 to answers any of your questions. 

### [Are your shuttle buses accessibility friendly?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Yes they are. If you are camping in our overnight campgrounds, all of our shuttle buses are fitted with wheelchair ramps and a lift. 

Wheelchair accessible buses are available by request from the Transit Lounge at the Eastern Bloc and Welcome Gate for entry to the festival and back to the parking area. 

Accessible buses are also available to assist patrons to and from the accessible camping area. 

### [Do you offer a buggy service at the festival for people with mobility issues?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Yes, we absolutely do. Please see the Access Support team on arrival, located in the accessible season campground office to discuss and arrange your buggy transport during your stay. 

### [I am unable to wear a wristband, what are my options?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

We understand that many people are unable to wear wristbands for several reasons. We have the option for an _‘Excusable Wristband Pass’._ Please ask the Access Support team at the Solutions Tent when you arrive. 

### [Do you offer hidden disability sunflower lanyards?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Yes, the Woodford Folk Festival recognises the Hidden Disability Sunflower. Patrons are able to collect theirs from the Access Support desk at the Solutions tent, Access Support office in the Season Campgrounds and Infology.

## General information

### [How do I pay for things at the festival?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

EFTPOS will be accepted throughout the festival.  Some outlets will accept cash. 

**Please note, our bars accept cards only.**  

ATMs are conveniently located throughout the festival precinct.

### [Where can I find ATM’s?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

ATM’s, which accept most foreign cards and AMEX, are located throughout the precinct (see map for locations). There are no travellers cheque facilities available on site.

### [How do I charge my phone at the festival?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Some bars across the festival precinct will have charging stations. 

The Power Up tent is located in the General Store precinct, where you can charge your mobile phone, camera, and laptop batteries.  Power banks will be available for rent or purchase. 

### [Where and how often do the shuttle buses run?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

\*Eastern Bloc refers to the location of our drive-through wristbanding gate location and long- term car park area – East of the festival site, along Woodrow Rd.  Shuttle bus timetable can be found [here.](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/festival-entry-information/25-26-shuttle-timetable/)

*   Eastern Bloc to Season Campgrounds 
*   Eastern Bloc to Overnight Campgrounds  
*   Eastern Bloc to Main Festival Entrance Gate  
*   Main Festival Entrance Gate to Overnight Campgrounds 
*   Season Campground Loop to Festival Precinct  
*   Shuttle buses run frequently throughout the event, depending on the time of day you can expect shuttles to run every 10-15min during peak times.  

We have multiple accessibility equip shuttles to accommodate for guests with mobility issues and for wheelchairs.  

### [Can I bring my kids trolley on the shuttle bus?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Yes you can bring your trolley on the shuttle buses.

### [What is Woodfordia citizenship?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Woodfordia Citizenship is an annual membership to access all things Woodfordia. It entitles a member to access the Woodfordia Citizen’s Portal, invitations to Citizen’s Day gatherings and Programme Launch party, and quarterly editions of the Lore Society journal. To find out more, visit [woodfordia.org](https://woodfordia.org/woodfordia/become-a-citizen/). 

### [How would the festival deal with an event like a bush fire?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Our event management plan includes a detailed safety, emergency and incident management plan that meets the strict requirements outlined in by Workplace Health and Safety Act, Safety Regulation Act and Risk Management Standard AUS/NZ.  

During the festival we have 24/7 personnel in Fire First Response, Qld Police, Paramedics, Qld Fire and Emergency Services, and security along with festival organisers and staff. An Emergency Communication Centre (ECC) operates 24/7 during the festival to facilitate communications between these services.  The patron hotline number (printed on the festival wristband) is the first point of call for any emergency onsite and is responded to by ECC. ECC will co-ordinate timely and appropriate responses to all incidents reported. Incidents will be escalated according to their severity. 

If an evacuation is required, this will be coordinated in conjunction with Qld Police, Qld Fire and Emergency Services and festival organisers. Information will be communicated to our patrons in person, via text alerts, social media and through our PA systems. 

_Current bushfire information via_: [www.ruralfire.qld.gov.au](http://www.ruralfire.qld.gov.au/) 

_Moreton Alert for free SMS, email and voice alerting system_ – [www.moretonbay.qld.gov.au](http://www.moretonbay.qld.gov.au/) 

### [Do I need to be vaccinated to attend?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Current government guidelines do not require patrons to be vaccinated to attend.   

Woodfordia will follow any guidelines outlined by the government in relation to mandates as they are set out. 

### [Can I bring my pet?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Woodfordia is a wildlife haven and we do not allow domestic animals on-site. As we are a recreational and conservation habitat, we ask that you leave your pets at home unless they are accredited assistance animals. To let us know you’re bringing your Seeing Eye Dog, Mind Dog or other Assistance Animal please complete the [Assistance Animal Form](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/forms/assistance-animal) in the site or contact our office directly regarding this. 

### [Can I bring my camera?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

You may take photos outside the precinct (campsite) with a professional camera but we do not allow patrons to bring their professional cameras (DSLRs and other) into the precinct. This is because we have a team of professional videographers and photographers already onsite and we keep these to a minimum. You are welcome to take photos and videos with your phone. Thanks for understanding.

### [Can I bring my e-bike or e-scooter?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Yes, e-bikes and e-scooters must adhere to the same speed limits as vehicles on Site and are not permitted in the Festival precinct.

### [How do I access AA services?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

The AA tent is located next to the Access Support tent in the Season Campgrounds and provides a safe, supportive space for anyone struggling with alcohol addiction to talk with someone.

Meetings are held daily from 10am–11am. There’s no need to book in advance, simply come along and join the group.

Day visitors: If your wristband type doesn’t allow access to the Season Campgrounds, visit Infology and let our team know you’d like to access AA. They’ll provide you with a temporary wristband, allowing you to enter the Season Campgrounds and attend the AA meetings.

## Accommodation

### [Why do I need to buy a festival ticket with camping if I book with Tent City, bell tent village or glamping tents?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Yes, you will need to purchase a festival ticket **with camping** to be able to book into Tent City, Bell Tent Village and Woodfordia Glamping Tents.

While your accomodation with Tent City, Bell Tent Village or Glamping tents includes your ‘accommodation’ and set up, the **camping** component of the festival ticket helps cover essential infrastructure and services that make the campground experience possible – including power, water, sewage, waste management, road access and general site maintenance during the event.

### [Where is Tent City accommodation located?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Tent City Accommodation is located within the festival Season Campgrounds.

We’re excited to share that Overnight Tent City is now conveniently located within the Season Campgrounds once again. This new location makes it easier than ever to access the festival.  
You will collect your wristband from the Drive-through Wristband Gates on your first day, if staying multiple nights, you can pick up your wristbands for the following day directly from the Tent City reception office.  
Overnight Tent City ticket holders won’t be able to park in the Season Campgrounds. But don’t worry! You can grab a Long-Term Day Vehicle Pass to get temporary access and drop your gear off right at your tent. After that, hop on the shuttle**,** running between the Eastern Bloc Transit Lounge and your cozy campsite—it’s a smooth and easy ride to your home away from home.

If staying for more than one day, collect your following days wristband from the Tent City Ticketing Office – 28 DEC – 1 JAN, 8:00AM till 1:00PM each day.

### [Can I stay in my festival accommodation on Christmas Day?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

Bell Tent Village, Tent City and Woodfordia Glamping tent accommodation are not available on the 25th Dec.

### [How do I register my interest in a Woodfordia glamping tent?](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/faqs/#)

**Glamping tents for the 2026/27 festival are SOLD OUT.**  
**Glamping tents for the 2027/28 will go on sale at the beginning of March 2027 via our [Accommodation page.](https://woodfordfolkfestival.com/info/accommodation/)**
