### What rules apply to vehicles used to bring food to the market??

If you use a vehicle to handle meat, dairy, smallgoods or poultry (animal products\] as your business and not simply as part of a catering operation you have to register your vehicle with NSW Food.

All vehicles used to transport food must:

*   Protect the food they are carrying from contamination and be designed and constructed to ensure that food contact surfaces can be cleaned and, if necessary, sanitised.
*   OR
*   The food's own packaging must protect the food from contamination.
*   OR
*   Containers used to carry and/or transport the food must protect the food from contamination and be designed to ensure that food contact can surfaces be cleaned and, if necessary, sanitised.

[Return to question list](https://www.organicfoodmarkets.com.au/FAQs#top)

### What special measures should I take if I want to use a deep fat fryer on the market??

There are good reasons why deep fat fryers are not commonly seen on markets. There are documented cases of sever injury being sustained from not just improper use but poor deployment of these devices.

In addition to this the electrical requirements of deep fat fryers often exceed that available at market sites. If you have to use a deep fat fryer buy a gas one. Please do not assume we can power electrical unit. If you do have an electric unit remember you must bring mats to manage any trip risks from trailing wires.

Beyond that set out above, if you are using a deep fat fryer you must comply with the following points:

*   Follow manufactures instructions and safety guild lines as set out in the documentation provided with the appliance.
*   Must have at least one 4.5 kg ABE fire extinguisher and one large fire blanket on the stall and quickly accessible at all times.
*   Deep fat fryers must be used only on weighted tables or installed as a fixture in a larger piece of equipment (stainless steel bench, side or table).
*   A weighted table is one with 20kg of weight attached to either end of the table in a secure manner.
*   Must carry extra first aid burn supplies and have them located in the stall during operation, for example https://www.thefirstaidshopau.com.au/product/burn-kit-large-2/
*   You must bring cat littler with you to help mop up any oil spins plus a dust pan and brush to brush it up.

In addition to fire/burning hazards deep fat fryers also need to be sheltered from rain as hot oil reacts badly to water.

[Return to question list](https://www.organicfoodmarkets.com.au/FAQs#top)

### Where can I park?

Normally you can park on site, and often a trading pitch will be available behind which you can park your vehicle. No parking on site is available at Hornsby, or Kings Cross. Multi story parking is available at all Mall locations and we have negotiated special low cost deals for standard vehicles at the last two sites.

### Will other traders selling similar goods/services be allowed to the market??

Australian Law endeavors to prohibit agreements to restrict market access, reduce competition and create exclusive dealing agreements. We operate in an open competitive system and all businesses must recognise and accept this.

In consequence we cannot offer exclusive arrangements or other measures to stop market access. We do try and balance the range of stalls at the market but no trader should expect new competition to be excluded at the market.

# About Us

## Mission Statement

At Organic Food Markets, our mission is to connect farmers, makers and creators with local communities. We strive to offer the best weekly shopping experiences that nourish your belly and your soul. Some of Australia's most loved food brands have launched in our markets, and we pride ourselves on providing entrepreneurs with a low-risk environment to launch their businesses, refine their products and follow their dreams.

## Contact Details

*   Phone: 02 9999 2226
*   Fax: 02 9999 2240
*   Email: [office@organicfoodmarkets.com.au](mailto:office@organicfoodmarkets.com.au)
*   Address: Suite 3, Level 1, 1741 Pittwater Road, Mona Vale 2103

## Open Door Policy

Markets are central to human interaction. We believe it is important for markets to allow politicians to attend freely and openly during election times and canvas support. Our markets follow this policy.

## Complaints

Complaints can be lodged by following this [link](https://www.organicfoodmarkets.com.au/Complaints).

## Local First Opportunity Policy

Organic Food Markets is committed to supporting local businesses and strengthening the communities in which its markets operate.

When a suitable vacancy arises, preference will, where practicable and subject to maintaining an appropriate market mix, be given to applicants whose principal place of business is located within the Local Government Area in which the market operates.

In assessing applications, Organic Food Markets will consider locality alongside other relevant factors including product quality, uniqueness, market demand, reliability, presentation, compliance history, sustainability practices and the overall balance and diversity of the market.

Where no suitable local applicant is available, or where market objectives would be better served, Organic Food Markets will appoint the applicant who best meets the needs of the market.

## Credit Card Refund Policy

Credit card charges for stalls will be refunded if we are given notice of cancellation by email seven days before the event and we can relet the stall space. Charges are not refundable for any cancellations later than seven days before an event or for bad weather on the day, breakdown on the way to the event or similar reasons or for advanced rent paid by Permanent stallholders.

## Privacy Policy

This website is operated by Organic Food Markets. We conform to the requirements of the [Australian National Privacy Principles](https://www.organicfoodmarkets.com.au/npp.pdf)

We have no intention of sharing any information provided by you save as required by law (such as the lodgement of food papers with local councils, or confirmation of your public liability insurance) or for the completion of transactions (such as providing your credit card number to our bank).

If you have any questions relating to our policy, or what we do with information or you believe we may have wrong information about you and wish to correct is plase email: [privacy@organicfoodmarkets.com.au](mailto:privacy@organicfoodmarkets.com.au?subject=Privacy%20Matters)

## Security Policy

All information provide by you which is kept in an electronic form is kept behind password protected barriers and any highly sensitive information, such as your passwords or credit card numbers are only kept in an encrypted form.

## makers market 2024

6th - 8th December

Hobart Town Hall,

Launch Event & preview - Friday Dec 5pm – 8pm

Saturday 7th Dec & Sunday 8th Dec 9am– 4pm

​

The designedmade Makers Market features some of Tasmania’s best designers, artists  and makers. There is a collective approach to sustainable practices and the retention of traditional manufacturing in the production of works that are both skilful and innovative. 

​

The designedmade Makers Market is held upstairs in the ballroom of the gracious and historic Hobart Town Hall on the corner of Macquarie and Elizabeth Streets.

The market is now in it’s tenth year in this location and includes the works of more than 30 makers across furniture, jewellery, ceramics, textiles, leather print and more who have created sculptural and functional objects for the home and to wear.

To celebrate the 10 year anniversary, the event this year will also include a stand-alone exhibition of pieces from our members that explore how their practice has developed over the last decade, how new skills, materials and processes have changed their practice, and how many things just take time.

​

There will be lots to see and purchase from a mix of past exhibitors and new faces including Andrea Barker, A Published Event, Artosaurus, Catherine Rogers, Christine Hannan, David and Michelle Rauenbusch, Duncan Meerding, Emily Snadden, Kate Bowman, Kathleen George, Kiyomi Reid, Leigh Rigozzi, Linda Chee, Linda Fredheim, Lisa Britzman, Mark Aheimer, Murray Jessup, Natalie Bennet, Olivia Hickey, Paul Allen, Penny Malone, Prue Quarmby,  Rengin Guner, Svend Madsen, Till Julien, and Zsolt Faludi, as well as coffe and other drinks and snack from the the Cutest Coffee Van

​

The event kicks off with drinks and nibbles on Friday night at the launch event at 5.00pm.

​

## about us

designedmade inc is a not-for-profit group based in Hobart providing members with a platform to showcase their work and network with other designers and organisations

​

Its mission is to inspire, connect and represent Tasmanian designers

​

The aims of designedmade inc. are to encourage and develop initiative in relation to

*   Increasing public awareness
    
*   Innovative practice
    
*   Co-operation and Communication between designers
    
*   Professionalism and best practice
    
*   Increase work opportunities
    
*   Design Education
    
*   Professional Development
    

​

The group was established in Tasmania in 1995 by a group of furniture designers and designer-makers, mostly  graduates from the Furniture Design program at the University of Tasmania, and was formerly known as the furniture designers association. Over the last 20 years the group has evolved and now includes members working in a range of practices including jewellery, ceramics, printmaking, textiles as well as furniture and wood. In 2015 the name was changed to better reflect the membership.

designedmade inc provides a network and information service to its members and supports marketing of products and design services, through co-operative ventures such as [exhibitions and other projects.](http://fda.com.au/exhibitions.htm) 

​

As an organisation, we are committed to fostering sustainable design practices among our members, encouraging artists and designers to approach their creative work in ways that minimize environmental impact throughout the entire lifecycle of an artwork — from concept and creation to display and beyond - see our [sustainability statement](https://www.designedmade.com.au/_files/ugd/b575aa_d6c3b99ff17849afbe02b475db6bcc35.pdf) for more info

​

We welcome artists and designers who use the craft techniques of woodwork, ceramics, glass, textiles, jewellery, metalworking, leatherwork etc to produce one-off or limited run production pieces and/or design objects to be produced using a range of craft and other manufacturing methods

​

We meet monthly (usually on the 1st Wednesday). Meetings venues and time are posted on our [events page](https://www.designedmade.com.au/events). All members are welcome to attend and contribute to planning and management of our events and activities.

​

​

## interplay

5th Aug – 4th September 2021

Moonah Arts Centre,

Open Tuesday - Friday 10am - 5pm Saturday 10am - 4pm

​

We started thinking about this exhibition late in 2019 around the theme of interplay - the operation or effect that two or more things have on each other, an interaction. Plans were made for studio visits, the sharing of ideas,  collaborations, and working at different scales to current practice. And then as the events of 2020 developed, most of those ideas got thrown out of the window, as uncertainty descended.

​

It quickly became apparent that our exhibition scheduled for mid 2020 was looking unlikely, with everyone's energy focused elsewhere, and interactions discouraged. Fortunately Moonah Arts Centre allowed us to reschedule our exhibition to 2021.

​

Somehow the extra time and more time alone in the studio has led to a different body of work. A questioning of why we make and what drives the process. A refining of fundamental ideas and a recognition of how inspiration and the interplay of ideas drives creativity. Can a process be the finished work? What happens when a familiar technique or material is used in an different way? Can an experience be recreated in an object?

​

16 of our members have developed new work over the last 12 months for the exhibition, sharing ideas and reflections to produce a diverse range of design and craft objects exploring the interplay between materials, process, form, function and imagination.

## Minimal Hassles

An underground wunderland built for the singular purpose of hosting the Time Of Your Life.

Featuring a Supernatural Amphitheatre, free range camping, BYO everywhere, permanent showers and composting toilets, abundant food stalls, [camping gear hire](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/get-prepared/camping-gear-hire/), and much much more.

## Plenty of Tassels

All singing, all dancing on the same undulation.

More giant spikes of excitement than a quill‑covered monotreme.

The one and only stage, the No Dickhead Policy, The Gift, Sky Show, Meredith Eye and zero commercial messages.

# Lifetime Warranty

Meredith [started in 1991](https://history.mmf.com.au/) as a one-time wig out for a coupla hundred fun-loving friends. So much enjoyment was had that it went down again the next year, and the next, and now, thirty-odd years later, Meredith is primed to happen again, down on the Nolan farm.

Thanks to all the [feedback and ideas](https://feedback.mmf.com.au/) from you and your friends, Meredith self‑propagates.

We guarantee we will continue to listen, fix things if they don’t work, not fix them if they do, and keep on making it all that it should be.

Every ticket includes camping and parking and helps many organisations to [do good things in the district](https://aunty.mmf.com.au/what-goes-on/how-you-help-the-district/).

See you in The Sup’,

# Bangalow Markets, simply stunning

### The Bangalow Market Day is a treat for day trippers, a retreat from the city and the rush of the Gold Coast. Bangalow is a window into another world. Come for the day.

Part of the continuing success of the market is the beautiful Bangalow Showgrounds, where the markets are held at, which are dominated by eleven huge camphor laurel trees which provide welcome shade and rustling leaves and a magic forest atmosphere.

A percentage of the market profit each month is distributed to Bangalow Community Groups on a rotating basis. The market then benefits the whole community and fulfils its role as a community market.

Parking is available in the showgrounds at the Market. Parking fee is $2

100% of market profits goes back into the upkeep, maintenance and improvement of the Bangalow Showgrounds.

![](https://bangalowmarket.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/IMG_0760-scaled.jpg)

![Bangalow Markets - Market Stalls](https://bangalowmarket.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/3-Bangalow-Markets.jpg)

![](https://bangalowmarket.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/2-Bangalow-Markets.jpg)

## A day at the market

The market is right in the middle of town in the showgrounds. If you drive, parking in the streets is a premium but you can park in to the showgrounds themselves right at the market.

Where to start and which way to go…the market pathways wind around between trees and follow lanes. Sights, sounds and smells are all catered for, the aroma of foods and perfumes, entertainers, bands and the colourful stall after stall beckoning down the path.

A local band (a different one each market) provide entertainment as you sit under the dappled shade of the leopard trees enjoying the offerings from one of the many food stalls.

Buskers perform, conjuring up little unexpected delights that break your concentration from all that’s on show.

You can make it restful or hectic, you can rush or dawdle, come early or late, you can stay for lunch, you can take in the whole village with a walk around or you can sit under a tree but a day at the market will be a Sunday you’ll remember.

Markets for 2026

Bangalow Market is on the 4th Sunday each month and in some months the 4th Sunday is not the last Sunday in the month, and they are marked with an \*.

*   25th January
*   22nd February
*   22nd March\*
*   26th April
*   24th May
*   28th June
*   26th July
*   23rd August\*
*   27th September
*   25th October
*   22nd November\*
*   27th December

Our history

In 1982 Jeff Prichard saw the Bangalow Showgrounds as the perfect location for an outdoor market. Large shady trees, parking space, power and toilet facilities and a community that welcomed the alternative nature and excitement the markets would bring. He organised and cajoled forty stallholders who made up the first market.

Over the years changes and improvements have resulted in a market today that hosts 320+ stalls. Many of the original stalls still exist. The markets are now run by The Bangalow Park Trust, a voluntary community committee, who are responsible for the care and maintenance of the grounds. The Committee operate under the aegis of the Byron Shire Council and Shane Olive has taken over the Manager role after Jeff Pritchard started and ran the Market for 40 years. The market still evolves showcasing new crafts and exotic foods providing a launch pad for entertainment talent. Many of the shops and industries in the Bangalow/Byron Bay region had their genesis as market stalls.

## Home - popup+design+exhibition

​

Waterside Pavilion, Mawson Place Hobart

9th - 17th December

open daily 10am– 4pm

​

Home - inspired by this place is a new venture in a new location from designedmade inc, - a reimagining of their popular makers market formerly held in the Ballroom of the Hobart Town Hall each December.  
  
Part exhibition, part design pop-up, Home features the work of some of Tasmanian best designers and makers working across jewellery, ceramics, glass, textiles, furniture and printmaking to produce a diverse range of sculptural and functional objects for the home and to wear.  
  
There is a collective approach to sustainable practices and the retention of traditional manufacturing in the production of works that are both skilful and innovative, and which also consider the question of how and where we live, can inspire what we make and use.  
  
Meet the artists and learn more about the work on display each day.

# BEAM ME UP

To the astral plains for GP Nineteen.

The  [LineUp](https://goldenplains.com.au/#whos-playing) is out.

Second Round Ballot results will be announced shortly.

Next up is  [Online Sales](https://aunty.goldenplains.com.au/ticket-info/online-sales/) on Wednesday 28 October at 11am (AEDT).

If you’re not already, become a [Subscriber](https://subscribe.goldenplains.com.au/).

![Full width image](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2026/09/GP2027_Photo5.2_ChipMooney.webp?x40798)

# PLAIN OLD FUN

There’s only one type of ticket. Everyone flies first class.

All singing, all dancing across two days and two nights of rarified reverie.

With no commercial sponsors, free range camping, BYO, the No Dickhead Policy, and One Stage that fits all.

# WHO'S PLAYING?

Ears to the ground, fingers on the tracks, to detect and select the latest and greatest.  
Heaven-sent and custom-cut with the right sounds at the right time across day and night.  
Mother nature on the lights.

Geese Underworld Angine de Poitrine Miss Kaninna Peter Garrett & The Alter Egos Tinariwen Haute & Freddy Westside Cowboy Maria Arnal Peach Dove Ellis daine iKeda Orcutt Shelley Miller Swapmeet Maurice Fulton Station Model Violence Salimata Intermood Shock Corridor Immy Owusu Rydeen & SOVBLKPSSY Tongue Dissolver Nono Gigsta All On The One Stage Storytelling With Uncle Barry Silence Is Golden

![Golden Plains XIX](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/themes/msa-gp-2027/images/redesign/lineup-logo.svg)

Geese. Underworld. Angine de Poitrine. Miss Kaninna. Peter Garrett & The Alter Egos. Tinariwen. Haute & Freddy. Maria Arnal. Westside Cowboy. Peach. Dove Ellis. daine. iKeda. Orcutt Shelley Miller. Swapmeet. Maurice Fulton. Station Model Violence. Salimata. Intermood. Shock Corridor. Immy Owusu. Rydeen & SOVBLKPSSY. Tongue Dissolver. Nono Gigsta. Storytelling With Uncle Barry. All On The One Stage.

![Image on the left](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2026/09/GP2027_Oslo_1v3.webp?x40798)

## SIRIUSLY

One of the best places on earth to spend a long weekend, the Meredith Supernatural Amphitheatre is purpose-built for serious fun.

One stage, spacey space, free-range camping, no curfew, no advertising, the Meredith Eye, the Ecoplex Outdoor Cinema, BYO, abundant food stalls and minimal hassles.

## 19TH HOLE

Every ticket assists regional organisations doing great work in the district. At the festival, eating from the Tucker Tent (and then eating again) helps good things happen for many local groups.

We are grateful to the wonderful town of Meredith and surrounding areas who so graciously help host Golden Plains.

![Image on the right](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2026/09/GP2027_Oslo_2v4.webp?x40798)

![Full width image](https://content.mmf.com.au/wp-content/uploads/sites/29/2026/09/GP2027_Photo2_ChipMooney.webp?x40798)

# GOLD  
STAMP

Golden Plains comes stamped with a Lifetime Guarantee. We promise we will continue to listen, fix things if they’re broken, not fix them if they ain’t, and keep on making Golden glow.

[Write to me](mailto:auntym@mmf.com.au) about anything, anytime.

I hope to enjoy the pleasure of your company this March.

# Casual Stallholder Information

October 25th Casual Site applications have closed

Please note that submitting this form is an application only. Casual stalls can be in high demand, and we often receive more applications than we have sites available. We appreciate your interest and thank you for your patience while we work through all applications.

All applicants will be notified by email by the end of Wednesday October 21st with the outcome of their application. Please wait for this email before following up, as we may not be able to confirm anything earlier. The number of sites available for casuals depends on how many permanent stallholders attend each month, and we won’t know final numbers until closer to the market date. 

Each market we have a different number of Casuals who apply selling the same type of product, and in that case, we only take a certain number of those. i.e. it may be a lot of pottery, or skin creams, or jewellery etc. 

Important details for casual applicants:

*   Only standard 3m x 3m stall spaces are available for casuals.
    
*   The fee for a casual site is $50, payable once your place is confirmed.
    
*   Casuals are limited to one site only per market.
    
*   Power is not available for casual stalls, and generators are not permitted under any circumstances.
    
*   Casuals need to apply through this process each month, and you will need to submit a new application each month. Sites are allocated on a month-by-month basis.
    
*   Sending an email asking for a casual site is not an application.
*   Casual Site applications open on Wednesday at 8am after the Market, and you can only apply for the next month’s market.

example –

Market – Sunday August 23rd

casual site applications open – Wednesday August 26th

next Market – September 27th

Applications close 7 days prior to the next market, but may vary depending on number of applicants v number of sites available.

[Stallholder Policy](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1H1705_RJK0aapCrbRmmihxIp_iXQcR9q/view?usp=sharing)

Stallholder Policy

[Stallholder Policy](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1H1705_RJK0aapCrbRmmihxIp_iXQcR9q/view?usp=sharing)

Food site application

This is an application for stallholders for food sites with a food van/truck or marquee who sell Category 1 or 2 food – made onsite

If you sell pre-packaged food, please apply as a Casual stallholder.

There are a limited number of food sites available, if any, at each market. There is limited power and you will only be given a site if someone is away and your requirements make it logistically possible to fit you into said available site.

Once you fill out the application, you will be notified prior to each market if an appropriate site is available and to see if you are able to attend.

[fill out food site application](https://forms.gle/NbEgqsvVq5MMTPX46)

Application for a Permanent site

At various times there are a small number of Permanent sites available to Casual stallholders who have been regular attendees at the Market, and who meet the applicable criteria.

**There are currently no permanent sites available, and the waitlist is long.**

# FAQs

# Byron Beachside Markets

# Stallholders

### I have filled in a new application for the market but haven’t heard back

Please check the IMPORTANT DATES section on the [Become a Stallholder](https://www.byroncentre.com.au/bcm/byron-beachside-market-signup#apply-now) page for the application process.

### I haven’t received my invoice to attend the next market

Please check the IMPORTANT DATES section on the [Become a Stallholder](https://www.byroncentre.com.au/bcm/byron-beachside-market-signup#apply-now) page for the application process.

### I have paid my invoice but don’t have a site number

Please check the IMPORTANT DATES section on the [Become a Stallholder](https://www.byroncentre.com.au/bcm/byron-beachside-market-signup#apply-now) page for the application process.

### Where do I email my updated/current insurance certificate to be updated?

You can email your updated Certificate of Currency to [marketinsurance@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:marketinsurance@byroncentre.com.au) This will then be updated across all our markets.

### Can the market provide me with insurance?

All stallholders are required to provide their own public liability insurance for their business. This can be purchased from several insurance companies such as AAMI, GIO, BizCover, QBE.

### How can I contact market management?

Byron Community Market - Natwah Petruszka[  
communitymarket@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:communitymarket@byroncentre.com.au) / 0499 755 500

Twilight Market - Greg Curry[twilightmarket@byroncentre.com.au /](mailto:twilightmarket@byroncentre.com.au) 0490 058 451

Beachside Market - Greg Curry[  
beachsidemarket@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:beachsidemarket@byroncentre.com.au) / 0490 058 451

# Visitors

### When and where are the markets held?

Byron Beachside Market is held 4 times a year during school holidays in January, April, July & September - along the beach foreshore between Clarkes Beach carpark and Byron Surf Club. Check the [website](https://www.byroncentre.com.au/bcm/byron-beachside-market) for this year’s date.

### Can I bring my dog to the market?

Yes you can! Byron Beachside Market is dog friendly. We do ask that you keep your dog on a leash and clean up after them.

### Will the market be on if it’s raining?

Beachside Market is an all weather market and will go-ahead, rain or shine. If the market is cancelled, announcements are made on our website and social media pages.

### Where is the Market Information / Lost Property / First Aid?

Market Information, first aid and lost property is located in a marquee, opposite Dening Park food court on the beachside.

### How can I contact a stallholder?

Check our [Stallholder Directory](https://www.byroncentre.com.au/bcm/stallholder-directory) for a selection of the stallholders that attend our markets: If the stall you are looking for is not listed, email [marketsadmin@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:marketsadmin@byroncentre.com.au) and we can forward your query on.

### Can I volunteer at the markets?

Absolutely! Volunteering opportunities are often available. Please apply on the [Volunteer](https://www.byroncentre.com.au/bcc/about/volunteer#apply) section of our website.

### Where can I park?

There are paid and unpaid parking areas near the market area. However, it can get busy, so we recommend arriving early to secure a spot. Check the [Byron Council](https://www.byron.nsw.gov.au/Services/Roads-and-parking/Parking/Where-can-I-park-in-the-Byron-Shire) website for a map of parking zones.

### Are credit/debit cards accepted or cash only?

Some stallholders have card payment options, while others may prefer cash only. It is best to bring some cash or access one of the several ATMs located around the site

### What kind of products can I find at the markets?

Beachside Market focuses on local artists, creators and healers at this ‘make it, bake it, sew it, grow it’. Showcasing a diverse and exciting collection of high-quality art, sculptures, ceramics, textiles, glass, homewares, fashion, craft and clothing created by local artisans.

### How can I contact market management?

Byron Community Market - Natwah Petruszka[  
communitymarket@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:communitymarket@byroncentre.com.au) / 0499 755 500

Twilight Market - Greg Curry[twilightmarket@byroncentre.com.au /](mailto:twilightmarket@byroncentre.com.au) 0490 058 451

Beachside Market - Teya Steinberg[  
beachsidemarket@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:beachsidemarket@byroncentre.com.au) / 0490 129 712

#### Haven’t found the answer to your question?

Please send your query to [marketsadmin@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:marketsadmin@byroncentre.com.au)  
Note: all our staff work part time, so please be patient when waiting for a response.

# FAQs

# Byron Twilight Markets

# Stallholders

### I have filled in a new application for the market but haven’t heard back

All our staff work part time. Please allow up to 3  weeks for a response. Spaces are limited and you will only receive a response once we have a site available for you.

### I haven’t received my invoice to attend the next market

An email with a link to pay is sent 1 week prior to each market. Also check your spam/junk folder.

### Where do I email my updated/current insurance certificate to be updated?

You can email your updated Certificate of Currency to [marketinsurance@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:marketinsurance@byroncentre.com.au) This will then be updated across all our markets.

### Can the market provide me with insurance?

All stallholders are required to provide their own public liability insurance for their business. This can be purchased from several insurance companies such as AAMI, GIO, BizCover, QBE.

### How can I contact market management?

Byron Community Market - Natwah Petruszka[  
communitymarket@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:communitymarket@byroncentre.com.au) / 0499 755 500

Twilight Market - Greg Curry[twilightmarket@byroncentre.com.au /](mailto:twilightmarket@byroncentre.com.au) 0490 058 451

Beachside Market - Greg Curry[  
beachsidemarket@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:beachsidemarket@byroncentre.com.au) / 0490 058 451

# Visitors

### When and where are the markets held?

Byron Twilight Market is held every Saturday between 4-9pm in Railway Park. [Map Location](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xwfx7jjsyPerekM88)

### Can I bring my dog to the market?

Yes you can! Byron Twilight Market is dog friendly. We do ask that you keep your dog on a leash and clean up after them.

### Will the market be on if it’s raining?

Twilight Market is an all weather market and will go-ahead, rain or shine. If the market is cancelled, announcements are made on our website and social media pages.

### Where is the Market Information / Lost Property / First Aid?

Market Information, first aid and lost property is located in the markets office in Railway Park, next to The Rails pub.

### How can I contact a stallholder?

Check our [Stallholder Directory](https://www.byroncentre.com.au/bcm/stallholder-directory) for a selection of the stallholders that attend our markets: If the stall you are looking for is not listed, email [marketsadmin@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:marketsadmin@byroncentre.com.au) and we can forward your query on.

### Can I volunteer at the markets?

Absolutely! Volunteering opportunities are often available. Please apply on the [Volunteer](https://www.byroncentre.com.au/bcc/about/volunteer#apply) section of our website.

### Where can I park?

Parking in the town centre is free after 6pm. This includes parking on Jonson Street. Check the [Byron Council](https://www.byron.nsw.gov.au/Services/Roads-and-parking/Parking/Where-can-I-park-in-the-Byron-Shire) website for a map of parking zones.

### Are credit/debit cards accepted or cash only?

Some stallholders have card payment options, while others may prefer cash only. It is best to bring some cash or access one of the several ATMs located on Jonson Street.

### What kind of products can I find at the markets?

Twilight Market features boutique stalls held by local artisans selling jewellery, leather goods, clothing and accessories as well as great food selection.

### How can I contact market management?

Byron Community Market - Natwah Petruszka[  
communitymarket@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:communitymarket@byroncentre.com.au) / 0499 755 500

Twilight Market - Greg Curry[twilightmarket@byroncentre.com.au /](mailto:twilightmarket@byroncentre.com.au) 0490 058 451

Beachside Market - Teya Steinberg[  
beachsidemarket@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:beachsidemarket@byroncentre.com.au) / 0490 129 712

# FAQs

# Byron Community Markets

# Stallholders

### I have filled in a new application for the market but haven’t heard back

Applications are checked on Wednesday’s - 10 days and 3 days prior to each market. Please allow time for a response as all our staff work part time.

### I haven’t received my invoice to attend the next market

An email with a link to pay is sent on Wednesday, 10 days prior to each market. Also check your spam/junk  folder. If your insurance is out of date, you may not have received an invoice.

### I have paid my invoice but don’t have a site number

An email is sent on the Friday before each market with instructions regarding  your site allocation. Please check your spam/junk folders.

### Where do I email my updated/current insurance certificate to be updated?

You can email your updated Certificate of Currency to [marketinsurance@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:marketinsurance@byroncentre.com.au) This will then be updated across all our markets.

### Can the market provide me with insurance?

All stallholders are required to provide their own public liability insurance for their business. This can be purchased from several insurance companies such as AAMI, GIO, BizCover, QBE.

### How can I become a stallholder at the markets?

Information regarding fees and requirements can be found on our website: [https://www.byroncentre.com.au/bcm/become-a-stallholder](https://www.byroncentre.com.au/bcm/become-a-stallholder). All applications must be completed online and you should complete a separate application for each market you wish to attend.

### How can I contact market management?

Byron Community Market - Natwah Petruszka[  
communitymarket@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:communitymarket@byroncentre.com.au) / 0499 755 500

Twilight Market - Greg Curry[twilightmarket@byroncentre.com.au /](mailto:twilightmarket@byroncentre.com.au) 0490 058 451

Beachside Market - Greg Curry[  
beachsidemarket@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:beachsidemarket@byroncentre.com.au) / 0490 058 451

# Visitors

### When and where are the markets held?

Byron Community Market is  held on the 1st Sunday of every month, with additional markets on the 3rd Sunday in December & January.  Between 8.00am to 3.00pm, in the Town Centre. [Market Map](https://assets-global.website-files.com/632be859f2cd4f7f329317aa/6400b4172954c8196bc135fe_Byron%20Community%20Markets%20CBD%20Map.pdf)

### Can I bring my dog to the market?

Yes you can! Byron Community Market is dog friendly. We do ask that you keep your dog on a leash and clean up after them.

### Will the market be on if it’s raining?

Byron Community Market is an all weather market and will go-ahead, rain or shine. If the market is cancelled, announcements are made on our website and social media pages.

### Where is the Market Information / Lost Property / First Aid?

Market Information, first aid and lost property is located in the markets office in Railway Park, next to The Rails pub.

### How can I contact a stallholder?

Check our [Stallholder Directory](https://www.byroncentre.com.au/bcm/stallholder-directory) for a selection of the stallholders that attend our markets: If the stall you are looking for is not listed, email [marketsadmin@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:marketsadmin@byroncentre.com.au) and we can forward your query on.

### Can I volunteer at the markets?

Absolutely! Volunteering opportunities are often available. Please apply on the [Volunteer](https://www.byroncentre.com.au/bcc/about/volunteer#apply) section of our website.

### Where can I park?

There are paid and unpaid parking areas near the market area. However, it can get busy, so we recommend arriving early to secure a spot. Check the [Byron Council](https://www.byron.nsw.gov.au/Services/Roads-and-parking/Parking/Where-can-I-park-in-the-Byron-Shire) website for a map of parking zones.

### Are credit/debit cards accepted or cash only?

Some stallholders have card payment options, while others may prefer cash only. It is best to bring some cash or access one of the several ATMs located around the site.

### What kind of products can I find at the markets?

Byron Community Market features over 300 sites including food stalls, handmade crafts, jewellery, clothing, artworks, and much more.

### How can I contact market management?

Byron Community Market - Natwah Petruszka[  
communitymarket@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:communitymarket@byroncentre.com.au) / 0499 755 500

Twilight Market - Greg Curry[twilightmarket@byroncentre.com.au /](mailto:twilightmarket@byroncentre.com.au) 0490 058 451

Beachside Market - Teya Steinberg[  
beachsidemarket@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:beachsidemarket@byroncentre.com.au) / 0490 129 712

#### Haven’t found the answer to your question?

Please send your query to [marketsadmin@byroncentre.com.au](mailto:marketsadmin@byroncentre.com.au)  
Note: all our staff work part time, so please be patient when waiting for a response.

#### Inclusive Workplace

We welcome anyone over the age of 18, all genders, people living with a disability, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and people who are LGBTIQSB+ to apply.

#### Student Placement

We offer a range of work placement opportunities to students. Students from the community services, social work, tourism, hospitality, events, marketing and business sectors have been involved in major projects and fundamental roles in facilitating Byron Community Centre’s work in community development.  

#### Work for the Dole

We provide fulfilling opportunities to Work for the Dole participants. Byron Community Centre offers a rare experience within an encouraging and supportive atmosphere. Participants develop new skills, build confidence and meet other volunteers while working in a variety of rewarding roles.

# Become a Stallholder

Set up a stall at Byron Bay to grow your business, expand your audience and connect with your customers.

[

[Learn More](https://www.byroncentre.com.au/bcm/become-a-stallholder#info)

Grow your business

## Grow your business in a real and natural way

Become a stallholder at our Byron Markets to grow your small business and connect to new audiences. Stallholder applications are available at our three Byron markets: Community, Beachside and Twilight. Each market has a unique atmosphere and you can apply to attend more than one market.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/632be859f2cd4f7f329317aa/633ce1e20b7be5e1194a2660_ByronBeachMarkets-HiRez-20201004-100831-KHPphoto.jpg)

Connect with your People

## Expand your audience and connect with your customers

The Byron Markets offer a unique opportunity to position your small business for success. Having a stall at the markets allows you to connect directly to your customers, share your story, and sell your products and services. There is no better way to grow your business in a vibrant outdoor setting that attracts both locals and tourists.

### Australia's longest running Latin dance festival ...

# Byron Latin Fiesta

Byron Latin Fiesta 2026. Join us from 29 Oct to 1 Nov for the most vibrant Latin dance festival Byron Bay hosts each year. Immerse yourself in the rich world of Latin dance, music and culture. Soak up the rhythm and energy across 4 vibrant nights and 3 exciting days. Enjoy Latin dance workshops, parties, social dancing, live music, DJs and performances. Learn from renowned dance artists, connect with a passionate community, be inspired and create lasting memories!

[LIMITED CAPACITY EVENT - ALL TICKETS ON SALE NOW](https://byronlatinfiesta.com.au/tickets)

### From Cuba

## MEET PILO...

Born and raised in Cuba, Pilo Selguera has over 20 years of experience sharing the passion, rhythm and energy of authentic Cuban dance. Having taught and performed at leading festivals across Europe alongside some of Cuba's most celebrated artists, he brings a wealth of knowledge and infectious enthusiasm to every workshop and event. Now based on the Sunshine Coast, Pilo leads La Rumba, where he teaches, DJs and hosts vibrant Cuban dance events, continuing to inspire dancers through Cuban Salsa, Rueda de Casino and Afro-Caribbean culture. Get ready for his genuine Cuban flavour and high-energy at Byron Latin Fiesta 2026!

[VIEW ARTISTS & DJS](https://byronlatinfiesta.com.au/artists)

### From Colombia

## MEET JOSE & FALLON

Bringing the vibrant energy of Colombian salsa, we’re thrilled to welcome Fallon & José to Byron Latin Fiesta for the very first time in 2026! As directors of Brisbane-based Salsa Fever Dance Academy, they specialise in the dynamic and authentic style of Salsa Caleña, famous worldwide for its lightning-fast footwork, dynamic movements and infectious energy. With a passion for Colombian culture, musicality and connection, they bring the distinctive rhythm and flavour of Cali to the dance floor. Teaching and Performing at the event, get ready to experience the flavour of Colombia and add some serious sabor to the dance floor!

[VIEW ARTISTS & DJS](https://byronlatinfiesta.com.au/artists)

### BLF 2026

## BEGINNER DANCERS!

New to the Latin dance world and would like to try out some of the exciting dance styles? The Byron Latin Fiesta features a dedicated BEGINNERS HUB! Your BEGINNERS PASS gives you access to all the Workshops at the Beginners Hub plus enjoy the Parties each night on the main Program! Watch performances, Take workshops, Social dance, connect with new people & have fun!

# Festival Info

**Byron Latin Fiesta 2026 — 21st Edition.** Join us in beautiful **Byron Bay** from **29th October to 1st November 2026** for a celebration of Latin music, dance and connection. Experience **4 unforgettable nights and 3 inspiring days** filled with rhythm, culture and the joy of social dancing at **Australia’s longest-running Latin dance festival.**

**Two Venues. One Fiesta**.  
The 2026 Fiesta takes over two venues in Byron Bay for the main events, both within easy walking distance of the town centre & just a **7-minute walk from each other**. Both venues have beautiful dance floors and are fully air-conditioned. We will be creating a welcoming festive vibe at both venues!

**Club Byron –** **Three Party nights.**    
Club Byron will host the Friday, Saturday & Sunday night parties, with Latin DJs, dance performances, a live band & social dancing. We’ll be transforming the **entire venue** to create the full Fiesta atmosphere. Bar and bistro on site plus **Drinks at Club prices!**

**Address: 18-20 Marvell St, Byron Bay**.

![Club Byron, dance floors](https://byronlatinfiesta.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Web-ClubByron-2.png)

![Club Byron, dance parties](https://byronlatinfiesta.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Web-ClubByron-3.png)

![Dining room at Club Byron, Byron Bay](https://byronlatinfiesta.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Web-ClubByron-4.png)

**Marvell Hall –** **Two Workshop days.**    
Marvell Hall will be home to the daytime workshops, with the **entire venue dedicated to dance & socialising**. Two or three workshops will run at any time. Learn, connect, grow, enjoy!  
**Address: 37 Marvell St, Byron Bay**.

![Marvell Hall, Workshops Venue](https://byronlatinfiesta.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/MarvellHall-1-700x467.jpg)

![Marvell Hall, Foer area](https://byronlatinfiesta.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Marvell-Hall-2.jpg)

### Travel

## Getting Here

##### Flying to Byron Bay from Interstate

*   Closest Airports are **Coolangatta** (Gold Coast) and **Ballina** / Byron.
*   Airlines which service Coolangatta are: Virgin Australia, Rex & Jetstar. Coolangatta is a 45min shuttle bus ride to Byron Bay.
*   Airlines which service Ballina are: Virgin Australia, Rex & Jetstar. Ballina is a 30min shuttle bus ride to Byron Bay.

# Our Story

**Byron Latin Fiesta 2026 — 21st Edition.** Join us in beautiful **Byron Bay** from **29th October to 1st November 2026** for a celebration of Latin music, dance and connection. Experience **4 unforgettable nights and 3 inspiring days** filled with rhythm, culture and the joy of social dancing at **Australia’s longest-running Latin dance festival.**

The Byron Latin Fiesta was founded in 2006. It grew out of a passion for Latin American music, dance and culture together with a love for the Byron shire with it’s stunning environment & unique attributes. When the fiesta was born, the main focus was to bring the local Latin dance community together and to give the national industry within Australia a platform to showcase their talents. It was also intended to educate and excite new comers. As the event has evolved and grown it has become an International, National and Local event and yet, it still strives to keep a rather grass roots approach and to stay connected to it’s humble beginnings.

### In the heart of

## Beautiful Byron Bay

Byron Bay is a beach town in the far north east of New South Wales. The resident population swells by three or four times during summer holidays and other peak times throughout the year. Byron Bay is popular for a number of reasons: it has some of the most beautiful beaches in the world and also stunning sub tropical rainforest areas. There is a wide variety of events & activities going on all the time. If you are active you can learn to surf or go skydiving, microlighting or hanggliding, kayaking with the dolphins, tours of the region, horseriding, golf, fishing, circus skills, art workshops and more. The area also has one of the highest number of artists and artisans as residents in Australia and you can see this at all the local markets and boutique stores. Check our Venue, Transport and Accommodation options [**HERE**.](https://byronlatinfiesta.com.au/info/)

#### Sky Blue  
Founder & Director

Sky Blue is the founding director of the Byron Latin Fiesta. She is also the Director of [Picante Productions](https://picanteproductions.com.au/), a Melbourne based boutique dance company. Sky has 30 years experience in dance & over 18 years working in the events industry.  
Sky created the Byron Latin Fiesta in 2006. This was the start of her ongoing career in directing a variety of dance festivals within Australia, notably, the Sydney International Bachata Festival, the Sydney Cuban Salsa Congress, the Melbourne Kizomba Festival and Festival de Ritmo. 

![Picante Productions logo](https://byronlatinfiesta.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Picante.png)

[Picante Productions](https://www.picanteproductions.com.au/ "Picante Productions") is a boutique company that produces festivals and events, hosts International and National artists and mentor’s new talent. In addition we also offer dance tuition by way of classes, workshops, bootcamps and private tuition. All events are delivered with passion and a fine attention to detail.

#### The Team

The Byron Latin Fiesta is not possible without the help of the local dance community and a few valuable key members. And, it truely thrives with the additional help we receive each year from our Volunteers.

## **Sea Otter is more than a Festival. More than a Race. More than an Expo.**

It’s where the world comes to celebrate the wonderful sport of cycling. With a 35-year history, the original Sea Otter draws 80,000 participants at the annual event in Monterey California. It is the World’s Largest Cycling Racing & Riding Festival, Summit and Tradeshow in one.

The inaugural 2025 Sea Otter Australia was a landmark celebration that redefined the event experience as the Southern Hemisphere’s largest and most integrated cycling festival, uniting nearly 9,000 attendees and 170+ brands in a world-class event where the incredible atmosphere and sense of community proved that Sea Otter truly is for everyone.

[FESTIVAL REPORT 2025](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1boJnMmwXnmanuMOOFvkBqioJKbWKs5C2/view?usp=sharing)

Rocky Trail Entertainment now runs Sea Otter the Southern Hemisphere! We have secured a 10-year contract and future dates for the next 3 years are already confirmed, with the Festival scheduled for **21-25 October in 2026**, for **20-24 October in 2027** and **19-23 October 2028**.

## Mogo Trails The Home of Sea Otter Australia

Welcome to Mogo Trails, the home of Sea Otter Australia!

Experience a world-class network of trails designed for every rider – from heart-pounding descents and flowy single track to epic climbs and technical challenges. Put your skills to the test and discover breathtaking scenery around every bend.

Witness the potential of this groundbreaking event. Sea Otter Australia is a game-changer, attracting riders from across the globe and injecting excitement into the Australian cycling scene.

Plus, the adrenaline of E-bike Four Cross racing, Cyclo-Cross beach battles, and jaw-dropping Freestyle jams! The Event Hub is the beating heart of it all – a rider’s paradise with 200+ brands showcasing the latest gear, demo rides, exclusive deals and offer free access and activities for younger children and chances to meet absolute cycling heroes.

## **A Global Legacy establishing roots in Australia**

Our events division, Rocky Trail Entertainment, secured the rights to establish the Sea Otter Event in Australia, which will be the first and only one of its kind in the Southern Hemisphere. It is now one of only two licensed Sea Otter events in the World outside of the US alongside Sea Otter Europe in Girona Spain. 

Sea Otter Australia is your new must-attend cycling event in the Southern Hemisphere!

With a big range of racing and riding events, including gravity enduro, downhill, cross-country, and free ride, the event will cater to all skill levels and riding styles. A bustling expo with 200+ brands showcasing the latest bikes, gear, and industry trends. The event extends beyond the tracks with the Australian Sea Otter Summit, fostering crucial dialogues about trail-based tourism and industry growth.

### Sea Otter Australia Festival Volunteer Incentive Program

The Sea Otter Australia Festival, taking place from **October 23-25**, is on the lookout for enthusiastic volunteers!

We recognise that volunteers are the backbone of any successful event, and we’re excited to offer a program that not only provides a fantastic experience but also helps individuals and groups achieve their goals.

![](https://seaotter.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/038011-1024x683.jpg)

### ****Ride, Volunteer, and Save!****

## For Individuals

Not racing at Sea Otter Australia then why not volunteer and be a part of this epic event for Free!

[Information For Individuals](https://seaotter.au/about/volunteer/individual-volunteering-at-sea-otter-australia/)

ABOUT

A VIBRANT ART FAIR

Art Jakarta holds on to its main vision to be the Southeast Asian-focused art fair in Asia, and one of the most exciting art fairs in the region. It is hosted in the region’s dynamic centre of contemporary art and is always a stimulating international forum for key stakeholders in Asia to serve the region’s contemporary art ecosystem.  

TEAM

CREATED BY THE PEOPLE IN INDONESIAN ART SCENE

Art Jakarta has drawn personalities who strongly believe in the potential of the Fair. These individuals have previously had their share of contributions to the region’s contemporary art scene. Coming together to run the Fair, they are united by their passion for the art.  
  
These experienced and diverse individuals are committed to realising an art fair that’s true to the spirit of the city and a reflection of the ever-amazing creativity of the country. Driven not only by professionalism but also by the love of the art world, each member is dedicated to taking meticulous care of every aspect of the Fair.

VENUE

International Venue

Art Jakarta 2024 maintains the high standard of an international art fair at the new venue, JIExpo Kemayoran. One of the largest of its kind in Indonesia, JIExpo Kemayoran is well-equipped with all the requisite facilities to create a smooth exhibition experience for both exhibitors  
and visitors.

![](https://i0.wp.com/artjakarta.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/foto.png?fit=4802%2C2733&ssl=1)

MRA MEDIA

By the leading lifestyle group

Art Jakarta is the brainchild of MRA Media, Indonesia’s leading lifestyle group that runs international magazines such as Harper’s Bazaar, Cosmopolitan, Her World, and CASA. MRA also holds the licenses of the high-end retail brands Bulgari, Häagen Dazs, Bang & Olufsen, and Hard Rock Café. In addition, MRA runs five brands of lifestyle and entertainment radio stations, some of which are known as the pioneers of the industry. MRA Media, building bridges of taste and appreciation, ensures broad and in-depth lifestyle media coverage for the right audience in Indonesia.

##### Menutup ARS LONGA: GENERATIO dengan Kesadaran Kolektif Baru

ARTJOG 2026 ARS LONGA: GENERATIO resmi menutup rangkaian penyelenggaraannya pada hari Minggu, 30 Agustus 2026 di Jogja National Museum. Pada usianya yang ke-19 tahun, pelaksanaannya tahun ini dimaknai sebagai ruang refleksi dan introspeksi yang mendalam. ARTJOG pun kembali mengungkapkan apresiasinya atas kritik dan diskusi publik yang telah terbangun, serta memandang dinamika yang telah terjadi sebagai bentuk kepedulian bersama demi ekosistem seni yang lebih baik.

26 Aug 2026

##### Membedah Bahasa Material Melalui The Others Lab by TACO

ARTJOG 2026 kembali memberi ruang bagi eksperimentasi desain dan material melalui program The Others Lab. Program ini mengintegrasikan perspektif desain ke dalam dunia seni kontemporer melalui proses pertukaran pengetahuan berbasis material. Di sini, kemampuan individu dalam memecahkan masalah secara kreatif menjadi kunci untuk mendemokratisasi desain agar tidak lagi terasa berjarak.

[Download](https://artjog.id/press/06.%20The%20Others%20Lab-20260826T110033Z-1-001.zip)

![](../press/artistique-theaterthumb.jpg)

10 Aug 2026

##### performa•ARTJOG Hadirkan Kisah Perempuan dan Migrasi lewat Pertunjukan Les Filles de la Mer

Di balik gedung pameran utama, pengunjung ARTJOG 2026 juga dapat menikmati berbagai presentasi seni pertunjukan, seni performans, maupun seni peristiwa lainnya secara langsung melalui program performa•ARTJOG. Didukung oleh Bakti Budaya Djarum Foundation, program ini menghadirkan ruang yang menawarkan pengalaman menikmati seni pertunjukan secara dinamis dan tanpa sekat, sekaligus menjadi laboratorium terbuka bagi para seniman pertunjukan untuk mengekspresikan gagasan artistik mereka.

[Download](https://artjog.id/press/07-Artistique%20Theatre.zip)

![](<../press/ARTJOG 2026 - Exhibition View Generatio Continua_ Death as the Catalyst for the Rebirth of a Generation - Roby Dwi Antono.jpg>)

10 Aug 2026

##### Luka Kolektif dan Kelahiran Kembali: Ruang Imersif Roby Dwi Antono di ARTJOG

Roby Dwi Antono adalah seorang seniman asal Yogyakarta yang berkarya melalui medium lukisan, patung, dan instalasi. Sebagai seniman pop surealis, ia pertama kali dikenal lewat karya-karya lukis yang memadukan kenangan masa kecil, refleksi personal, dan unsur fantasi. Dunia imajinatif yang ia bangun sarat dengan figur-figur khas seperti kelinci, anak-anak, serta makhluk humanoid yang menghadirkan ruang di mana kepolosan dan imajinasi saling berkelindan. Meski karakter-karakter tersebut tetap menjadi bagian penting dari bahasa visualnya, kali ini Roby memperluas praktik artistiknya ke medium patung dan instalasi. Melalui karya-karya tersebut, ia menciptakan pengalaman yang lebih imersif untuk mengeksplorasi persoalan identitas, realitas, serta kegelisahan yang muncul di tengah perubahan zaman yang begitu cepat.

[Download](https://artjog.id/press/05.%20Commission%20Artist-20260810T100346Z-1-001.zip)

![](../press/diskusi-publik.jpg)

08 Jul 2026

##### Seni dalam Tarik Ulur Kepentingan

Universitas Sanata Dharma, Yogyakarta, 8 Juli 2026. Menanggapi berbagai perdebatan dan polemik yang berlangsung di tengah publik, ARTJOG merancang sesi diskusi publik untuk mengulas kompleksitas hubungan antara praktik kreatif, dukungan pendanaan, dan kepentingan politik dalam ekosistem seni dan budaya. Diskusi publik ini terselenggara melalui kerja sama dengan Program Doktor Kajian Budaya (Kajian Seni dan Masyarakat) Universitas Sanata Dharma Yogyakarta, dengan tajuk “SENI DAN KEKUASAAN: Independensi Seni, Pendanaan Seni, dan Kebebasan Berekspresi di Ruang Seni Kontemporer”. Kegiatan ini berlangsung pada hari Rabu, 8 Juli 2026, mulai pukul 14.00 WIB, di Ruang Koendjono, Gedung Pusat Lt.4, Kampus II, Universitas Sanata Dharma Yogyakarta, serta disiarkan langsung melalui akun YouTube dan laman resmi ARTJOG untuk memperluas jangkauan.

[Download](https://artjog.id/press/04.%20Diskusi%20Publik-20260716T134006Z-1-001.zip)

![](<../press/ARTJOG 2026 - Opening Ceremony - Suasana.jpg>)

19 Jun 2026

##### Mengawali Perhelatan dengan Pengalaman Kolektif Lintas Generasi

Jogja National Museum, 19 Juni 2026. Penyelenggaraan ARTJOG berlangsung dari 19 Juni hingga 30 Agustus 2026 di Jogja National Museum (JNM), Yogyakarta. ARTJOG menawarkan tema besar ARS LONGA Trilogia mulai 2026 hingga 2028, yang berarti “Trilogi Seni Itu Panjang”. Tema ARS LONGA: GENERATIO mengawali trilogi ini, yang mendorong dialog antargenerasi dalam praktik seni, sekaligus membayangkan kembali peran dan relevansi sosial seni di berbagai rentang usia. Tema ini merupakan upaya untuk memaknai ulang praktik seni kontemporer di tengah ketidakpastian, baik sebagai bentuk perlawanan, produksi pengetahuan, maupun proses penyembuhan.

[Download](https://artjog.id/press/03.%20Opening%20Day-20260630T075626Z-3-001.zip)

![](<../press/ARTJOG 2026-Media Gathering-Pemaparan Informasi_Fotografer Aulia Yasmine.jpg>)

11 Jun 2026

##### ARTJOG 2026 ARS LONGA: GENERATIO Menghadirkan Dialog dan Praktik Lintas Generasi

Wanasekar Resort, 11 Juni 2026. Festival seni rupa kontemporer ARTJOG akan kembali hadir mulai 19 Juni hingga 30 Agustus 2026 di Jogja National Museum (JNM), Yogyakarta. Tahun ini, ARTJOG mengundang Farah Wardani sebagai kurator untuk periode 2026–2028 dengan mengusung tema ARS LONGA Trilogia yang berarti “Trilogi Seni Itu Panjang”. Tema besar ini dipilih untuk menginterpretasikan makna ARS LONGA (seni itu panjang) di mana seni dipercaya sebagai bagian dari kehidupan yang terus relevan terhadap kondisi sosial, budaya, dan politik yang terus berubah.

[Download](https://artjog.id/press/02.%20Media%20Gathering%20ARTJOG%202026-20260623T091533Z-3-001.zip)

![](<../press/Sosialisasi ARTJOG 19_Curatorial Theme Presentation.jpg>)

13 Nov 2025

##### ARS LONGA: GENERATIO, BABAK BARU ARTJOG

ARTJOG 2026 akan diselenggarakan pada 19 Juni hingga 30 Agustus 2026 di Jogja National Museum, Yogyakarta. Menuju pelaksanaannya, ARTJOG menggelar acara Sosialisasi Tema sekaligus memperkenalkan Farah Wardani sebagai kurator tamu untuk tiga tahun ke depan. Sosialisasi tema ini berlangsung pada Senin, 10 November 2025 di Pendopo Ajiyasa, JNM, Yogyakarta dengan dihadiri para seniman, rekan media, khalayak umum, dan berbagai pihak yang mendukung pelaksanaan ARTJOG.

31 Aug 2025

##### Penutupan ARTJOG 2025 Jadi Ruang Pernyataan Sikap atas Kondisi Bangsa

Di tengah kondisi negara yang tengah bergejolak, Heri Pemad, Direktur ARTJOG, menutup rangkaian pelaksanaan ARTJOG 2025 - Motif: Amalan tanpa perayaan. Sebagai sebuah festival yang berpijak pada semangat kebersamaan, malam penutupan kali ini diubah menjadi sebuah ruang pernyataan sikap atas situasi keruh yang terus mencederai kita semua. Sebuah peristiwa dan momen untuk saling berbagi pandangan kritis melalui pendekatan seni, karena sejatinya seni tidak terpisah dan selalu menjadi bagian yang menyertai kegelisahan masyarakat secara luas.

[Download](https://artjog.id/press/Seremoni%20Penutupan%20ARTJOG%202025-20260610T174802Z-3-001.zip)

24 Aug 2025

##### Buka Wawasan Baru Lewat Residensi Pendek di ARTJOG

Sebagai pijakan menuju ekosistem seni yang lebih terbuka dan inklusif, ARTJOG merancang program Love🤟ARTJOG yang menyertai pelaksanaannya. Hal ini adalah komitmen ARTJOG dalam menghadirkan sebuah festival seni yang bertumpu pada semangat kebersamaan dan kesetaraan. Setelah menghadirkan pelayanan dan fasilitas bagi kawan-kawan difabel, ARTJOG kemudian melebarkan jangkauan kampanyenya dalam menumbuhkan kesadaran di masyarakat dengan menginisiasi kegiatan residensi bagi para pelajar dan pelaku seni difabel. Kegiatan ini bertujuan untuk mengenalkan dan memperluas wawasan seputar disabilitas dalam praktik dan wacana kesenian.

[Download](https://artjog.id/press/Love-ARTJOG-20260610T174716Z-3-001.zip)

23 Jul 2025

##### ARTJOG Kids Dukung Imajinasi Anak

Sebagai festival yang berkomitmen pada proses pembelajaran bersama, ARTJOG secara aktif mendukung imajinasi dan kreativitas anak-anak melalui program ARTJOG Kids. ARTJOG Kids dirintis sejak tahun 2022 untuk mencapai cita-cita kebersamaan dan kesetaraan, sekaligus menawarkan pendekatan yang unik dan segar dari perspektif anak-anak dalam menciptakan percakapan baru. Program ini bukan bertujuan untuk mencetak seniman, namun menjadi pendamping peran orang tua sebagai pendukung utama dalam membangun dan mengasah fondasi yang kuat bagi tumbuh kembang anak.

### ABOUT ARTJOG

ARTJOG adalah peristiwa seni yang berperan sebagai ruang pertemuan bagi gagasan-gagasan baru dalam kesenian dan kreativitas. Bekerja di bawah naungan PT Artjog Matra Nusantara, ARTJOG hadir sebagai sebuah festival yang mewadahi proses pertukaran pengetahuan dan estetika serta perkembangan seni terbaru. ARTJOG mewujudkannya melalui pameran seni rupa dan berbagai program seni dan edukasi demi menyuguhkan tawaran pengalaman baru bagi pengunjung. Hal ini merupakan salah satu bentuk komitmen ARTJOG untuk terus mengikis sekat-sekat yang membatasi praktik dan pemaknaan dalam kesenian, sambil terus menumbuhkan dan merawat jejaring antara seniman, pasar, pemangku kebijakan, dan publik yang selama ini telah terbangun dengan baik.

### ABOUT PT ARTJOG MATRA NUSANTARA

PT Artjog Matra Nusantara (sebelumnya dikenal sebagai Heri Pemad Manajemen atau HPM) adalah perusahaan manajemen seni terkemuka yang berfokus pada pengembangan infrastruktur dan ekosistem seni rupa kontemporer di Indonesia. Perusahaan ini didirikan oleh Heri Pemad, seorang spesialis manajemen seni dengan rekam jejak panjang dalam mengintegrasikan visi artistik ke dalam manajemen profesional. 

Melalui kapabilitasnya, PT Artjog Matra Nusantara menyediakan solusi komprehensif yang mencakup manajemen pengorganisasian pameran (_art organizing_), konsultasi kuratorial dan artistik, hingga penanganan karya seni (_art handling_). Sebagai motor penggerak industri kreatif, perusahaan ini mengelola dua portofolio besar yang menjadi barometer seni rupa nasional dan internasional: festival seni rupa ARTJOG dan Jogja Art Fair (JAF) yang kini bertransformasi menjadi Chapter Jogja. Sinergi ini kian memperkuat posisi Yogyakarta sebagai episentrum seni kontemporer yang dinamis di Asia Tenggara.

ARTJOG 2025 - Motif: Amalan menjadi seri terakhir dari trilogi ‘Motif’ yang digagas oleh kurator Hendro Wiyanto dan berlangsung sejak 2023. Tema ini mengajak seniman untuk berusaha menata ulang pandangan konvensional dan berfokus pada manifestasi serta dampak dari praktik seni. Mencoba menyoroti bagaimana gagasan artistik dapat diimplementasikan menjadi tindakan dan kontribusi nyata dalam kehidupan seni dan masyarakat.

Anusapati (Yogyakarta) dan REcycle-EXPerience (Bandung) adalah seniman komisi yang diundang oleh ARTJOG untuk menerjemahkan tema ‘Motif: Amalan’. Keduanya memberikan spektrum interpretasi yang luas, mulai dari refleksi material sampai praktik yang berorientasi pada lingkungan, menegaskan peran seni sebagai ‘amalan’ yang memiliki bobot etis dan sosial melalui karya yang dipamerkan.

ARTJOG 2025 memperkenalkan program baru, yaitu ‘ARTJOG Spotlight’ yang bertujuan memberikan ruang khusus untuk kolaborasi lintas sektor. Program perdana ini menggandeng Reza Rahadian yang mempresentasikan karya instalasi seni berjudul _Eudaimonia_ sebagai bagian dari proyek peringatan 20 tahun berkarya. Untuk lebih jauh menunjukkan bagaimana praktik seni memiliki peran di masyarakat, tiga ‘Special Project’ dari tiga kolektif seniman juga dihadirkan, yaitu _Tanah Air βeta_ karya Murakabi Movement (Yogyakarta), _Perguruan Taman-ruru_ karya ruangrupa (Jakarta), dan DEFVTO Printmaking Institute (Bali). 

Menjadi platform ekosistem seni yang inklusif dan substansial, ARTJOG 2025 - Motif: Amalan tidak hanya menawarkan sajian visual, tetapi juga merayakan praktik seni berkelanjutan. Melibatkan 47 seniman dewasa dan 44 seniman anak-anak, menjadikan ‘Motif: Amalan’ sebagai penutup trilogi yang reflektif, kolaboratif, dan memberikan harapan terhadap masa depan praktik seni kontemporer di Indonesia.

 [![](Moki-Suvi.jpg)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EnZVbqkb4_k)

##### Ziarah Ingatan

Waktu, dalam kerangka yang lebih luas, sangat lekat dengan tema sejarah. Prihatmoko Moki dan Suvi Wahyudianto dengan pendekatannya masing-masing dan dengan pilihan teknik dan mediumnya yang khas bereksplorasi dengan tema sejarah. Keduanya berulang-alik di antara sejarah personal dan sejarah komunitas yang lebih besar. Keduanya ingin menyatakan bagaimana karya seni dapat mengajak kita melintasi waktu melalui peristiwa di masa lampau, bagaimana kita dapat membicarakan hal yang dulunya tabu, dan membantu kita berimajinasi tentang masa depan yang lebih baik.

 [![](Ira-Lintang.jpg)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kY62AKlsgaU)

##### Imajinasi Sang Waktu

Masa lalu, hari ini, dan masa depan kerap dibayangkan dalam satu lintasan garis yang sama. Meskipun demikian, masa lalu dan masa depan sebenarnya sama-sama penuh dengan spekulasi dan kemungkinan-kemungkinan. Kemungkinan-kemungkinan itu lahir dari apa yang hari ini kita jalani. Melalui eksperimentasi tekstil dan kristal yang ia lakukan pada karyanya, Irene Agrivina, berkolaborasi dengan Caroline Rika, mengajak kita membayangkan kemungkinan tentang masa depan. Tentang bagaimana benda-benda sekitar kita dapat tumbuh dan hidup dengan intervensi manusia dan teknologi. Sementara Lintang Radittya mengajak kita untuk mendengarkan masa lalu yang diceritakan oleh tanah dari dataran Merapi, Nglanggeran, dan Parangkusumo. Kedua karya ini mengajak kita untuk membayangkan cara-cara lain untuk membicarakan masa lalu, hari ini, dan masa depan.

 [![](<Thumbnail wayang ukur.png>)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9YA4k8A08dU)

##### Mengukur Bayang-Bayang

Wayang Ukur merupakan karya yang diciptakan oleh Ki Sigit Sukasman dengan curahan pemikiran yang progresif dan visioner. Melalui pemikirannya dan praktiknya itu, dapat kita temui pengetahuan hampir dalam setiap aspek karya tersebut, mulai dari proses pembuatan wayang, pertunjukan, penulisan cerita, siasat presentasi, dan sebagainya. Pengetahuan inilah yang kemudian sangat penting untuk dijaga, dirawat, agar dapat terus diwariskan.

### Commissioned Artist

 [![](https://www.artjog.id/mmxxii/control/file/20220719185616.jpg)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aWdrOHPijsc)

**_Personal Denominator, 2022_**

**_Christine Ay Tjoe_**

  

ARTJOG MMXXII mengundang Christine Ay Tjoe untuk secara khusus merespon tema _Expanding Awareness_. Gagasan ini diwujudkan dalam karya instalasi berjudul _Personal Denominator._ Karya berukuran hampir tiga meter kubik ini terinspirasi dari Tardigrada, spesies mikroskopis berukuran 0,5mm yang memiliki kemampuan bertahan hidup dalam lingkungan ekstrem. Daya hidup Tardigrada mengingatkannya pada situasi masyarakat yang meski selama dua tahun terakhir ditimpa masa pandemi, tetap memiliki kemampuan bertahan dengan cara-cara yang luar biasa. _Personal Denominator_ berbicara tentang satu kualitas yang tidak mencapai nilai nol. Christine ingin menekankan bahwa setiap aktivitas manusia sesederhana apapun harus terus berlanjut dan menunjukkan daya hidup. 

Karya Personal Denominator juga dapat diraba dan dipeluk oleh pengunjung supaya mereka dapat merasakan seluruh tekstur dan pergerakan objek. Pada kaitannya dengan gagasan inklusivitas dalam seni, karya ini dapat dinikmati oleh siapa saja, termasuk pengunjung yang hanya dapat mengandalkan indera sentuhan atau raba. Ketersediaan karya untuk disentuh juga menjadi sebuah ajakan bagi kita untuk kembali membuka diri.

#### Artjog Kids

Diluncurkan perdana pada tahun 2022, ARTJOG KIDS kembali hadir untuk memfasilitasi karya dan aktivitas anak-anak sebagai upaya untuk mencapai tujuan kebersamaan dan kesetaraan yang diusung oleh ARTJOG. Program ini diharapkan dapat menjadi medium pembelajaran seni dan regenerasi sejak dini, sekaligus mampu mengikis persepsi seni rupa kontemporer yang identik dengan bahasa dan tema yang mungkin tidak terjangkau oleh anak-anak. 

Demi mewujudkan tujuan tersebut, ARTJOG Motif: Ramalan menampilkan karya seni dari 36 anak dan remaja yang terpilih melalui jalur panggilan terbuka. ARTJOG percaya bahwa anak-anak mampu menawarkan perspektif yang unik dan segar dalam membicarakan masalah sosial dan budaya sehari-hari, menciptakan hubungan emosional yang lebih dalam dengan audiens, serta mampu membuka ruang dialog dan pertukaran gagasan dan percakapan yang baru.

#### Young Artist Award

Melalui Young Artist Award (YAA), ARTJOG membuka ruang akses dan kesempatan bagi seniman muda peserta terbaik yang berusia di bawah 35 tahun. Program ini hadir sebagai wujud penghargaan dan apresiasi atas kiprah mereka dalam berkarya. Sebagai sebuah upaya untuk menggali potensi dan wawasan seniman muda, serta memperluas jaringan dan lintasan karir mereka dalam berkesenian.

Tahun ini program YAA hadir atas dukungan dari Dinas Kebudayaan (_Kundha Kebudayaan_) Provinsi DIY. Tiga dari 14 seniman muda peserta ARTJOG 2024 akan dipilih melalui penjurian. Adapun ARTJOG mengundang seniman Santi Ariestyowati dan Handiwirman Saputra sebagai bagian dari tim juri bersama tim kurator ARTJOG Motif: Ramalan.

[![](<imgprogram/12. Exhibition Tour.jpg>)](https://artjog.id/2026/exhibition.php#)

#### Exhibition Tour

Program Exhibition Tour menawarkan pengalaman tur interaktif dan edukatif kepada pengunjung untuk mendapat pemahaman mendalam dan pengalaman mengapresiasi karya seni yang sedang dipamerkan. Program ini bermaksud untuk mendekatkan karya seni dengan publik yang luas. ARTJOG merancang beberapa jenis tur pameran untuk berbagai kelompok pengunjung, yaitu tur yang terbuka bagi umum bersama kurator, tur bagi kawan difabel, dan tur untuk anak-anak.

[![](<imgprogram/14. Meet The Artist.png>)](https://artjog.id/2026/exhibition.php#)

#### Meet The Artist

Program Meet the Artist membuka kesempatan bagi pengunjung untuk bertemu dan mendalami proses kreatif, presentasi karya, sekaligus mendorong pertukaran gagasan dengan seniman secara langsung. Program ini hadir setiap hari Kamis dan terbuka untuk umum. Pengunjung dapat menyelami lebih dalam dan mengeksplorasi lebih luas dunia seni dengan mendaftarkan diri pada sesi yang diinginkan.

## THE STAGE BALI DESERVES

Southeast Asia's most anticipated international tattoo convention.

Bali has long been a destination for the world's best tattoo artists and collectors. Studios here are world class. The talent is undeniable. The culture runs deep. Yet for all of that — Bali has never had an international tattoo convention to match its reputation.

Island of Gods is that stage.

IOG exists to connect artists, brands, communities, and tattoo lovers from across the world — and to position Bali, and Indonesia, as a true global center of tattoo culture.

GRAND PRIZE: IDR 50,000,000

The highest honor at Island of Gods Tattoo Convention, awarded to the absolute most outstanding tattoo artwork created live across the event.

*   **IDR 50.000.000 Cash Prize:** Direct cash reward for the Best of Show Winner.
    
*   **Exclusive Handcrafted Trophy by Zhushi Skull:** A one-of-a-kind custom sculpture created specifically for IOG by world-renowned Chinese sculpture master Zhushi.
    
*   **Global Industry Recognition:** Evaluated by our panel of international judges from Greece, USA, and South Korea.

# 2026 Theme:  
Mulat Sarira

For Tangi Street Art Festival 2026, we embrace Mulat Sarira, a Balinese phrase that means to reflect upon oneself. It speaks about the act of looking inward with honesty and awareness, understanding our thoughts, behaviors, and place in the world.

In a time of rapid change and constant noise, Mulat Sarira invites us to pause. It encourages artists, communities, and audiences to reconnect with their inner selves, to question what we value, and to consider how our actions ripple through the environment and society around us.

# FAQs

*   What is the Tangi Street Art Festival?  
    The Tangi Street Art Festival is an annual event that celebrates street art culture and creativity. It brings together local and international artists to showcase their talents through murals and other artistic mediums.  
     
    
*   When and where does the festival take place?  
    The festival typically takes place in \[location\] during \[month/year\]. Please check our website or social media channels for the latest updates on dates and venue.  
     
    
*   How can I participate in the festival as an artist?  
    Artists interested in participating can apply through our website during the open call for submissions. Keep an eye on our announcements for details on how to apply.  
     
    
*   Is the festival open to the public?  
    Yes, the Tangi Street Art Festival is open to everyone! We encourage art enthusiasts, families, and individuals of all ages to join us in celebrating creativity and street art culture.  
     
    
*   Are there any fees to attend the festival?  
    Admission to the festival is typically free of charge. However, certain workshops, events, or special activities may require registration or tickets. Please check our program schedule for more information.  
     
    
*   How are mural locations determined?  
    Mural locations are carefully selected by our team based on factors such as visibility, accessibility, and community impact. We work closely with property owners and local authorities to secure suitable walls for artists.  
     
    
*   Do artists need to bring their own materials?  
    While artists are welcome to bring their preferred materials, the Tangi Street Art Festival provides basic painting supplies for mural creation. Specific material requirements and guidelines will be communicated to participating artists.  
     
    
*   Is there a deadline for completing murals?  
    Yes, participating artists are typically given a set timeframe to complete their murals during the festival. The exact deadline will be communicated to artists upon confirmation of participation.  
     
    
*   Are there any restrictions on mural content?  
    While we support artistic expression, we ask that mural content is respectful of local community values and regulations. Any content deemed inappropriate or offensive may be subject to removal.  
     
    
*   What does Tangi Street Art Festival cover for the artists?  
    We strive to cover all essential needs for participating artists, including materials, wall permissions, accommodation, meals, and flights. However, this depends on the sponsorship budget for each edition. We actively collaborate with embassies, organizations, and companies to secure support. Specific conditions for each edition will be communicated directly to invited artists.

# About Tangi

The Tangi Street Art Festival is a vibrant initiative by the Kolaborasi Dunia Tangi Foundation, a non-profit organisation dedicated to creating and celebrating public art. Founded in 2022 by a group of artists sharing a concern for Bali's quieted street art scene following the pandemic, Tangi meaning "awake" in the Balinese language was born to reignite creativity and bring fresh energy to the community. More than just a festival, Tangi serves as a platform that unites people through creativity, collaboration, and cultural exchange. Since its debut in 2023, the festival has become a dynamic space where local and international artists converge to share ideas, skills, and experiences, fostering lasting connections.  
  
At its core, Tangi is powered by a passionate team of artists, organisers, and volunteers who share a vision of transforming communities through the universal language of art. With goals that extend beyond murals, the festival aspires to inspire creativity, foster inclusivity, and promote sustainable cultural development. From brainstorming sessions to on-the-ground collaboration, the Tangi team embodies a spirit of togetherness, driven by a shared purpose to empower communities and create meaningful change through art. 

​

We welcome partnerships, sponsorships, and collaborations to help grow our mission of bringing impactful public art to communities. Whether you’re an artist, a brand, or an organization looking to support, we’d love to hear from you!

Partnership & Sponsorships:
