Parking for support staff is situated a short walk east on Ridge Road.

#### Is there water out on course?

The CamelBak Hydration Station is situated approximately halfway around the loop on Dog Trap Road & Mitchels. Riders also pass a second time 4.5km later.  
  
All riders must carry their own water to sustain themselves between each water point and feed tech area.

#### What happens if I have a mechanical issue out on course?

There will be a neutral support tent provided by MAXXIS at the feed tech area.  
  
All riders must however carry their own spares out on course.  
  
Recommended list includes – spare inner tube, pump or Co2 inflator, chain link, multitool, derailleur hanger (optional).  
  
Other than inside the feed tech zone riders can only accept outside support from other riders and are responsible for their own repairs.  
  
Accepting outside assistance may result in a DNF.

#### Are there marshalls on course?

Yes we have 12 marshal stations on the route with a medic station at M9 on Dog Track Road

#### What do I do if there is an accident on course?

Please contact us via the “Emergency Number” on your race plate and we will talk you through what you need to do.  
  
We will have medics stationed at Mogo Trig, CamelBak Hydration Station & Feed Tech Areas.  
  
Do not move injured riders unless directed to by us or a medical professional  
  
Idealy position another rider up the trail to warn riders of accident ahead.

#### What do I do if I cant continue?

If you are unable to continue for any reason please notify a Marshal of your withdrawal and they will let you know the options available at your location.  
  
If your require medical assistance please contact us via the number on your numberplate or talk to your nearest marshal.

#### Where can we spectate?

Spectators can view the finish line near the feed tech zone.

#### Do riders need to return to event center after the event?

All presentations will be at the event center so please make you way back and help us celebrate!

#### Can we practice the course?

**LimitationThursday:**  
Schools event in progress in Botanic Garden Zone. No access from the start of the race loop (Ridge Road Saddle) to the Dam Wall until 2PM.  
  
**Recommendation:**   
Practice rides possible up to and including Wednesday with caution (track markings in progress).   
  
Practice rides possible Thursday AFTER 2PM.

#### Where are the presentations

All presentations will be at the event center so please make you way back and help us celebrate!

#### How Do I Get To The Finish Line?

We will be running a shuttle bus from the event center to the finish line during the event. Please listen out for announcements.  
  
Support vehicles can park only on Ridge Road, East of the Feed Tech Area at the junction of Dog Trap Road. No parking is allowed on Ridge Road or Dog Trap Road adjacent to the course.  
  
Access during the event is via George Bass Drive, Tallgums Way onto Ridge Road.  
  
This is a residential area and therefore please do not block driveways or impinge traffic to and from the event center.

#### Can I park at the Feed Tech Zone?

Support vehicles can park only on Ridge Road, East of the Feed Tech Area at the junction of Dog Trap Road. No parking is allowed on Ridge Road or Dog Trap Road adjacent to the course.  
  
Access is only possible during the event via George Bass Drive, Tallgums Way onto Ridge Road.  
  
This is a residential area and therefore please do not block driveways or impinge traffic to and from the event center.

## Sea Otter Schools Championships

### Sea Otter Australia Schools Championships FAQ’s

#### When and where do I pick up my rider pack?

Pre-Registration will be open at Hanging Rock Event Center on Wednesday from 12:00pm – 5:00PM at the Sea Otter HQ building next to the main gate.  
  
Registration on the day is from 7:30 AM at the **Botanic Garden Event Center**  
  
We recommend picking up you rider pack at least 24 hours in advance (if possible) so that you avoid any delays on the day.

#### Where and what time is the start of the Schools Champs?

Riders must meet at the Botanic Garden Event Center for an obligatory 8:45 am rider briefing. Once the rider briefing is complete riders can choose which trail they want to start on.  
  
Racing starts from 9:00 AM and your last race run is 1:30 PM

#### Are the tracks marked?

All the tracks are clearly marked with Orange signs and trail marking tape.

#### Where is the finish?

All finishes are clearly marked with a checker flag and an orange “Finish” sign

#### Is there water out on course?

Yes there will be a water station at the event center.  
  
We highley recommend that all riders carry a water bottle at all times especially if the weather is hot.

#### What happens if I have a mechanical issue out on course?

All riders must carry their own spares out on course.  
  
Recommended list includes – spare inner tube, pump or Co2 inflator, chain link and multitool

#### Are there marshalls on course?

Yes we have multiple marshal stations on the route with a medic station at the event center.

#### What do I do if there is an accident on course?

Please contact us via the “Emergency Number” on your race plate and we will talk you through what you need to do.  
  
Do not move injured riders unless directed to by us or a medical professional  
  
Idealy position another rider up the trail to warn riders of accident ahead.

#### What do I do if I cant continue?

If you are unable to continue for any reason please notify a Marshal of your withdrawal and they will let you know the options available at your location.  
  
If your require medical assistance please contact us via the number on your numberplate or talk to your nearest marshal.

#### Where can we spectate?

Spectators can ride up the liasons to the Botanic Garden Midline where they can view riders. Those on foot can walk up the “Powerline” firetrail halfway along Deep Creek Road and follow the marshals directions.  
  
No spectators are permitted to enter any “Live Tracks” at anytime either on foot or by bike.  
  
Please follow the directions of event staff at all times.

#### Where are the presentations?

The presentations will be at the Botanic Garden event center.

#### Can we practice the course?

The trails will be marked in the lead up to the event.  
  
Please see the trail map below for details of the trails used.  
  
Please be aware that there maybe event staff on trails at all times prior to the event.

#### Can riders sign up independently from a school?

Riders may sign up individually and represent their school under parent supervision.  
  
Home school and Distance Education students are welcome to register and nominate school name as Home School/Distance Ed.  
  
If a school wishes to endorse their students attend or attend with a school group, get in touch with the events team for bulk sign-up options and more details.  
  
Email [jo@seaotter.au](mailto:jo@seaotter.au)

#### Do I Need To Be Part Of A Cycling Association Or Club To Race?

No you don’t.

#### I want to ride with my child is that possible?

You can ride any of the liasons with your child however there is a strict “No Towing” policy.  
  
Riders without a “Marshall Plate” will NOT be allowed to enter a live race track

#### What About Insurance?

All Sea Otter Australia events are covered by Flip Insurance

#### Do I need a festival pass to support my child?

No you don’t, this event is held prior to the festival & expo opening.  
  
The event will also be based at the Mogo Trails Botanic Garden Trailhead.  
  
You only need to purchase a Festival & Expo pass if you are entering the festival venue at Hanging Rock on or after 24th October (day after this event).

#### Will There Be A First Aid Officer?

Yes, we will provide first aid officers, who will be on-site at the race or event. They will be located in a clearly marked tent or area.

#### Will There Be A Bike Shop To Assist With Bike Repair?

Yes, we always try to get a dedicated supporting bike shop on-site for the entire day of racing. In the rare cases where we don’t have a bike shop on site we will arrange that there are plenty of supplies and spare parts for sale through our sponsors/supporters.

#### How Do I Keep Track Of My Time/Laps and Results?

All race times are LIVE on the website’s Results page and you can scan QR codes in the event center.

#### Can we register students in bulk?

If a school wishes to register their students to attend as a school group, please get in touch with the [events team](https://seaotter.au/contact/) for bulk sign-up options.

#### What do I do if I see another rider cheat?

If you see another rider cheat please let one of our race officials know immediately.  
  
Any form of cheating will result in the removal of times deemed applicable.

#### What is classified as cheating?

All our trails are clearly marked with both signage and trail bunting. Leaving the trail at any point will be deemed as cheating. This includes taking lines that were perviously bunted closed but have “opened up” due to damaged course marking.  
  
Riders who feel they have been unfairly penalised can talk to the race director prior to the close of the event.

## Maxxis Gravel Fondo

### Maxxis Effervelo Gravel FAQ’s

#### What are the event distances

Distances are approximately:  
  
Adventure 50 will be approximately 870 vm and 47 KM  
Epic 70 will be approximately 1400 vm and 72 Km

#### When and where do I pick up my rider pack?

Registration will be open Wednesay from 12:00pm – 5:00PM and then everyday from Thursday to Sunday from 7:30 at the Sea Otter HQ building next to the main gate.  
  
We recommend picking up you rider pack at least 24 hours in advance (if possible) so that you avoid any delays on the day.

#### What tyre should I run for the terrain?

With Maxxis as the headline sponsor for this event, of course, we got their team to give us the inside scoop – we ran it all past the local gravel squad and they gave us the thumbs up too.  
  
You can expect fire trails to expansive backcountry forestry roads, a highly diverse mix of trails and surfaces, especially for anyone stepping up to the Epic distance. Therefore, Maxxis had two answers depending on your bike:  
  
If your gravel bike can run wider rubber, they recommend the **[new Aspen ST 55C front and rear](https://www.kwtimports.com.au/Brand/MAXXIS/Gravel-and-CX/MAXXIS-Gravel-ASPEN-ST-700X55C-HYPR-X-~-EXO-~-TR-Foldable-120-TPI-E50-ASPST755XEXOTR)** for the confidence, speed and comfort to get out and back in record time, and still feel fresh at the finish.  
  
If your bike doesn’t have that wide-body capacity, their pick is the **[Rambler up front and the Reaver on the back](https://www.kwtimports.com.au/MAXXIS/Gravel-and-CX)**, both in the widest configuration your frame and fork will take, humming along the smooth, fast-rolling hardpack while confidently tackling the punchy, steep climbs and fast, sweeping descents.

#### Where and what time is the start of the Maxxis Effervelo Gravelfondo?

Riders must meet at the Hanging Rock Event Center start zone on Sunday 25th for 7:30 am ready for an 8:00 am roll out.  
  
All riders will leave the event center under Police escort at 8:00 am.

#### Is this a race or a ride?

This is a Ride NOT a Race.

#### Are the tracks marked?

All the tracks are clearly marked with signs and trail marking tape.

#### Where is the start?

Riders will start the ride from Hanging Rock Event center and will be escorted to the start of the gravel section of the ride at Ridge Road.

#### Is there food and water out on course?

50km Riders:  
**Neutral Maxxis Support Feed Station at 21.5km** – Mechanical, Medical, Hydration, Nutritional, and emotional support available  
Neutral hydration station at 26.1km – Hydration & Nutritional Support  
Hanging Rock Event Center at 50km – Finish line  
  
70km Riders:  
**Neutral Maxxis Support Feed Station at 21.5km** – Mechanical, Medical, Hydration, Nutritional, and emotional support available  
Neutral hydration station at 49.1km – Hydration & Nutritional Support  
Hanging Rock Event Center at 70km – Finish line  
  

#### What happens if I have a mechanical issue out on course?

All riders must carry their own spares out on course  
  
Neutral support is provided at the following locations:  
  
50km Riders:  
Neutral Feed Station at 21.5km – Mechanical, Medical, Hydration, Nutritional, and emotional support available  
Hanging Rock Event Center at 50km – Finish line  
  
70km Riders:  
Neutral Feed Station at 21.5km – Mechanical, Medical, Hydration, Nutritional, and emotional support available  
Hanging Rock Event Center at 70km – Finish line  
  
Recommended list includes – spare inner tube, pump or Co2 inflator, chain link, multitool, derailleur hanger (optional).  
Other than inside the feed tech zone riders can only accept outside support from other riders and are responsible for their own repairs.  
Accepting outside assistance may result in a DNF.

#### Are there marshalls on course?

There will be 10 Marshals out on course, sweep/sag vehicles, 2 aid stations as above, plus some mobile marshals (aka hi-vis wearing riders who will help if asked).

#### What do I do if there is an accident on course?

Please contact us via the “Emergency Number” on your race plate and we will talk you through what you need to do.  
  
Do not move injured riders unless directed to by us or a medical professional

#### What do I do if I cant continue?

If you are unable to continue for any reason please notify a Marshal of your withdrawal and they will let you know the options available at your location.  
  
If your require medical assistance please contact us via the number on your numberplate or talk to your nearest marshal.

#### Do riders need to return to event center after the event?

The official end of the ride is at Hanging Rock Event Center, please make your way back to the Event Hub for the finisher medal and so we know all riders are accounted for. Returning through the finish arch will be your final check-point for the day.

#### Can we practice the course?

The course is open for practice at all times in the lead up to the festival from 22nd Oct. Trails west of the Princes Highway are open at all times prior to race day. Trails east of the Princes Highway are closed from 7:00am – 3:00pm on Friday & Saturday. Please check with course marshals and adhere to their instructions.  
  
Important notice: Final course marking will be in place from Saturday afternoon so practicers need to rely on map reading/gps/etc before that.

The SFM is built upon relationships and we believe that with this the SFM has the  
potential to become one of NZ’s iconic events. But who we partner with and how, speaks volumes about what we want to achieve. Right from the word go we have strived to collaborate with like minded partners: people who share the same generosity of spirit and sense of adventure. Those who value quality over quantity. Those who desire partnership in the true sense of the word.

[Partner with us](https://www.thesinglefinmingle.com/contact)

[![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/616cf982cb8259357473f8c4/9df09692-99c4-4987-b8b8-e7b13ae03e2e/Chch.png)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/616cf982cb8259357473f8c4/3b482708-ad9b-411d-93ae-3e9a898ede22/IMG_7700.jpg)

Founded by Kiwis who wanted a cleaner premix, the range now includes vodka and gin RTDs plus energy drinks. Now pouring across NZ and Australia — cheers to drinks that feel as good as they taste.

](https://www.hydroflask.co.nz/)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/616cf982cb8259357473f8c4/ce041cb4-2838-42c1-802d-322d70c33521/Mingle+Day+1+-+%40ed_west+%28112+of+112%29.jpg)

# Contact

**Wondering how you surf, play, paint or sponsor this wonderful festival?** We’d love to hear from you via the form below.

**SURF**  
The Single Fin Mingle is one of the world's leading invitational longboard events, bringing together many of the best surfers on the planet. Due to the limited time we have to run the contest, many amazing surfers miss out on spots. So how do you get one of these elusive invitations? Make a great video that showcases your surfing talents, stand out at other longboard events, have another Mingle competitor endorse you, come party, be a legend, shred your local beach day in and day out!

**MUSIC**  
We curate a magical lineup of some of New Zealand's favourite acts alongside artists from around the world for our iconic Mingle Street Parties. If you think your sound belongs at The Mingle, we'd love to hear it.

**TEAM**  
It takes a passionate team to bring The Mingle to life. Whether you're into event production, photography, videography, marketing, partnerships, hospitality or volunteering, we're always keen to hear from good people who want to help create something special.

**SPONSOR**  
The SFM is unlike any other event on New Zealand’s festival scene. A totally unique event, it can’t be pigeonholed into simply music, art, or sport; it is a genuine amalgamation of NZ’s finest culture. With a loyal following here in NZ, Australia, and around the world, the SFM can offer an opportunity you won’t find anywhere else — an authentically engaged audience who are proven to be dedicated to the brand.

# The Single Fin Mingle

From the outset our vision has been clear: To develop a world class surfing event which brings together the very best surfers into the beautiful community and waves of the South Island, Aotearoa, New Zealand. To do this we have always had a simple formula - bringing great people together and having a great time. It is about celebrating our connections, the culture that we are part of and inviting others in. From traditional surfing displays, art shows, film screenings and musical performances, the SFM has always been about sharing the love.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/616cf982cb8259357473f8c4/1635760576833-SJG00Z1L9L1M5LCROAO8/SFMDay2%40jonathansmitnz-0606.jpg)

**_ART_**

![SFMDay1@jonathansmitnz-8333.jpg](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/616cf982cb8259357473f8c4/1634545572757-VSE9YW5BBG36G4JBG092/SFMDay1%40jonathansmitnz-8333.jpg)

**_FILM_**

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/616cf982cb8259357473f8c4/1635758113274-NMM2N29CST3RLIL8R4BR/SFMFinalsDay+36+%40WalkWildStudio++copy.jpg)

**_SURF_**

## **Social Responsibility**

The Single Fin Mingle is so much more than a surfing competition. 

Since its inception in 2015, The Mingle has been a surfing event at the forefront of gender equality globally - offering equal prize money to male and female competitors (4 years before the world surfing league got with the program…). We’ve shown that genuine gender equality at an event goes way past offering equal prizes and we prove this by having female organisers and sponsors, showcasing wahine artists, musicians, film makers at the festival. At the Mingle we open are arms wide to all LBGTQ+ communities and are always keen to look at ways we can promote other underrepresented communities in surfing. 

Over the years we’ve been committed to using the Mingle platform to support important social issues. Mental health and suicide is sadly an issue that has affected us really close to home and each year we attempt to raise awareness through meaningful conversations at the event and online and by raising money to support charities in this space.

## **Values** 

The Single Fin Mingle has always been a celebration of the culture that surrounds surf, art, film and music. Moreover, it is a celebration of life, friendships and community. We all need this in our lives and the Mingle is a place where those qualities of togetherness shine, a feeling we want everyone to experience. 

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/616cf982cb8259357473f8c4/9e722e10-7109-484d-b1ad-08bf1405c63c/Illustrations-06.png)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/616cf982cb8259357473f8c4/f445468c-6b56-4c3f-ab08-ce934aac25c2/Illustrations-08.png)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/616cf982cb8259357473f8c4/b803e3d7-74e3-42a2-a128-5244cb73f9cf/Illustrations-05.png)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/616cf982cb8259357473f8c4/1635760924684-C1QO6KGBBLZGO06AB67M/SFMDay2%40jonathansmitnz-8865.jpg)

**_SURF: TRADITIONAL LONGBOARD CONTEST_**

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/616cf982cb8259357473f8c4/ba8c4129-82d0-4440-b507-7d1d7930e09d/Screen+Shot+2022-11-24+at+12.40.54+PM.png)

**_MUSIC: TWO NIGHTS OF LIVE MUSIC_**

## **Sustainability**

We are a small organisation which runs on the smell of an oily rag, yet in everything we do we strive to be sustainable - in time, energy and the resources we consume. Ultimately our goal is to make this festival a waste free event. To us this means that _every_ step along the way is carefully considered - not just whether we are using biodegradable coffee cups and cutlery (which we do by the way). Yet we are realistic enough to know that this is a journey of evolution and we make meaningful changes where we can. 

Currently at the end of each event more often than not you will find Brad, our designer, hand-sorting through the weekends recycling so we can be sure that 100% of these items actually end up recycled rather than in the landfill. This is by no means a sexy job after you have been up for nearly 3 days straight but it is something we are committed to following through.. We avoid single use plastic at all costs and require that all vendors provide biodegradable, compostable or reusable packaging for their products too. 

But perhaps the biggest lesson we have learnt along the way is the need for a sustainable mindset - to make do with less and to communicate this to everyone who attends the event.

一般の入場口を３か所に設けます。  
  
た船の科学館近くの入場口 A 、ダイバーシティー側の入場口 C そして、２つの入場口のちょうど真ん中当たりに入場口 B がございます。入場待ちで混雑した場合は、こちらの入場口もご利用ください。  
  
また SCN の入場チケットは当日販売のみ。入場口で販売となります。  
※前売り券の販売はございません  
  
お支払いは現金または PayPay のみ。クレジットカードでのお支払いは不可となります。  
  
釣銭の無い方、PayPay でのお支払いの方は、 Express Lane (優先入場) が可能となりますので、予めご準備の上ご来場頂くようお願いいたします。  
  
**入場料/Admission Fee: ¥1,980(税込) / 1名 (小学生以下 FREE)**  
  
We have located three Entry Gates.  
  
Entry Gate A (入場口A) is the usual entry gate near the Museum of Maritime Science  
Entry Gate C (入場口C) is near the Divercity-Tokyo  
Entry Gate B (入場口B) in the middle of Entry Gate A and C.  
If it gets crowded due to the admission, please consider using the other entry gate.  
  
In addition, Admission Ticket for the SCN is a ticket at the gate.  
※We do not have Advance Ticket. Please come to the Gate and purchase the ticket at the gate on the day.  
  
Payment can be done only by Cash or PayPay(Electronic Payment Service).  
Unfortunately, we do not take credit cards.  
  
If you can pay exactly, or use PayPay, you can use the Express Lane. Please be prepared.  
  

[![](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/26/scn/parking.jpg)](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/26/scn/parking.jpg)  
**一般駐車場のご案内 / General Parking Information**

38th MOONEYES Street Car Nationals®にお車でお越しの方は、青梅第二臨時駐車場をご利用ください。早朝7:00am よりご利用いただけます。  
  
その他 公共駐車場 の利用をご希望の方は、各自お調べください。  
  
Parking までの道のり  
1\. 船の科学館入口交差点を曲がり Street Car Nationals® 会場を左手に見て直進  
2\. 一つ目の信号を直進  
3\. 左折にて Parking に入場してください。  
※右折入場はできません  
  
収容台数 841台（内バス43台） 普通車：当日1回／2,000円  
バス・大型車：当日1回／4,500円  
※先払い、現金のみ  
  
車両制限：  
普通車 長さ 5.1m 幅 2.1m 以内  
トラック 無積載かつ総重量4トン以下  
  
※予約は受け付けておりません  
※バイク駐車可（料金無料）  
  
満車の際はご利用頂けません。  
  
If you are traveling by car to the 38th MOONEYES Street Car Nationals®, please use the Aomi No. 2 Temporary Parking Lot. It will be available starting from 7:00 AM.  
  
If you wish to use other public parking lots, please research and locate them on your own.  
  
Directions to the Parking Lot  
Turn at the Museum of Maritime Science Entrance (船の科学館入口) intersection.  
Keep the Street Car Nationals® venue on your left and continue straight.  
Proceed straight through the first traffic light.  
Turn left to enter the parking lot.  
Note: Right turns into the parking lot are strictly prohibited.  
  
Parking Capacity & Fees  
Total Capacity: 841 vehicles (including 43 buses)  
Standard Cars: ¥2,000 per entry  
Buses / Large Vehicles: ¥4,500 per entry  
Payment: Cash only (Pre-paid upon entry)  
  
Vehicle Restrictions  
Standard Cars: Within 5.1m (length) and 2.1m (width).  
Trucks: Must be unloaded and have a gross vehicle weight of 4 tons or less.  
  
We do not take reservations.  
Motorcycles: Parking is available and free of charge.  
  
Availability: Entry will not be permitted once the lot is full.

**MOONEYES Street Car Nationals® Location**

お台場青海駐車場  
〒135-0064 東京都江東区青海１丁目１  
1-1 Aoumi, koutou-ku, Tokyo 135-0064, Japan

Event Date  
SUNDAY May. 24, 2026  
(2026年5月24日(日))

## お車でお越しの方 ( By Car )

![LQQK!](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/img/look-right-16.jpg) **横浜方面からお越しの方**  
首都高湾岸線 臨海副都心出口で降りてすぐの交差点を右折、また右折し、潮風公園南交差点を左折。  
「船の科学館入り口」　を左折で会場入り口です。

**From Yokohama Area**  
If you get off at the exit of Bayshore Route Rinkai Fukutoshin, turn right at the intersection and turn right again and then turn left at Shiokaze Park South intersection. If you turn left at "Museum of Maritime Science Entrance" there will be the entrance.

![LQQK!](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/img/look-right-16.jpg) **東京方面からお越しの方**  
レインボー ブリッジからお越しの方は台場出口で降り「レインボー入口」を左折し、  
フジテレビ前を通り、突き当りを左折。「船の科学館入り口」　を左折で会場入り口です。

From Tokyo Area  
From Rainbow bridge exit from Daiba exit and turn left from "Rainbow Entrance" and pass front of Fuji TV and turn left at the end of the road. If you turn left at "Museum of Maritime Science Entrance" there will be the entrance.

![LQQK!](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/img/look-right-16.jpg) **舞浜方面からお越しの方**  
有明出口で降り、直進。「潮風公園南」を左折、「船の科学館入口」を左折で会場入口です。

From Maihama Area  
Go straight after you exit from Ariake Exit. Turn left at Shiokaze Park South intersection. If you turn left at "Museum of Maritime Science Entrance" there will be the entrance.

## 公共機関でのご来場が便利です。

It is also accessible by public transportation

![LQQK!](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/img/look-right-16.jpg) **東京臨海新交通 ゆりかもめ**

By Tokyo Waterfront New Transit Yurikamome

JR 新橋駅より東京臨海新交通 ゆりかもめに乗り換えて7駅目「東京国際クルーズターミナル駅」下車、徒歩2分程で会場です。

From JR Shinbashi stations go on Yurikamome and at the go off at the 7th stop "Museum of Maritime Science". Walk for 2 minutes and there will be the venue..

![LQQK!](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/img/look-right-16.jpg) **東京臨海高速鉄道 りんかい線**

JR 山手線、JR 埼京線、湘南新宿ラインは大崎駅にて東京臨海高速鉄道に乗り換えて  
4駅目「東京テレポート駅」下車  
徒歩10分程で会場です。  
東急大井町線、JR 京浜東北線は大井町駅にて乗り換えて3駅目「東京テレポート駅」下車。  
JR京葉線、東京メトロ有楽町線は新木場駅にて乗り換えて3駅目「東京テレポート駅」下車。

By Yamanote, Saikyo and Shounan Shinjyuku line go off at "Osaki Station" and go on the Rinkai line to the 4th stop "Tokyo Teleport" station and then it will be approximately 10 minute walk to the venue.  
By Tokyu Ooimachi line, JR Keihin Tohoku line, go off at "Ooimachi station" and 3rd stop will be Tokyo Teleport station.  
By JR Keiyou line and Tokyo metro Yurakucho line go off at "Shinkiba station" and 3rd stop will be Tokyo Teleport station.

**EVENT REPORT**  
2026年5月24日(日) お台場青海 Parking にて 38th MOONEYES Street Car Nationals® を開催いたしました。 心配された天候も皆さんの祈りが通じたのか、時折青空が広がる過ごしやすい一日となり、皆様のご協力のおかげで今年も素晴らしいショーを開催する事ができました。ご来場いただいた皆様、そしてエントリーされた皆様、本当にありがとうございました。また来年、皆様とお会いできることを楽しみにしております。Event Report と MOONEYES in Action では、当日の様子を網羅した動画を配信しましたので、お楽しみください。

On Sunday, May 24, 2026, we had the 38th MOONEYES Street Car Nationals® at the Odaiba Aomi Parking. Despite some early weather worries, everyone's wishes must have reached the car gods—the skies cleared up, bringing us a beautiful, comfortable day. Thanks to everyone's incredible support, we had the MQQNTASTIC show. A huge thank you goes out to everyone who came out, and to all who participated. We are looking forward to see you all again next year. We have released a ful coverage video of the entire event in both the Event Report and MOONEYES in Action, so please enjoy watching it.

[Event Report is Here](https://www.streetcarnationals.com/scn2026-report/)

首都高湾岸線 臨海副都心出口で降りてすぐの交差点を右折、また右折し、潮風公園南交差点を左折。  
「船の科学館入り口」　を左折で会場入り口です。

**From Yokohama Area**  
If you get off at the exit of Bayshore Route Rinkai Fukutoshin, turn right at the intersection and turn right again and then turn left at Shiokaze Park South intersection. If you turn left at "Museum of Maritime Science Entrance" there will be the entrance.

![LQQK!](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/img/look-right-16.jpg) **東京方面からお越しの方**  
レインボー ブリッジからお越しの方は台場出口で降り「レインボー入口」を左折し、  
フジテレビ前を通り、突き当りを左折。「船の科学館入り口」　を左折で会場入り口です。

From Tokyo Area  
From Rainbow bridge exit from Daiba exit and turn left from "Rainbow Entrance" and pass front of Fuji TV and turn left at the end of the road. If you turn left at "Museum of Maritime Science Entrance" there will be the entrance.

![LQQK!](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/img/look-right-16.jpg) **舞浜方面からお越しの方**  
有明出口で降り、直進。「潮風公園南」を左折、「船の科学館入口」を左折で会場入口です。

From Maihama Area  
Go straight after you exit from Ariake Exit. Turn left at Shiokaze Park South intersection. If you turn left at "Museum of Maritime Science Entrance" there will be the entrance.

## 公共機関でのご来場が便利です。

It is also accessible by public transportation

![LQQK!](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/img/look-right-16.jpg) **東京臨海新交通 ゆりかもめ**

By Tokyo Waterfront New Transit Yurikamome

JR 新橋駅より東京臨海新交通 ゆりかもめに乗り換えて7駅目「東京国際クルーズターミナル駅」下車、徒歩2分程で会場です。

From JR Shinbashi stations go on Yurikamome and at the go off at the 7th stop "Museum of Maritime Science". Walk for 2 minutes and there will be the venue..

![LQQK!](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/img/look-right-16.jpg) **東京臨海高速鉄道 りんかい線**

JR 山手線、JR 埼京線、湘南新宿ラインは大崎駅にて東京臨海高速鉄道に乗り換えて  
4駅目「東京テレポート駅」下車  
徒歩10分程で会場です。  
東急大井町線、JR 京浜東北線は大井町駅にて乗り換えて3駅目「東京テレポート駅」下車。  
JR京葉線、東京メトロ有楽町線は新木場駅にて乗り換えて3駅目「東京テレポート駅」下車。

By Yamanote, Saikyo and Shounan Shinjyuku line go off at "Osaki Station" and go on the Rinkai line to the 4th stop "Tokyo Teleport" station and then it will be approximately 10 minute walk to the venue.  
By Tokyu Ooimachi line, JR Keihin Tohoku line, go off at "Ooimachi station" and 3rd stop will be Tokyo Teleport station.  
By JR Keiyou line and Tokyo metro Yurakucho line go off at "Shinkiba station" and 3rd stop will be Tokyo Teleport station.

## 3 Day Bike, Gear & Industry Expo

We bring back the biggest line-up of national and global bike industry brands! Over 200 brands will showcase everything from the latest bikes, gadgets, and gear. Rub shoulders with industry legends, and score epic deals!

Whether you’re a gearhead or just love soaking up the cycling scene, the Expo at Sea Otter Australia is bound to be a highlight, bringing together bike lovers from near and far for a long weekend of fun and discovery.

#### FAQ

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Are there any purchase limits for certain products?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

For products with purchase limits at the atmos Merchandise Booth, the maximum number of items that can be purchased per person will be listed in the web catalog available at the venue on the event day. Purchase limits vary by product, so please check the web catalog at the venue. Please note that purchase limits and purchasing procedures may differ depending on the exhibitor at each booth. For details, please check directly at each booth.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Will there be lottery sales at the venue on the event day?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

For products available through lottery sales on the event day, details will be announced on the official atmoscon Instagram account as they become available.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Will products be sold until they are out of stock?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Products available at the venue are limited in quantity. Except for some items, products will be sold on a first-come, first-served basis until they are sold out.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Can I try on the products before purchasing?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Trying on products is not available at the atmos Merchandise Booth.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Is it possible that the sales methods or rules may change on the event day?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Depending on the situation at the venue, the sales methods and rules may be changed at the discretion of our staff when necessary.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Can I receive a refund, return, or exchange after purchasing a product?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

All sales are final. We cannot accept refunds, returns, or exchanges for products after purchase.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Do I need a ticket to purchase products at the venue?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

A valid admission ticket for the event day is required to purchase products at the venue.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Where can I purchase tickets?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Tickets are available through Lawson Ticket. For atmos member presale tickets (Exclusive Offer / Members Only), please refer to the information provided to eligible members. Same-day tickets will be available at the venue reception.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Why do ticket prices vary depending on the sales period?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Tickets are offered at lower prices during earlier sales periods. Each sales period is available only while supplies last and may end once the allocated number of tickets has been sold. We recommend purchasing your tickets early to receive the best available price.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Can I cancel my ticket or change the event date after purchase?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

No. Cancellations, changes, and refunds requested for personal reasons are not permitted. Except in the event of a cancellation, tickets are non-refundable once purchased.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Can I transfer or resell my ticket?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Ticket resale for commercial purposes is prohibited by law. Please note that tickets purchased through unauthorized resale channels will not be accepted for admission.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Will same-day tickets be available?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Same-day tickets for 1-day admission and live stage admission are scheduled to be available for purchase at the venue reception each day, while supplies last. Same-day sales will not be available for 1-Day Admission with Early Entry or 2-Day Admission. Please note that if any ticket type sells out in advance, same-day tickets for that ticket type will not be available.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

In what order will guests be admitted to the Live Stage?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

For each session, guests who have a “Live Stage Admission + 1-Day Admission” ticket will be admitted first, in the order of the queue numbers assigned to their tickets. After that, guests who have a “Live Stage Add-on” ticket will be admitted in the order they arrive at the designated meeting point. Please note that the queue number for “1-Day Admission with Early Entry” is only for early entry to the 1F Main Area and does not affect the order of admission to the Live Stage.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Why don’t Live Stage Add-on tickets have a queue number?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

The “Live Stage Add-on” ticket is for guests who already have an admission ticket for the same day and wish to add access to the Live Stage. No queue number is assigned to Live Stage Add-on tickets. If you wish to enter the Live Stage in queue-number order, please purchase a “Live Stage Admission + 1-Day Admission” ticket.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

What is the difference between "1-Day Admission with Early Entry" and "1-Day Admission"?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

A 1-Day Admission with Early Entry ticket allows you to enter the 1F Main Area before general admission. Entry is in numerical order based on your assigned entry number. A 1-Day Admission ticket allows entry starting from the general admission time.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

What is the difference between "Live Stage Admission" and "Live Stage Add-on"?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Live Stage Admission is a ticket package that includes both admission to the venue on the applicable day and access to the Live Stage. Live Stage Add-on is an additional ticket for guests who already have a valid admission ticket for the applicable day and would like to add Live Stage access. It cannot be used as a standalone ticket for venue entry.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Can I enter the venue with only a Live Stage Add-on ticket?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

No. A valid admission ticket for the applicable day (1-Day Admission, 1-Day Admission with Early Entry, or 2-Day Admission) is required in addition to the Live Stage Add-on ticket.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Can I access the Live Stage with a 2-Day Admission ticket?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

No. A 2-Day Admission ticket only includes access to the 1F Main Area on both event days. To watch the Live Stage, you will need to purchase an additional Daytime Live Stage Add-on or Night Live Stage Add-on ticket for the performance you wish to attend.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

If I want to watch both the daytime and night Live Stage performances on November 1, what tickets do I need?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

You will need both a Daytime Live Stage Admission ticket and a Night Live Stage Admission ticket (or both a Daytime Live Stage Add-on ticket and a Night Live Stage Add-on ticket). (Live Stage Add-on tickets are only for guests who already have a valid admission ticket for the applicable day and cannot be used as standalone tickets for venue entry.)

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

What is the entry number used for?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

The entry number determines the order of Early Entry to the 1F Main Area and the admission order for the Live Stage. For Live Stage tickets, the entry number indicates the order of admission to the Live Stage only and does not apply to the admission order for the 1F Main Area.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

How do I enter the venue?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Please present your ticket screen at the reception. After verification, you will receive a wristband. We kindly ask that you present the original ticket screen from your purchase rather than a screenshot.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

What happens if I arrive late for my assigned entry number time?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Your assigned entry number will become invalid, and you will be admitted from the end of the line. Please arrive with sufficient time.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Can I re-enter the venue after leaving?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Yes. Re-entry is permitted on the same day only. When re-entering, please make sure to wear the wristband provided at your initial entry and present it at the venue entrance.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Will there be ID checks?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

You may be asked to present a valid ID upon entry, when purchasing products, participating in lotteries, or purchasing alcoholic beverages. Please bring a valid photo ID, such as a driver’s license, Basic Resident Registration Card, passport, student ID with photo, residence card, My Number Card, or disability certificate.  
  
Please note that expired IDs, copies, or photos of IDs shown on a smartphone will not be accepted. IDs not listed above (such as employee ID cards) will not be accepted, even if multiple forms are presented.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

I have lost or damaged my wristband. Can it be reissued?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Wristbands cannot be reissued for any reason. If you are not wearing your wristband, you will not be permitted to enter the venue, even if you can provide your ticket purchase history. After putting on your wristband, please be careful not to cut it, remove it, or detach it.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

What should I do with my wristband for a 2-Day Admission ticket on the second day?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

The wristband for a 2-Day Admission ticket is valid for both event days. Please continue wearing the wristband you received on the first day and do not remove or cut it before returning on the second day. If you remove or lose your wristband after the first day, you will not be permitted to enter on the second day. Reissuance or refunds will not be provided. If you wish to enter the venue, you will need to purchase a same-day ticket again.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Is there a cloakroom or luggage storage service available?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

No cloakroom or luggage storage service is available. Please take care of your personal belongings at all times.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Can minors attend the event?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Yes, minors are welcome to attend. However, children of junior high school age or younger must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.  
  
Alcoholic Beverages:  
Alcoholic beverages will be available at the venue. However, in accordance with Japanese law, we cannot sell or serve alcohol to anyone under the age of 20. Age verification may be required when purchasing alcoholic beverages.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Is admission free for children?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Admission to the 1F Main Area is free for guests who are high school age or younger. If it is difficult to confirm your age, you may be asked to provide proof of age at the reception, such as a student ID. If your age cannot be verified, paid admission will be required.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Can I watch the Live Stage with my child?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Children aged 4 years old through high school must have both a valid admission ticket for the applicable day and a Live Stage ticket to access the Live Stage. For safety reasons, children 3 years old and younger are not permitted to enter the Live Stage venue (B1F Sumitomo Hall). Thank you for your understanding.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Can I enter the venue with a stroller?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Yes, strollers are allowed inside the venue. However, there is no dedicated stroller parking area, so please manage your stroller and belongings at your own responsibility. Please note that the venue is expected to be crowded, so take extra care to avoid contact with other guests during busy periods.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

How do I get to the venue?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

The event will be held at Shinjuku Sumitomo Building Sankaku Hiroba (2-6-1 Nishi-Shinjuku, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo). The venue is directly connected to Toei Oedo Line Tochomae Station, a 4-minute walk from Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line Nishi-Shinjuku Station, and an 8-minute walk from Shinjuku Station (JR Lines and other lines).

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Can I bring food and drinks into the venue?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

We kindly ask that you refrain from bringing food or drinks into the venue. However, this does not apply to guests with food allergies or infants’ meals. Please note that eating and drinking are strictly prohibited inside B1F Sumitomo Hall (Live Stage).

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Can I take photos or videos at the venue?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Photography and video recording are permitted in the 1F Main Area. However, please be considerate of other guests, as they may unintentionally appear in photos or videos. Depending on the situation, venue staff may ask you to stop recording. Please note that photography, video recording, and audio recording are strictly prohibited inside the Live Stage venue (B1F Sumitomo Hall).

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Are pets allowed at the venue?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

Pets are not permitted inside the venue, except for guide dogs, assistance dogs, and hearing assistance dogs.

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/019.webp)

Will the event be held in case of severe weather?

![](https://assets.atmos-tokyo.com/assets/img/features/atmos-con_2026/020.webp)

As the event will be held at an indoor venue, it is expected to proceed as scheduled in principle. However, the event may be canceled or the content may be changed due to natural disasters or other unavoidable circumstances. The latest updates will be announced on the official website and official social media channels.

"atmoscon" is a sneaker convention first held in Harajuku in  
2016 by atmos, the Tokyo-born sneaker retailer known worldwide.  
What started as a core event drawing just 600 attendees at vol.1  
has since grown in scale, riding the rise of street culture and sneaker fandom.  
  
Last year, atmos celebrated its 25th anniversary — and after a hiatus during the pandemic,  
the convention made its long-awaited comeback, drawing its largest crowd yet.  
Looking beyond sneakers,  
atmoscon now embraces a wider range of culture, from music and food to sports and art,  
charting a new course toward becoming Asia's premier culture convention.

## ABOUT THE FESTIVAL

![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/8starred.png)

### COOLY ROCKS is BACK!

![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/date-banner-blue.png)

Returning from 9-13 June 2027, join us as we celebrate the motors, music and lifestyle of yesteryear at Cooly Rocks On! A GOLD award winner in the Major Festivals & Events category at the Queensland Tourism Awards, come check out why Cooly Rocks On is Australia’s favourite nostalgia festival!

**MOTORS**

Renowned as one of Australia’s best [Show ’N’ Shine](https://www.coolyrockson.com/show-n-shine/) displays, Coolangatta will be transported back in time as the streets are lined with over 1000 incredible cars at Cooly Rocks On’s Show ‘N’ Shine proudly presented by [Autoglym](https://www.autoglym.com/). Discover the best hot rods, kustom vehicles and lowbrow art in [Kustomville](https://www.coolyrockson.com/kustomville/), plus get up close to a massive variety of vehicles, scooters, bikes and more! For the die-hard motor enthusiasts, take part in this incredible display by showcasing your pride and joy!

**MUSIC**

Slip on your dancing shoes and get ready to boogie to the beloved tunes of yesteryear! Each year, Cooly Rocks On delivers an electrifying lineup featuring some of the finest rock ’n’ roll, swing, rockabilly and tribute artists from across the globe. As a special highlight, Cooly Rocks On is also one of only three festivals in Australia to host an official preliminary round of the [Ultimate Elvis Tribute Artist Contest](https://www.coolyrockson.com/ultimate-elvis-tribute-artist-contest/), an Elvis Presley Enterprises sanctioned event, with the winner securing a spot at Elvis Week in Memphis. Time to get all shook up!

**LIFESTYLE**

Cooly Rocks On simply wouldn’t be the festival it is without honouring the lifestyle of yesteryear. The Cooly Rocks On [Pin-up Pageant](https://www.coolyrockson.com/pin-up-pageant/) shines a spotlight on classic and rockabilly styles, while the Cooly Rocks On [Moonlight Swing Dance](https://www.coolyrockson.com/moonlight-swing-dance/), a 1940s-inspired shindig, gives attendees the perfect chance to dance the night away. And that’s not all! Browse a fantastic selection of retro treasures, vintage gems and nostalgic memorabilia from decades past as you wander through the extensive beachfront [markets](https://www.coolyrockson.com/markets/).

With so much to experience, there truly is something for everyone at Cooly Rocks On. See you there!

# MUSIC

![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/8starred.png)

![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/CRO_General-Festival_SUN-33-Copy-scaled.jpg)

### ARTIST LINEUP

Featuring a rockin’ lineup of Australia’s favourite rockabilly, swing and rock ’n’ roll artists from near and far, you’ll have no trouble finding a good boogie! Stay tuned for who will be hitting the stage at Cooly Rocks On 2027!

[SEE 2026 LINEUP](https://www.coolyrockson.com/artists/)

![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Queen-Rhapsody-scaled.jpg)

### FEATURE SHOWS

Including international and homegrown Elvis Tribute Artists and other electrifying tribute shows, you won’t want to miss! Stay tuned for what feature shows will be at Cooly Rocks On 2027!

[FIND OUT MORE](https://www.coolyrockson.com/feature-shows/)

[![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/CRO_Artist_SUN-12-scaled-e1750397220386.jpg)](https://www.coolyrockson.com/elvis-precinct/)

### ULTIMATE ELVIS TRIBUTE ARTIST CONTEST

As one of only three contests held in Australia sanctioned by Elvis Presley Enterprises, who will head straight to Elvis Week in Memphis to represent Cooly Rocks On?

Stay tuned for who will be competing in Cooly Rocks On 2027!

[FIND OUT MORE](https://www.coolyrockson.com/ultimate-elvis-tribute-artist-contest/)

![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/DSC04236-2-scaled-e1679897005208.jpg)

### THE ELVIS KARAOKE AFTER PARTY

Sing your heart out to some of The King’s best hits at the ultimate after party! Join UETA contestants, VIP Legends Pass Holders and more for a night to remember at Cooly Rocks On 2026.

[FIND OUT MORE](https://www.coolyrockson.com/the-elvis-karaoke-after-party/)

Cooly Rocks On is one of four festivals proudly produced by [Experience Gold Coast](https://experiencegoldcoast.au/) (EGC) and is an award-winning festival celebrating the eras of yesteryear with a long and rich history.

EGC’s mission is to develop a portfolio of events and festivals that attracts music lovers near and far to the beautiful Gold Coast, whilst showcasing the city as the ultimate events and festivals destination.

Other events produced by EGC include [Blues on Broadbeach](https://bluesonbroadbeach.com/)  , [Groundwater Country Music Festival](https://groundwatercmf.com/) and [BLEACH\*.](https://hota.com.au/whats-on/live/festivals-and-series/bleach-2025)

**STRATEGIC PARTNERS**

[![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/TEQ_black-768x226.png)](https://www.queensland.com/au/en/things-to-do/events)

[Tourism and Events Queensland](https://www.queensland.com/au/en/things-to-do/events) (TEQ) is a statutory body of the Queensland Government and the state’s lead marketing, tourism experience and destination development and major events agency. TEQ aims to build Queensland’s tourism and events industry to foster innovation, drive industry growth and boost visitor expenditure.

TEQ is a proud Strategic Partner of Cooly Rocks On.

[![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/logo_itslive-1.png)](https://www.queensland.com/au/en/things-to-do/events)

Cooly Rocks On is supported by the Queensland Government via Tourism and Events Queensland and is a feature on the [It’s Live! in Queensland](https://www.queensland.com/au/en/things-to-do/events) events calendar. Mark your calendars to experience the energy and spirit of Queensland with one of our many world-class events.

**MAJOR PARTNERS**

[![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/AG-Corp-Logo-black.png)](https://www.autoglym.com/au/)

For over 60 years, [Autoglym](https://www.autoglym.com.au/) has set the standard in car care the world over, trusted by professionals and enthusiasts alike. 

Since 1965, our innovative products have cleaned, protected, and enhanced everything from classics and everyday drivers to modern performance cars. 

This year we’re celebrating six decades of excellence by becoming the proud Presenting Partner of the Cooly Rocks On [Show ‘N’ Shine](https://www.coolyrockson.com/show-n-shine/), proving our commitment to quality and innovation remains stronger than ever, because great cars and their owners deserve the best. 

[![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/GCA-LogoΓCoHorizontalΓCoMono-scaled.png)](https://www.goldcoastairport.com.au/)

[Gold Coast Airport](https://www.goldcoastairport.com.au/) is the gateway to Australia’s premier tourist destination, connecting South East Queensland and Northern New South Wales to Australia and beyond. We’re committed to creating accessible and inclusive environments for everyone to enjoy – as a proud Major Partner of Cooly Rocks On, we’re helping to share our city with the world.

**PARTNERS**

[![Indian motorcycle logo black](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/Indian-motorcycle-logo-black-1170x409.png)](https://www.indianmotorcycle.com.au/)

[Indian Motorcycle](https://www.indianmotorcycle.com.au/), America’s first motorcycle company since 1901, with commitment to fine craftsmanship and pioneering spirit, produces some of the most iconic motorcycles, recognised worldwide.

Partners since 2019, both Indian Motorcycle and Cooly Rocks On continue to pay homage to the classics, coming together on the Coolangatta foreshore to celebrate motors, lifestyle and music. Indian Motorcycle is proud to be an official Partner of Cooly Rocks On.

[![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Shannons-Sponsor-Logo-MONO-1170x332.png)](https://www.shannons.com.au/)

[Shannons](https://www.shannons.com.au/) is Australia’s original insurance for motor enthusiasts. From vintage and veteran to classics, hot rods and modified cars. No one knows your passion like Shannons.

Shannons insurance products are tailored with the motoring enthusiast in mind – with features like Your Choice of Repairer, Agreed Value and Cover for Modifications (terms and conditions apply).

Shannons also offers membership to the Shannons Club. Our online community for motoring enthusiasts featuring articles from Australia’s leading motoring journalists and exclusive videos, join over 170,000 motoring enthusiasts on the Shannons Club today – it’s free!

For more information visit [Shannons](https://www.shannons.com.au/) or call 13 46 46 and speak with a genuine motoring enthusiast today.

**COMMUNITY PARTNERS**

[![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/YRACA-LOGO-MONO-Background-Removed-768x432.png)](https://www.yraca.org.au/%20)

[Yugambeh Region Aboriginal Corporation Alliance](https://www.yraca.org.au/) aims to promote and strengthen Yugambeh culture, whilst championing the ambitions of its Traditional Custodian membership base by providing cultural services, supporting Aboriginal and Torres Straight Islander businesses, building relationships and cultural opportunities across the region.

The festival is held on the lands of the Kombumerri and Minjungbal family groups who have a shared connection to this place. YRACA is proud be the Cultural Advisory Partner of Cooly Rocks On.

[![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/EVENTELEC-LOGO-ALL-Electrical_MONO-POS-e1685579061746-768x228.png)](https://www.eventelec.com.au/)

[EVENTelec](https://aus01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.eventelec.com.au%2F&data=05%7C02%7Camber.patch%40experiencegoldcoast.com%7Ccfd8a3ef61814db8e30c08de1bf6c476%7Cde5f7e6b6183467c9793b82d0f663638%7C0%7C0%7C638978943892481296%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=twgCzpCQT8zy67vQCDc1HXfqO0We1T1xDEk0Jt1nKrI%3D&reserved=0) is a Gold Coast based team of award-winning event specialist electricians and engineers, who have been powering major events and festivals across a variety of sectors since 1996. Now a national brand servicing six states and territories and powering over 120 major events per year, EVENTelec is a proud Partner of Cooly Rocks On. Our experienced team is dedicated to providing exceptional service with professional integrity and will be powering Cooly Rocks On this June.

[![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/TFH-logo-ecc-01-BLACK-500x292.jpg)](https://tfh.com.au/)

TFH Hire Services is Australia’s leading privately owned temporary hire company, proudly supporting live events, construction and civil projects nationwide for over 30 years. With 38 branches across the country, we deliver essential infrastructure that keeps events and worksites safe and operating efficiently – from temporary fencing, site cameras, crowd barriers to picnic tables and portable facilities. We partner with major festivals, councils, and corporate clients, including our valued support of Experience Gold Coast. As a true one-stop shop for hire solutions, TFH is trusted for quality, compliance, and service excellence – We Are Everywhere! Get a quote at [www.tfh.com.au](https://tfh.com.au/)

**MEDIA PARTNER**

[![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/TripleM925_GoldCoast_lineart_on-blk-768x266-1-1.png)](https://triplem.listnr.com/gold-coast/)

[Triple M Gold Coast](https://triplem.listnr.com/gold-coast/) is your home for rock, sport, and the stories that matter. We bring the biggest anthems, the latest local news, and the best footy coverage to the Goldie. From classic hits to fresh rock, we keep the energy high and the community connected. As proud partners of Blues on Broadbeach, we’re all about celebrating live music and supporting the artists who make it unforgettable. Whether on-air, online, or on the ground, Triple M is with you – turn it up and let the good times roll! 

[![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Clean-Vibes-Logo-black.png)](https://cleanvibes.com.au/)

With sustainability at our core, we offer high end cleaning and waste management services to events throughout Australia and New Zealand. The [Clean Vibes](https://cleanvibes.com.au/) crew love what we do (seriously, we have ‘bin juice’ in our DNA!) and are proud Community Partners of Experience Gold Coast.

We look forward to delivering highly professional services at each of the four events across 2024 to ensure festival goers have an enjoyable and comfortable experience, whilst considering the environment at every step. Be sure to say hello or to ask our friendly team for assistance at the festival!

[![Griffith University](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/GU_Logo_International_3-Line-Stack_black_rgb-768x226.png)](https://www.griffith.edu.au/)

Since 1990, [Griffith University](https://www.griffith.edu.au/) has been working to create a better future for the Gold Coast by offering a world-class education right here, while also attracting the best teachers and researchers from around the world. Griffith has built a reputation to become a global research and education powerhouse, ranked in the top 2% of universities worldwide. The University is internationally renowned for its teaching and research in health, business, tourism, environment, and many other areas that make a positive impact in our vibrant community.

 Griffith on the Gold Coast proudly contributes to the cultural life of the city through innovative local partnerships such as this sponsorship, reflecting our goal to create positive, meaningful change in the lives of our students, our community and all of society.

**CHARITY PARTNER**

[![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/MND-logo-stack-black.png)](https://www.mndandme.com.au/)

The [MND and Me Foundation](https://www.mndandme.com.au/) is a not for profit organisation focused on raising funds to ensure a cure for Motor Neurone Disease (MND) is realised, whilst improving the lives of those impacted by the disease.

They aim to reduce the burden of recently diagnosed patients and their families and provide practical assistance to people living with MND, and their Carers, to help them cope with present and future challenges.

MND and Me Foundation is proud to be the Official Charity Partner of Cooly Rocks On in 2024. You will find them on-site at the festival selling raffle tickets for the chance to win a 1946 Ford Jailbar with all funds going towards MND Research to hopefully find a cure for this terminal disease. 

**INTERESTED IN JOINING THE COOLY ROCKS ON SPONSOR FAMILY?**

We’d love to hear from you! Click below to learn more about sponsorship opportunities available and we look forward to welcoming you to our sponsor family.

# Party at Our Partner Venues for Cooly Rocks On 2026!

![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/8starred.png)

![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/070624_Cooly-Rocks-On_GC_Bianca-Holderness-75.jpg)

Not long now until we’re swing dancing in the sunshine to the sweet sound of rock ‘n’ roll music, admiring a line up of classic cars and putting the finishing touches on our rockabilly outfits. Cooly Rocks On 2026 is so close!  

The beautiful beachside suburb of Coolangatta will come alive for five days from June 3 – 7 and our amazing partner venues will be serving up the retro vibes along with delicious drinks and food to fuel you up! From dancing to dining, drinks and live music, drop into these venues for a guaranteed good time during Cooly Rocks On. 

###### **Greenmount Beach Surf Club**

Nestled right by the beach with panoramic ocean views, a spacious outdoor deck and delightful dining options, [Greenmount Beach Surf Club](https://www.greenmountsurfclub.com.au/) is a local icon. Sit, sip and savour in a laid-back family-friendly atmosphere and drop by over the festival for live music and rock ‘n’ roll dancing all weekend.

###### **Coolangatta Sands Hotel**

Catch your favourite Cooly Rocks On artists at [The Sands](https://www.coolangattasandshotel.com.au/). This historic hotel has been a local watering hole since 1911 and is a must-visit venue for lovers of live music. Drop in for a boogie and a cold beer, or a bite to eat from modern pub-style menu.

###### **Eddie’s Grub House**

A New Orleans-style dive bar and rock ‘n’ roll venue with a mouthwatering menu of burgers and cocktails, [Eddie’s Grub House](https://www.eddiesgrubhouse.com/) is a go-to for good times, good tunes and a great feed. Found tucked away under The Pink Hotel, Eddie’s is a venue that stands out from the crowd.

###### Kirra Beach House

Head to [Kirra Beach House](https://kirrabeachhouse.com/) for a late-night session of disco, funk and 80’s anthems, soundtracked by Sgt Slick (Melbourne) and disco local Andy Finn. With global releases, chart-topping edits and a reputation for keeping dancefloors packed, Sgt Slick delivers nothing but high-energy, feel-good sets from start to finish. Free entry, 8pm until late, or join Kirra Beach House earlier for dinner! Venue open from 12pm with DJ’s from 4pm.

###### **4 Pines Brewing Co**

This vibrant beachfront cafe, bar, and small-scale microbrewery is found on the ground floor of The Strand shopping precinct. Pairing the [4 Pines](https://4pinesbeer.com.au/) craft beer experience with a relaxed surf-culture vibe, the laid back, open-air venue will be open all day, from bacon and egg rolls at breakfast to late night drinks. It’s the perfect festival wind-down (or warm up!) spot.

###### **The House Of Bamboo**

This [Asian-fusion restaurant and bar](https://the-house-of-bamboo.com/) isn’t just a venue – it’s a vibe! Think vibrant Asian street food feasts, world-class cocktails and disco beats. Head to this buzzing basement for underground sounds and nights to remember.

###### Superbar

One of the [Gold Coast’s favourite clubs](https://www.instagram.com/superbargc/) will be rolling out the retro carpet for Cooly Rocks On! Get on down to [DJ Johnny B](https://www.coolyrockson.com/artist/dj-johnny-b/) on Friday and Saturday night, and catch [Fletcher’s](https://www.coolyrockson.com/artist/fletcher/) special Cooly Rocks On set of 70s and 80s dancefloor classics and Saturday from 3 –5 pm.

###### Cooly Hotel

Catch some of your favourite live acts at [Cooly Hotel](https://www.thecoolyhotel.com.au/) – one of the Gold Coast’s premiere live music venues. Enjoy prime views and people watching from verandah, tuck into a classic pub meal from the bistro, shoot some pool and say cheers to yesteryear at one of the multiple bars.

###### **CWA Coolangatta**

The [CWA Coolangatta](https://www.qcwa.org.au/) is a volunteer group who support their local community in many ways. They’re throwing open their doors for two vibrant evenings of retro-fuelled fun. Dance along to live music from local party favourites, The Salty Daze, for the Cooly Nights Rock events on Friday and Saturday night.

For the full lowdown on who’s hitting the stage and what’s going down at our venue partners, dive into the complete [program here](https://www.coolyrockson.com/program/) or check it out on the [Experience Gold Coast App](https://www.coolyrockson.com/festival-app/). 

Our thanks to these local venues who help make Cooly Rocks On the iconic celebration it has become. Join us June 3 – 7 at Australia’s largest nostalgia festival for a packed program of all things [Motors](https://www.coolyrockson.com/motors/), [Music](https://www.coolyrockson.com/music/) and [Lifestyle](https://www.coolyrockson.com/lifestyle/).

# LIFESTYLE

![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/8starred.png)

![CRO\_Lifestyle\_THURS-63](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/CRO_Lifestyle_THURS-63-scaled-e1750399012763.jpg "CRO_Lifestyle_THURS-63")

### **MOONLIGHT SWING DANCE**

Join the party of the year and swing into history at the Cooly Rocks On Moonlight Swing Dance. 

[FIND OUT MORE](https://www.coolyrockson.com/moonlight-swing-dance/)

![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/CRO_Sun-Selects_AB-46-1-scaled-e1750398772270.jpg)

[![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Untitled-design-12.png)](https://www.coolyrockson.com/markets/)

### Markets

From retro fashion to vintage memorabilia products and food, wander through the Cooly Rocks On markets and pick yourself up a treat.

[FIND OUT MORE](https://www.coolyrockson.com/markets/)

### ROCK ‘N’ ROLL DANCE

Polish off your dancing shoes and show off your best moves to all of your favourite tunes at the Beachside Rock ‘N’ Roll Dance! 

[FIND OUT MORE](https://www.coolyrockson.com/beachside-rock-n-roll-dance/)

![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/PIN-UP-PAGEANT-WINNERS-NO-1-scaled.jpg)

### Pin-up pageant

Showcasing the differing lifestyles, cultures, fashions, hair and make-up of eras gone by, who will take the crown at the 2027 Cooly Rocks On Pin-up Pageant? 

[FIND OUT MORE](https://www.coolyrockson.com/pin-up-pageant/)

[![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/CRO_Lifestyle_THURS-63-scaled-e1750399012763.jpg)](https://www.coolyrockson.com/moonlight-swing-dance/)

### **MOONLIGHT SWING DANCE**

Join the party of the year and swing into history at the Cooly Rocks On Moonlight Swing Dance. 

[FIND OUT MORE](https://www.coolyrockson.com/moonlight-swing-dance/)

[![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Cooly-Rocks-On-2022_10062022_Bianca-Holderness-533-e1681958997178-1024x1024.jpg)](https://www.coolyrockson.com/rock-on-dance-workshops/)

### DANCE WORKSHOP

Learn to dance various styles like rock ‘n’ roll, swing, rockabilly, lindy hop and more! All skill levels welcome, so grab your dancing shoes!

[FIND OUT MORE](https://www.coolyrockson.com/rock-on-dance-workshops/)

![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/Untitled-design-30.jpg)

### Dance Workshops

Swing on in and learn a thing or two at the Dance Workshops. Heat up the dance floor as you enjoy rock ‘n’ roll, swing, rockabilly, balboa and line dance lessons.

## お車でお越しの方 ( By Car )

![LQQK!](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/img/look-right-16.jpg) **横浜方面からお越しの方**  
首都高湾岸線 臨海副都心出口で降りてすぐの交差点を右折、また右折し、潮風公園南交差点を左折。  
「船の科学館入り口」　を左折で会場入り口です。

**From Yokohama Area**  
If you get off at the exit of Bayshore Route Rinkai Fukutoshin, turn right at the intersection and turn right again and then turn left at Shiokaze Park South intersection. If you turn left at "Museum of Maritime Science Entrance" there will be the entrance.

![LQQK!](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/img/look-right-16.jpg) **東京方面からお越しの方**  
レインボー ブリッジからお越しの方は台場出口で降り「レインボー入口」を左折し、  
フジテレビ前を通り、突き当りを左折。「船の科学館入り口」　を左折で会場入り口です。

From Tokyo Area  
From Rainbow bridge exit from Daiba exit and turn left from "Rainbow Entrance" and pass front of Fuji TV and turn left at the end of the road. If you turn left at "Museum of Maritime Science Entrance" there will be the entrance.

![LQQK!](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/img/look-right-16.jpg) **舞浜方面からお越しの方**  
有明出口で降り、直進。「潮風公園南」を左折、「船の科学館入口」を左折で会場入口です。

From Maihama Area  
Go straight after you exit from Ariake Exit. Turn left at Shiokaze Park South intersection. If you turn left at "Museum of Maritime Science Entrance" there will be the entrance.

## 公共機関でのご来場が便利です。

It is also accessible by public transportation

![LQQK!](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/img/look-right-16.jpg) **東京臨海新交通 ゆりかもめ**

By Tokyo Waterfront New Transit Yurikamome

JR 新橋駅より東京臨海新交通 ゆりかもめに乗り換えて7駅目「東京国際クルーズターミナル駅」下車、徒歩2分程で会場です。

From JR Shinbashi stations go on Yurikamome and at the go off at the 7th stop "Museum of Maritime Science". Walk for 2 minutes and there will be the venue..

![LQQK!](https://www.mooneyes.co.jp/events/img/look-right-16.jpg) **東京臨海高速鉄道 りんかい線**

JR 山手線、JR 埼京線、湘南新宿ラインは大崎駅にて東京臨海高速鉄道に乗り換えて  
4駅目「東京テレポート駅」下車  
徒歩10分程で会場です。  
東急大井町線、JR 京浜東北線は大井町駅にて乗り換えて3駅目「東京テレポート駅」下車。  
JR京葉線、東京メトロ有楽町線は新木場駅にて乗り換えて3駅目「東京テレポート駅」下車。

By Yamanote, Saikyo and Shounan Shinjyuku line go off at "Osaki Station" and go on the Rinkai line to the 4th stop "Tokyo Teleport" station and then it will be approximately 10 minute walk to the venue.  
By Tokyu Ooimachi line, JR Keihin Tohoku line, go off at "Ooimachi station" and 3rd stop will be Tokyo Teleport station.  
By JR Keiyou line and Tokyo metro Yurakucho line go off at "Shinkiba station" and 3rd stop will be Tokyo Teleport station.

###### **Cooly Rocks On recognises that SPONSORSHIPS are guided by a shared vision and purpose.**

Striving for unity within our partnerships, we look to provide synergy between your business and our brand, Cooly Rocks On.  Offering endless sponsorship opportunities that are tailored to you, leveraging off Cooly Rocks On has never been easier and assists to extend your brand exposure and build a lasting connection with our fans and visitors.

# Hobart  
Twilight Market

*   Eats
*   Drinks
*   Design
*   Music

The ultimate Friday night out. Taste Tasmania's best food and drinks, browse local makers, enjoy live music, and soak up a relaxed, family and dog friendly atmosphere.

[All Market Dates](https://hobarttwilightmarket.com.au/#dates)[Apply as a stallholder](https://hobarttwilightmarket.com.au/#stallholder)

Also from us — [Tasmanian Produce Market](https://hobarttwilightmarket.com.au/tasmanian-produce-market)

## About Us

At the Hobart Twilight Market, we strive to create a warm and welcoming atmosphere where you can enjoy live music from local talent and indulge in Tasmania's finest quality products. Our market is home to a diverse range of food and locally-crafted small batch drinks, as well as an array of design stalls.

We take pride in our passionate stallholders who are eager to share their unique stories with you. Our market provides access to toilets, a playground (Long Beach only), accessible parking, a dedicated information booth, and a fee-free cash-out facility. We welcome dogs and families and hope to create a truly enjoyable experience for all who attend.

Make sure you follow our social channels to learn more about what you can expect when visiting.

🦮 Dog Friendly👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family Friendly♿ Accessible🅿️ Accessible Parking

![Hobart Twilight Market](/htm-about.jpg)![Market stalls](/htm-about-1.jpg)![Market atmosphere](/htm-about-2.jpg)

## There's so much to see & do at Hobart Twilight Market

From street food to live music, discover everything our market has to offer.

![Street Food](/htm-street-food.webp)

### Street Food

Welcome to foodie heaven! Chow down on a diverse range of gourmet treats from local street traders and a sizeable food truck line-up. Grab a bite to eat as you peruse the markets, or make a meal of it, sit back and enjoy the people-watching.

![Local Produce](/htm-local-produce.webp)

### Local Produce

Get to know the farmers behind your produce whilst you fill your bag with locally grown fruit, veggies and plants. The perfect place to stock up on your weekly goods, with everything from farm-fresh seasonal produce to homemade artisanal treats.

![Design](/htm-design.webp)

### Design

Browse the eclectic craft stalls, boasting an impressive range of local homewares and goodies you didn't even know you needed. Jewellery, gifts, books, homewares and many other eclectic surprises await you.

![Live Music](/htm-live-music.webp)

### Live Music

Let the afternoon slip away to the chilled tunes of live and local talented artists, entertainers and musicians against a picturesque backdrop. A perfect place to sit back and spend the afternoon with family, friends and dogs too!

![Fashion](/htm-fashion.webp)

### Fashion

A perfectly fashionable Friday night shopping experience! Always a hub of creativity, you can shop and explore the latest from local designers, makers and entrepreneurs, as well as find pre-loved items to spice up your wardrobe.

![Refreshments](/htm-refreshments.webp)

### Refreshments

Find a new favourite as you sip your way through some of the region's finest beverages, with everything from locally made liquors, cocktails, cordials and wines to quaff or savour.

## One city, two amazing market locations

Experience Hobart's Twilight Market at two stunning waterfront locations.

![Long Beach, Sandy Bay](/htm-long-beach.webp)

Pop Up Series

### Long Beach, Sandy Bay

Experience Hobart's iconic Twilight Market, located on the picturesque Long Beach. Delicious food, live music and local crafts.

**Where?**17 Beach Road, Lower Sandy Bay — 10-min drive from Hobart CBD. Catch a Metro bus or hire a scooter.

**When?**Select Fridays 4:30pm – 9:00pm (Oct–Mar) + Sunday Pop Up Series 11:00am – 3:00pm (Jun–Sep)

[Get Directions](https://www.google.com/maps/place/42%C2%B054'37.4%22S+147%C2%B021'23.2%22E/@-42.91038,147.356451,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m4!3m3!8m2!3d-42.91038!4d147.356451?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDcxNC4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)

![Brooke St Pier](/htm-brooke-st.webp)

### Brooke St Pier

Discover Hobart's vibrant Twilight Market, located at Brooke Street Pier. Shop, eat and connect with the local community.

**Where?**12 Franklin Wharf, Hobart TAS 7000 — in the heart of the city, easily accessible by foot or public transport.

**When?**Select Fridays 4:30pm – 9:00pm. Dates are subject to change — check our website and socials for updates.

[Get Directions](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Brooke+Street+Pier/@-42.8847445,147.33021,17z)

Our markets wouldn't be possible without the support of our valued sponsors. Together, we're creating a unique community hub for Tasmanian small businesses, creators, and entertainers.

# FAQs

![](https://www.coolyrockson.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/8starred.png)

[GENERAL INFORMATION](https://www.coolyrockson.com/frequently-asked-questions/#event-information)

[MOTORS](https://www.coolyrockson.com/frequently-asked-questions/#motors)

[MUSIC](https://www.coolyrockson.com/frequently-asked-questions/#music)

[FEATURED SHOWS](https://www.coolyrockson.com/frequently-asked-questions/#featuredshows)
