[APPLICATIONS](https://www.coolyrockson.com/frequently-asked-questions/#applications)

[VIP LEGENDS PASS](https://www.coolyrockson.com/frequently-asked-questions/#vip-legends)

### GENERAL Information

WHAT ARE THE DATES FOR COOLY ROCKS ON 2027?

Cooly Rocks On will be back 9 – 13 June 2027 in Coolangatta, Gold Coast.

WHERE IS COOLY ROCKS ON HELD?

Cooly Rocks On is located throughout the streets, parks and venues of Coolangatta on the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia.

IS THE FESTIVAL FREE TO ATTEND?

Cooly Rocks On is a FREE festival to attend.

You’re able to enjoy all of the Cooly Rocks On outdoor stages, [Show ‘N’ Shine](https://www.coolyrockson.com/show-n-shine/) proudly presented by Autoglym and beachfront activations for free. There are numerous festival features that require you to purchase a ticket, these are: [Show ‘N’ Shine entry](https://www.coolyrockson.com/show-n-shine/) for those wanting to display their cars, Elvis Marquee shows and the [VIP Legends Pass](https://www.coolyrockson.com/legends-pass/). 

Is the Cooly Rocks On 2027 program and app out?

The Cooly Rocks On 2027 program and app will be released closer to the festival.

WHERE CAN I BOOK ACCOMMODATION FOR COOLY ROCKS ON?

There are plenty of accommodation options on the Gold Coast and you can see what’s close to Cooly Rocks On [here](https://www.coolyrockson.com/all-accommodation/?pa=1&count=10). We always suggest getting in early to secure your spot. 

WILL THERE BE ACCESSIBLE VIEWING AREAS AT THE FESTIVAL?

Cooly Rocks On provides an inclusive environment for all attendees to enjoy five days of entertainment as we celebrate the motors, music and lifestyle of yesteryear. There will be accessible viewing areas throughout the festival that will be indicated by signage at outdoor stages. For more accessibility information at Cooly Rocks On, click [here](https://www.coolyrockson.com/accessibility/). 

How do I get to the festival?

There are many ways to get to Cooly Rocks On. Whether it’s public transport, rideshare & taxi, or driving you will be able to access the festival. You can find out more about Transport & Travel [here](https://www.coolyrockson.com/getting-here).

CAN I BRING MY PET TO COOLY ROCKS ON?

As the festival is held within a public area, local laws apply for bringing your pet to Cooly Rocks On. However, due to large crowds, loud music and revving of cars and motorcycles, we recommend attendees leave their pets at home.

Does Cooly Rocks On have a wet weather plan?

We have our fingers crossed for sunshine so we can enjoy all that Cooly Rocks On has to offer. In the event it rains or we have inclement weather during the festival, our team will do all they can to minimise its impacts. If programming changes are required these will be communicated via our website and social media channels. 

WHERE CAN I BUY MERCHANDISE?

Cooly Rocks On festival merchandise can be purchased at the festival!

Can I pre-order Merchandise?

At this stage, pre-orders will not be available for Cooly Rocks On merchandise. However, the good news is there will be a merchandise tent at the festival from 9-13 June 2027.

### motors

Do I need to buy tickets to come and check out the cars?

Absolutely not! You don’t need to buy any tickets to come and see all of the incredible vehicles that will be on display for the Show ‘N’ Shine proudly presented by Autoglym. Tickets only apply to car owners who wish to enter their car into the Show ‘N’ Shine. 

WHO CAN ENTER THE SHOW 'N' SHINE?

The 2027 Show ‘N’ Shine proudly presented by Autoglym is open to vehicles manufactured prior to and including 1985, featuring classic cars, hot rods, customs, motorcycles and more.

Vehicles manufactured between 1980-1985 must complete an expression of interest application process before being accepted into the 80’s Zone of the Show ‘N’ Shine. The applications will open closer to the festival date.

When will Show 'N' Shine tickets go on sale?

Tickets for the 2027 Show ‘N’ Shine display proudly presented by Autoglym will become available closer to the festival date. Stay tuned on our socials and subscribe to our emails to be the first to know on when tickets will be available.

I'm in a car club, how do we get involved in the festival?

To be involved in the festival as a car club, please send an email to [\[email protected\]](https://www.coolyrockson.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#9dfbf8eee9f4ebfcf1eeddf8e5edf8eff4f8f3fef8faf2f1f9fef2fceee9b3fef2f0) with your contact details and car club name, and our team will get back to you!

Does my motor vehicle have to be QLD road registered to participate in the Show 'N' Shine?

No! Your motor vehicle does not need to be road registered for the Show ‘N’ Shine display. However, due to changes within the ASRF Insurance Policy, Travel Concessions can now only be provided to applicants for single day events and therefore Cooly Rocks On is unable to receive a sanction. All ASRF Members wishing to enter the Cooly Rocks On Show ‘N’ Shine and other motor events associated with Cooly Rocks On will need to list their attendance on the [ASRF QLD Impromptu Facebook Page.](https://www.facebook.com/groups/305462810308811/) 

When will the Car Runs go on sale?

The 2027 Cooly Rocks On Car Runs will be on sale closer to the date. 

Stay tuned to find out more information about the 2027 Car Runs and when they go on sale. 

What is the Saturday Night Car Cruise?

The Saturday Night Car Cruise, returning Saturday 12 June 2027, transforms the streets of Coolangatta into a runway for the beautiful cars on display as part of the festival’s Show ‘N’ Shine. Car owners will get the opportunity to cruise along Coolangatta and show off their pride and joy in action while the festival crowd watches on! 

Who can enter the Saturday Night Car Cruise?

Only Show ‘N’ Shine Car entrants who have bought a Show ‘N’ Shine Weekend Pass + Night Cruise will be permitted to enter the Saturday Night Car Cruise. The cruise is free to spectate!

### music

### FEATURED SHOWS

Can I listen to the music for free while I'm at the festival?

Yes, you’re able to enjoy live entertainment on all of the Cooly Rocks On outdoor stages and partnered venues for free. 

Who's on the 2027 artist lineup?

Stay tuned for the 2027 lineup!

Who are the Elvis Tribute Artists for Cooly Rocks On 2027?

Stay tuned for who the Elvis Tribute Artists are as we will announce closer to the festival!

What are the 2027 feature shows?

Stay tuned – we’ll announce the 2027 Feature Shows closer to the festival.

WHEN DO TICKETS GO ON SALE FOR FEATURE SHOWS?

Stay tuned for when tickets go on sale. We will announce the ticket sale closer to the festival!

Is the Elvis Marquee wheelchair accessible?

Yes, the Elvis Marquee is wheelchair accessible and companion seating is available.

More information about companion cards for 2027 will be released closer to the festival date.

Do I need to purchase a VIP Legends Pass to see the Elvis shows?

No, you don’t need to purchase a VIP Legends Pass to see the Elvis shows. 

The VIP Legends Pass includes premium seating, priority meet-and-greets with Elvis Tribute Artists, VIP-only events, exclusive merchandise and more! It’s the ultimate fan experience.

Stay tuned! The 2027 VIP Legends Pass will go on sale closer to the festival date. To see all the 2026 VIP Legends Pass Holders inclusions click [here](https://www.coolyrockson.com/legends-pass/)

What is included in the VIP Legends Pass?

The VIP Legends pass offers an exclusive experience. Enjoy premium seating, meet-and-greets with international headline performers, access to VIP-only events, and a premium memorabilia pack. Find out more [here.](https://www.coolyrockson.com/legends-pass/) 

When do the ticketed experiences go on sale? 

Ticketed experiences will go on sale **Thursday 12 February from 10AM AEST (QLD time).**        

Is the Elvis Marquee Accessible?

Yes, the Elvis Marquee is wheelchair accessible and companion seating is available.

For VIP Legends Pass Holders, accompanying Companion Card seats are available only for tickets purchased in accessibility seats AA19, BB19, and CC19 (unless sold out).

For all other ticketed experiences within the Elvis Marquee, Companion Card seats are available only for tickets purchased in accessibility seats:

*   Gold Section – A19, B19, C19
*   Silver Section – M19, N19, O19
*   Premium Section – AA19, BB19, CC19
*   General Admission – A19, B19, C19

To request a Companion Card ticket, please first purchase one of these seats, then email [\[email protected\]](https://www.coolyrockson.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#670e090108270408080b1e1508040c1408094904080a "mailto:info@coolyrockson.com") with the following details:

*   Order number and proof of purchase
*   Full name and email address of the Companion Card holder
*   A photo of the State or national Companion Card

Who will send me my tickets? 

Your tickets will be sent to you from [\[email protected\]](https://www.coolyrockson.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#5d29343e3638293f32251d38252d382f3438333e383a3231393e323c2e29733e3230 "mailto:ticketbox@experiencegoldcoast.com")

Be sure to check your junk and spam folders if you don’t see them. 

If you can’t find your tickets, please contact the Cooly Rocks On team by calling 1300 035 189 or emailing [\[email protected\]](https://www.coolyrockson.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#61080f070e21020e0e0d18130e020a120e0f4f020e0c "mailto:info@coolyrockson.com").  

How will my ticket purchase appear on my bank statement? 

The Credit Card descriptor will appear as HOTA Gold Coast.

Are my tickets refundable?

The festival will only accept tickets originally purchased directly from Experience Gold Coast. 

All refunds are provided at the discretion of the event organiser and are subject to the Terms and Conditions agreed to at the time of purchasing the ticket. 

If you would like to apply for a refund, please contact the Cooly Rocks On team by calling 1300 035 189 or emailing [\[email protected\]](https://www.coolyrockson.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#1c75727a735c7f737370656e737f776f7372327f7371 "mailto:info@coolyrockson.com") to begin the process. 

 Is my ticket transferable? 

Yes, if you are no longer able to attend the festival, we can facilitate a transfer to a new individual. 

Please note, we are only able to facilitate one change of name per pass, and all transfers must be received in writing prior to the festival commencement (9am, Wednesday 3rd June 2026) 

Please contact the Cooly Rocks On team by calling 1300 035 189 or emailing [\[email protected\]](https://www.coolyrockson.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#f891969e97b89b979794818a979b938b9796d69b9795 "mailto:info@coolyrockson.com") to begin the process. 

### LIFESTYLE

When and where can I buy a ticket to the Cooly rocks On Pin-up Pageant?

Entry to watch the Cooly Rocks On Pin-up Pageant is free. Stay tuned as we announce more details about the Pin Up Pageant closer to the festival date.

Who can apply to enter the Cooly Rocks On Pin-up Pageant?

We encourage and welcome pin-ups from all walks of life to apply every year!

When are the Moonlight Swing Dance tickets on sale for 2027?

Stay tuned as we announce when tickets are on sale closer to the date.  

Can kids attend the Moonlight Swing Dance? Do they receive free entry?

The Moonlight Swing Dance is kid-friendly, however, tickets are required for all attendees in order to maintain numbers. We hope to see you there!

### Applications

When are the Artist Applications Open?

Artist applications for Cooly Rocks On 2027 will open closer to the festival date. 

Follow our socials and stay tuned for when the applications open.

When are the Ultimate Elvis Tribute Artist Contest Applications open?

The 2027 Cooly Rocks On Ultimate Elvis Tribute Artist Contest applications will open closer to the festival date.

When are the Pin-up Pageant applications open?

Applications for the 2027 Cooly Rocks On Pin-up Pageant will open closer to the festival date.

When are Vendor applications open?

Vendor applications for Cooly Rocks On 2027 will open closer to the festival date.

Stay tuned on our socials to find out when!

### VIP LEGENDS PASS

WHEN WILL THE 2027 VIP LEGENDS PASS GO ON SALE?

VIP Legends Passes will go on sale closer to the festival date.

Make sure you have subscribed to our emails and stay tuned on our socials for all the up-to-date information.

To see the inclusions of what the 2026 VIP Legends Pass, click [here](https://www.coolyrockson.com/legends-pass/). 

How much are VIP Legends Passes?

Stay tuned for more details closer to the event date!

What is included in the VIP Legends Pass?

VIP Legends Pass include premium seating, priority meet-and-greets with Elvis Tribute Artists, VIP-only events, exclusive merchandise, and MORE throughout the festival.

For the full list of inclusions of the 2026 VIP Legends Pass Holders, click [here](https://www.coolyrockson.com/legends-pass/).

### music

### TICKETED EXPERIENCES

When do the ticketed experiences go on sale? 

Stay tuned! Ticketed experiences will go on sale closer to the festival date!

Is the Elvis Marquee Accessible?

Yes, the Elvis Marquee is wheelchair accessible and companion seating is available.

More information about companion cards for 2027 will be released closer to the festival date.
